raw.description:
About the company

Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world.

Founded in Japan in 1994, Side has grown to become a global force in the video games industry, with over 40 studios in 15 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include codev, art production, localization, audio production, quality assurance, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. For more information, visit

About the role

As Localization QA Game Tester, you will work within our Localization Quality Assurance team and be the very first person to see the localized game in its entirety – translated text, images and the rest of the user interface collectively. You’ll get to experience the project in the way it will be consumed by the end users. You will work in a multilingual project team ensuring that the game is free from grammatical errors, cultural inconsistencies and ultimately ensuring that the game is accurately localized into the target language.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with a global project team.
  • Identify and correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and other language errors.
  • Ensure adherence to console manufacturer guidelines.
  • Log details of errors and issues, providing improvement suggestions.
  • Ensure accurate translation within context and maintain consistency in terminology and imagery.
  • Identify missing or incorrect content and ensure proper display/format of dates, calendars, and characters.
  • Write reports on errors and bugs found and perform ad hoc translation.
  • Oversee the quality of your work, collaborate with the team, and contribute to the overall success of projects.

Our Localization QA team conducts language checks on upcoming games across a variety of cutting-edge platforms, including PC, Xbox Series X/S, PS5, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation VR2, and various mobile and tablet devices. As an LQA Game Tester, you will be working on top gaming titles for some of the world’s leading publishers.

Requirements

  • No experience required. Just fluency in Polish and conversational in English.
  • Strong cultural understanding of the language you are applying for.
  • Computer literacy – particularly with Excel.
  • Robust Internet research skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Previous experience with using different software, applications, and websites.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely and collaborate within project teams.
  • Candidate must be located within Schengen Area.

What we offer:

  • You will be working for the pre-eminent global provider of specialist services to the games industry and provided with full training and the opportunity to work on some of the biggest game clients, titles, projects, and tech in the world.
  • Attractive remuneration, holidays, regular team competitions with great prizes; and inclusion into an extensive social calendar. Our environments thrive with collaborative teamwork with people from all around the world, different nationalities, and languages.
  • A supportive community inclusive of LGBTQ+, and any age, ethnicity, religion, or disability. We care about the well-being of our employees and have a dedicated employee well-being program. We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.
  • Learn as you work and be part of something real that changes the face of gaming - forever.
  • Working with a global multi-lingual workforce with superb training and promotion and progression opportunities.

Working Condition:

  • Fully remote within Schengen Area. If you're based in Braga, Portugal, even better!
  • With the possibility of transitioning to a full-time role. However, if you prefer to remain a freelancer, that's perfectly fine!

We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities. If your qualifications align with a role/project that becomes available, we will reach out to you directly to discuss next steps. While there may not be an immediate opening, we encourage you to submit your application, as we regularly review our pool of candidates when positions arise. For more career opportunities, visit our career page:

ALL APPLICATION MUST BE SENT IN ENGLISH

raw.excerpt: Why AssemblyAIAssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications.
raw.description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!

About the Role

AssemblyAI builds the foundational speech models behind the Voice AI products our customers build. The people who train those models and build the systems that serve them are some of the hardest people in tech to hire; and we need to hire a lot more of them in 2027.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter to own hiring for our Research team and a portfolio of senior Engineering roles: Researchers, Research Engineers, and ML Engineers. You’ll work directly with our research and engineering leaders, and you’ll be expected to understand the work well enough to find, assess, and close people others can’t.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Research and senior Engineering roles, from intake through offer and close
  • Build deep, outbound-first pipelines: map talent at frontier labs, speech and audio teams, and academic groups; track publications, open-source contributors, and conference speakers
  • Partner with research and engineering leaders to define profiles, calibrate on bar, and design quality, efficient interview loops
  • Run thoughtful screens with technical candidates and give hiring managers sharp, evidence-based reads
  • Lead complex closes: competing offers from large labs, equity conversations, and international candidates, in partnership with the People team
  • Build long-term relationships with candidates who aren’t ready to move yet
  • Use data and AI tooling to work faster: smarter sourcing, cleaner Greenhouse pipelines, and clear reporting on funnel health
  • Help the team scale: interviewer training, structured kits, and a candidate experience that reflects how much we care about the work

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of technical recruiting, with a track record of hiring ML researchers, research engineers, or ML/infrastructure engineers at AI labs, AI-native startups, or top tech companies
  • A strong outbound sourcing practice and a network in the ML/AI research community
  • Enough technical fluency to talk credibly about model training, evaluation, and inference with researchers, and to tell a strong profile from a keyword match
  • Experience closing senior, sought-after candidates against competing offers, including equity-heavy packages
  • Comfort with Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, JuiceBox (or similar), and modern AI sourcing tools
  • Self-direction: you find the highest-impact work and do it without waiting to be asked

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Compensation: $170,000–$200,000

The expected cash compensation for this role is listed above. Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants and 100% employer-paid benefits.

OTHER DUTIES

Joining our team means stepping into a collaborative and dynamic environment that values creativity, initiative, and a passion for client success. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and values each team member’s unique contributions.

raw.description:
At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead. Powering a jobsite shouldn't be a hassle. But too often, crews are left waiting, equipment breaks down, vendors go dark, and deadlines slip.

We started JC Davis Power to fix all of that. We're a full-service jobsite operations partner, delivering and maintaining temporary power, climate control, and tower lighting. All with one reliable crew. No handoffs. No confusion.

We show up, solve problems, and do the work the right way. Whether you're supporting customers in the field, building systems behind the scenes, or helping drive the business forward, you'll be part of a team that values reliability, accountability, and getting the job done.

Simple - Reliable - Done Right!

The Role

Every job site we support depends on equipment, fuel, parts, and subcontractors; each tied to an invoice that must be accurate.. As our Accounts Payable Analyst, you will manage the full payables cycle from invoice intake and three-way matching to payment runs, vendor reconciliations, and month-end close.

This is more than processing. You will be the person who spots the coding error before it distorts job costs, who reconciles the vendor statement nobody else wants to touch, and who tells us what our spend is doing. As the business grows, you will help build the payables process that scales with it.

What You'll Do

  • Process the payables volume. Review, code, and enter high volumes of vendor invoices, matching to purchase orders and receiving documentation and resolving discrepancies before they hit the ledger.

  • Own job and GL coding accuracy. Code invoices to the correct general ledger accounts, jobs, and cost categories so project profitability and equipment costs stay clean.

  • Run payments. Prepare and process check, ACH, and card payment runs on schedule, applying payment terms, discounts, and approval requirements.

  • Reconcile vendor accounts. Reconcile vendor statements, research aged and unmatched items, and work directly with vendors to resolve disputes, credits, and short pays.

  • Support month-end close. Prepare AP accruals, reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, and clear open items so close is not held up by payables.

  • Report on payables and spend. Build and maintain aging, cash requirement, and vendor spend reporting, and flag trends and exceptions to the Manager, Accounts Payable and Accounting leadership.

  • Improve the process. Identify the bottlenecks and recurring errors in the payables cycle, propose fixes, and help implement automation and workflow improvements in our systems.

  • Keep vendor data and compliance clean. Maintain vendor master records, collect and verify W-9s, support 1099 preparation, and apply sales and use tax treatment correctly.

  • Support audits and internal controls. Pull documentation and provide support for internal reviews and external audit requests, and follow approval and segregation of duties requirements.

  • Partner with the field and operations. Work with managers, purchasing, and shop teams to chase down missing approvals, packing slips, and PO detail to ensure invoices are processed without delay

  • Reconciling credit card accounts. Manage end-to-end reconciliation for high-volume corporate credit card accounts (50+ cards / $100K+ monthly volume), ensuring all transactions are matched with valid receipts, properly coded, and cleared against the general ledger. Investigate and resolve credit card transaction discrepancies, disputed charges, and unapplied credits with vendors and card-issuing banks.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of accounts payable experience, including full cycle, high volume processing

  • Hands on experience with purchase order based invoicing and three-way match

  • Experience reconciling vendor statements and the AP subledger to the general ledger

  • Working knowledge of an ERP or accounting system such as NetSuite, or similar, plus comfort learning new systems

  • Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling large data sets

  • Familiarity with W-9 collection and 1099 reporting

  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work

  • Ownership mentality. You work a problem to a finish and bring solutions, not just questions

  • Clear, professional communication with vendors and internal teams

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality with financial and vendor information

  • Self directed and dependable in a remote setting, with consistent availability during business hours

Bonus Points

  • Sales and use tax experience across multiple jurisdictions

  • Multi entity or multi location payables experience

  • Experience with an AP automation or invoice capture tool

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

What We Offer

We take care of our team so you can take care of the work. Our benefits are designed to keep you safe, supported, and set up for success.

  • Health & Wellness – 100% company-paid medical coverage premiums for you and your family, plus dental and vision options available

  • 401k – plus 4% matching

  • Time Off – Flexible PTO

  • Supportive Culture – Safety-first mindset, people-first values, and a team that looks out for one another

Sutherland is looking for a Sr. Director Network Administration (Remote - US Base). This role is responsible for overseeing and managing the Americas region’s network strategy, design, operation, and improvement of corporate and cloud networks for all of Sutherlands Business Units. This individual will manage a team of network engineers in our Americas region and be accountable for the design, management, upgrade, implementation strategy and stability of our wireless/wired networks, firewalls, switches, and cloud environment. Accountability extends to maintaining our network security which includes the definition, reporting, and documentation of our network architecture and compliance with peer standards in our other regions.

This individual will partner with our Global Network Teams, Server teams and other IT organizations as required to perform associated duties. This position will also work with our vendors and Business team members to design and deliver network services to support and enable Sutherland Business units and its clients. This includes proactive scanning, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, managing hardware/software upgrades, Information Security Management as it relates to network infrastructure and actioning urgent response requirements as needed.

Responsibilities:

Senior Director of Network Services summary of job function:

  • Network Security, LAN, WAN, and Wireless architecture design and implementation for all Sutherland Network Operations support for APAC region.
  • Provide management and technical direction for team of network engineers.
  • Ensure the network meets availability, reliability, security, and performance requirements.
  • Research and define network hardware and software standards with peers for Sutherland Network.
  • Develop/Update network related policies, procedures and processes.
  • Standardize network configuration across all Americas regions.

Management and Development of Network Operation Strategy

  • Develop and Manage network designs and build from multiple infrastructure projects to ensure appropriate delivery, reliability, redundancy, safety, security, scalability, and sustainability with contingency planning for growth design strategies for Sutherland.
  • Develop, Design, Manage and build of New/Remodeled Sutherland facilities.
  • Manage network engineering team.
  • Develop and oversee network technology roadmap for all Americas regions.
  • Collaborate with business units on strategic technical solutions.
  • Provide Level 3 network support for all Americas Region.
  • Maintain security across network infrastructure in conjunction with the Info Security Team and the Network Security Architecture team.
  • Develop and Maintain all network documentation as changes are implemented.
  • Work with VP of Global Network Services on Budgeting, Forecast planning and Special Project ROI Models.
  • Good technical expertise with enterprise On Prem Network Technologies – Switches, Routers, Load Balancers, Network Access Control, Remote Access technologies, SDWAN Devices, Wireless Networks, Web Proxy Services, as well as the supporting technologies like DNS and DHCP.
  • Participate in IT change control process and provide notifications to the business partners/stakeholders of planned and/or unplanned changes, maintenance windows, and outages.
  • Stay abreast of current technologies, developments, network compliance requirements, standards, and industry trends.
  • Ability to be on call as needed, accommodate intermittent travel, and perform other duties as assigned.

Education/Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, required in Computer Science, Engineering or related field.
  • Master’s degree, preferred in Computer Science, Business Management, or related field.
  • Minimum of five (5) years managing a large, complex enterprise network.
  • Leading large technical projects with demonstrated oral and written ability to communicate with team members and business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of network routing, switching, wireless, firewalls and SDWAN Technologies. Manufacturers include (Cisco, Zscaler, Citrix, Palo Alto and F5).
  • CCNA or CCNP Certification, Active or Expired, and verifiable network project experience to match 5-10 years of active network leadership experience are highly desirable.
  • Experience with software defined networks (SDN) and cloud environments are a plus. Certifications in these areas desired.
  • Experience with cloud-based telecom systems/technologies.
  • Managing and mentoring network engineers.
  • Architecting and designing large-scale networks.
  • Managing and maintaining Cisco Routers, Switches, Load Balancers and Firewalls.
  • Wireless networking technologies such as 802.11x in an enterprise environment.
  • Manage our internal clients and external clients in addressing escalations and client concerns.
  • Ability to be on call as needed, accommodate intermittent travel, and perform other duties as assigned.

raw.description:
Building anAI‑first organisationis central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function — to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve, must drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.

Clinisys has built an unrivalled reputation for deploying complex diagnostic networks and academic centres – and is the only provider to repetitively deliver to all disciplines end-to-end – at scale. Fostering healthier communities.

Role Summary

As aSolution Architect, you will work closely with healthcare and laboratory customers to design, configure and deploy Clinisys LIMS solutions across the UK and Ireland. Acting as a trusted advisor and technical subject matter expert, you will help optimise laboratory workflows, deliver successful implementations and support customers through solution design, testing and go-live.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and deployment of Clinisys LIMS solutions within pathology and laboratory environments.

  • Analyse customer workflows and translate requirements into scalable, best-practice solutions.

  • Act as the technical lead throughout implementation, validation and transition to support.

  • Collaborate with customers, project teams and partners to ensure successful delivery.

  • Drive standardisation, quality and continuous improvement across deployments.

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve automation, efficiency, data quality and decision support.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience delivering healthcare IT, LIMS or laboratory software solutions.

  • Strong understanding of pathology laboratory workflows and healthcare regulations.

  • Customer-facing consulting and stakeholder management experience.

  • Experience with healthcare integrations and messaging standards (HL7, FHIR).

  • Knowledge of cloud and hybrid environments, including Azure.

  • Strong problem-solving, solution design and technical troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • UK or Ireland healthcare sector experience preferred.

What We're Looking For

  • A consultative and customer-focused approach.

  • Strong technical leadership and solution design expertise.

  • Interest in emerging technologies, particularly AI and automation.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

  • Flexibility to travel to customer sites and the Woking office when required.

This role requires a working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and the ability to leverage them to improve processes and outcomes. A core understanding of AI concepts is required and must be able to demonstrate the use of AI tools in a professional setting.

Onboarding
As part of our onboarding process, all new employees will be required to attend / travel to the office on their first day of employment. This requirement is essential for onboarding activities, including the identity verification, completion of necessary documentation, receiving your IT equipment, introductions to key team members, and orientation to Clinisys policies and procedures.

raw.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
raw.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Job Title: Snowflake Administrator
Primary Location: remote
Position Type: contract

Overview
TalentFish is casting a line for a Snowflake Administrator to support a large healthcare system implementing - Snowflake enterprise data platform. This role will be responsible for Snowflake administration, platform configuration, performance tuning, security, and integration with Informatica, Epic healthcare data systems.
The ideal candidate will have worked as a Snowflake implantation as an Administrator for a large healthcare system, Will have advanced SQL skills, and experience supporting enterprise data environments utilizing Informatica. Healthcare experience is required, particularly working with Epic data.
What You Bring to the Role. (Ideal Experience)

  • Snowflake Administration: 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Snowflake environments, including platform configuration, virtual warehouses, databases, schemas, security, performance optimization – Snowflake implementation.

  • SQL Expertise: Strong SQL skills, including complex queries, troubleshooting, query optimization, and performance tuning.

  • Informatica Integration: Experience supporting Informatica ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion, and integration with Snowflake.

  • Healthcare / Epic Experience: Experience working with hospital data environments, preferably integrating Epic Clarity, Caboodle, or other Epic data sources into Snowflake.

  • Data Security & Governance: Experience with role-based access control (RBAC), data governance, HIPAA requirements, monitoring, and Snowflake cost management.

What You'll Do.

  • Administer Snowflake: Configure, maintain, monitor, and optimize Snowflake environments to ensure availability, scalability, security, and performance.

  • Support Data Integration: Partner with data engineering teams to support Informatica pipelines and the ingestion of Epic clinical, financial, and operational data into Snowflake.

  • Optimize Performance: Monitor workloads, troubleshoot SQL queries, optimize virtual warehouses, and manage Snowflake consumption and costs.

  • Manage Security: Implement user access, roles, permissions, data protection, and governance controls aligned with healthcare security and HIPAA requirements.

  • Support Implementation & Operations: Collaborate with data architects, BI teams, and hospital IT stakeholders to support Snowflake implementation, data warehouse migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform operations.

Compensation Information
Compensation: $50-80/hr (plus benefits we offer healthcare on the first of the month after start date and additional quality benefits programs.
The expected compensation for this position will depend on experience and qualifications. TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity.

title: Data Engineer, Forward Deployed
description: Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energy operations.

raw.title: Data Engineer, Forward Deployed
raw.excerpt: Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energy operations.
raw.description:
Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energy operations. We’re live across oil and gas, refineries, and petrochemicals, working towards our mission: sustainable

abundance for a growing planet.

The hydrocarbon industry keeps the world running. But its complexity has left operators tied to legacy systems, making critical decisions on less than 10% of available data. We built Orbital to change that. It’s a foundation model built specifically for energy that lets companies use AI at scale, harnessing all of their operational
data and optimising in real time for any metric. Decisions get faster, operations get safer, and carbon intensity falls.

We’ve raised over $32 million, including one of the largest seed rounds for an
AI company in the UK. We’re just getting started

The Role

As our Data Engineer, you’ll architect and maintain pipelines that make high-frequency time-series, lab, and historian data into a scalableLakehouse architecture, usable for both deep learning models and real-time LLMs. You’ll be working acrossAWS (EKS, S3, EBS, KMS, CloudWatch)andDatabricks/PySpark, ensuring data is contextualised, synchronised, and optimised for both deep learning models and real-time LLM workloads.

This isn’t a traditional ETL role, you’ll be solving problems at the intersection ofcontrol systems, industrial data engineering, and AI enablement.

Technical Requirements

  • Deep expertise in PostgreSQL (partitioning, indexing, query optimisation, storage design).

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing, scripting, and pipeline orchestration.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS (EKS, S3, EBS, IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, etc.)for secure and scalable data pipelines.

  • Proven ability to work with Databricks and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processing.

  • Familiarity with time-series industrial data (control systems, DCS/SCADA logs, process historians).

  • Experience in unstructured data sync and management within hybrid cloud/on-prem environments.

  • Bonus: Experience working as a data engineer in oil and gas or energy environments

  • Bonus: Knowledge of streaming frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming) or MLOps stacks for data versioning and lineage.

Core Responsibilities

1. Ingest & Contextualise Data

  • Ingest from OPC UA servers, process historians, IoT sensors, LIMS systems, alarms/events, and P&IDs.

  • Map signals to their physical processes (tags, units, hierarchies) for interpretability in AI pipelines.

2. Data Movement & Accessibility

  • Build pipelines that handle real-time streaming and batch ingestion into the Lakehouse.

  • Manage synchronisation between historian archives, unstructured files, and AWS storage (S3/EBS).

  • Orchestrate Databricks Lakeflow/Connectors for integrating data into Lakebase/Lakehouse.

  • Handle secure, high-throughput transfers between historian archives and sandbox/live environments.

3. Change Tracking & Integrity

  • Detect and manage schema changes, signal drift, and inconsistencies acrosstime.

  • Implement lineage and audit trails across Spark/Databricks and AWS pipelines.

4. Data Preparation for AI

  • Build and maintaindual pipelines:

    • Training→ large-scale historical data prep for time-series + LLM training.

    • Inference→ low-latency, real-time pipelines for anomaly detection, optimisation, and LLM search.

  • Support heterogeneous AI workloads (time-series forecasting and retrieval-augmented LLMs).

5. Database Performance & Optimisation

  • Tune PostgreSQLand sparkfor high-throughput time-series workloads (partitioning, indexing, query optimisation).

  • Optimise pipelines for both fast analytical queries and high-efficiency model training.

  • Deploy and manage data pipelines in AWS EKS (Kubernetes) with persisten tEBS-backed storage.

What Success Looks Like

  • Live data streams are contextualised,queryable, and AI-ready.

  • Schema changes and signal drift are detected and handled without breaking downstream workflows.

  • Training and inference pipelines run smoothly in parallel, optimised for scale and latency.

raw.description:
Posting Type

Remote

Job Overview

About Relativity

Legal technology is having its moment, and Relativity is at the centre of it.

We are a leading legal data intelligence company. Our extensible, AI cloud platform, RelativityOne, is trusted by the world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies to turn complex data into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, arbitration, and other high-stakes legal matters.

In Asia, the momentum speaks for itself: RelativityOne adoption jumped 46% year-over-year, a sign that organisations have moved beyond experimentation and are now applying AI in production environments to modernise how legal work gets done at scale.

To meet this moment, we’re expanding our Singapore team and on-the-ground presence. This is an opportunity to be part of an exciting growth story. We are looking for mid-level professionals across sales, technical solutions, customer success, and marketing to support our continued expansion. You’ll have the backing of an established industry leader and the opportunity to help grow our customer base across Asia.

If you’re ready to help write the next chapter of legal AI in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description and Requirements

The Role

As a Sales Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting Relativity’s sales activities across the Asia-Pacific region. You will be responsible for providing clients and prospects with exceptional Relativity experience via workflow assistance and acting as a solution evangelist. Based in Singapore, this role will contribute to the success and growth of the APAC Sales Engineering team and Relativity as a whole. You will take the lead on sales support requests, provide mentorship to less senior members of the team, and support team process growth.


Your role in action

  • Play a key role in Relativity’s efforts to acquire and grow accounts through virtual and in-person technical sales consulting – Serve as a subject matter expert and consultant for internal and external stakeholders. Participate in sales calls and meetings with account executives and prospects. Assist with, and/or lead, presentations and standard product demonstrations. Identify customer business needs and help define solutions to address them.
  • Support Relativity’s RFx and third-party risk assessment workflows – Capture prospect/customer requirements. Collaborate with sales to write sales proposals detailing how Relativity’s solutions will address business needs.
  • Intake and communicate product feedback – Deliver feedback to the product management team based on prospect or customer feedback, product issues, field deployments, and generally observed market trends.
  • Serve as customer facing Relativity evangelist – Collaborate on necessary documentation, presentations, and build product demonstrations to teach clients about Relativity functionality and the value proposition. Attend and present at industry events in support of product expertise. Author content surrounding industry trends and best practices, contributing to Relativity’s thought leadership in Legal Data Intelligence (LDI).
  • Demonstrate, develop and maintain subject matter expertise in product and industry – Develop expert knowledge of RelativityOne by consulting internally with teams and other resources, individual study, and future product enhancements and added features. Achieve Relativity Expert status and obtain other associated Relativity Certifications. Develop expertise in Legal Data Intelligence (LDI) use cases, such as Data Breach Response, and in the Relativity AI Suite. Bring a genuine drive to champion GenAI adoption with clients and prospects, helping them see and realise its value in their workflows.
  • Understand sales process as it relates to Relativity’s overall strategies and objectives – Learn and understand the Relativity sales strategy, conducting effective discovery to understand pain points, and proactively address customer inquiries.

Your skills

  • Experience supporting Legal Data Intelligence (LDI) use cases (e.g., litigation, investigations, regulatory matters, DSAR) across the entire review lifecycle, including a technical understanding of Relativity
  • Strong sales orientation and a positive, service-oriented personality
  • Knowledge of Generative AI and its application to legal document review, with genuine enthusiasm for evangelizing GenAI adoption to clients and prospects
  • Five years of experience supporting SaaS applications, including four or more years in sales engineering, client services, or consulting
  • Relativity Certified Administrator (RCA) strongly preferred, otherwise ability to pass the exam within 3 months of employment
  • Relativity Expert status preferred, otherwise ability to obtain Relativity Expert within 12 months of employment
  • Relativity Master status is a plus, with the ability to obtain within 24 months of employment
  • Proven technology skills, outstanding interpersonal abilities, and strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Attention to detail, plus analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, including international travel
  • Ability to multitask and self-manage workload
  • Fluency in English required; additional regional language proficiency (e.g., Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia/Malaysia) is a plus
  • Experience working within the Singapore and/or broader APAC legal or legal technology markets preferred

Suggested Skills:

Account Management, Business Development, Consultative Selling, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Customer Relationships, Product Demonstrations, Relationship Management, Sales, Sales Engineering, Technical Sales

Category: Medical Device

Location:


We are seeking an experiencedContract Administratorto support contract development, review, and negotiation activities for a leading organization in themedical device and life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience preparing and managing various contract typesparticularlyclinical study agreements, vendor contracts, and service agreementswithin a fast-paced, global, and regulated environment. This position requires strong attention to detail, understanding of legal and business terms, and the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, includingLegal, Clinical, Regulatory, Risk Management, and Global Operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a high volume ofclinical study agreements and related legal documents, using approved templates and established contracting practices.
  • Manage the end-to-end contracting process, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external vendors to ensure timely execution.
  • Evaluate proposed contract redlines from clinical sites and vendors; revise terms in accordance with company standards and applicable regulations.
  • Collaborate withLegal, Risk Management, Clinical, and Regulatoryteams to identify and resolve contract issues efficiently.
  • Track and prioritize multiple contract requests in ahigh-volume, deadline-driven environment.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records in thecontract management systemandMicrosoft Teamsfolders.
  • Oversee the proper execution, filing, and archiving of all agreements and related documentation.
  • Monitor active study agreements and maintain contract status spreadsheets or dashboards.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and compliance in the contracting process.
  • Provide administrative support for team meetings, including scheduling, minute-taking, and follow-up tracking.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degreeandprofessional experiencein contract administration, legal operations, or clinical contracting within amedical device, pharmaceutical, or biotechenvironment; OR
  • Strong understanding ofclinical contracting terms, conditions, and negotiation principles(non-negotiable).
  • Demonstrated ability to review and redline contracts, applying a practical, business-oriented approach to risk and compliance.
  • Excellent organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple contracts and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proficiency inMicrosoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)andAdobe Acrobat, with advanced Word and Excel skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and professionalism in dealing with global stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in amedical device or life sciences organization(strongly preferred).
  • Familiarity withcontract lifecycle management (CLM) systemsand document management tools.
  • Experience coordinating betweenLegal, Clinical Operations, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs).
  • Proven ability to work independently in a high-volume, fast-paced, and compliance-driven environment.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to identify opportunities forprocess optimizationand standardization.
This is intended for inclusion in Pharmavise’s talent database to build a qualified pool of professionals for future medical device client requisitions.

raw.description:
Assistant Professors are full-time employed faculty who provide a variety of educational services to degree, certificate, and non-degree learners. Assistant Professors are responsible for meeting the expectations and requirements of Capella University while establishing and maintaining effective relationships with learners, colleagues, staff, and administration. Assistant Professors are able to perform well in all key accountabilities of the role, are nimble and flexible and expected to be able and willing to take on essential roles and other duties as needed, within the department, school or university. Assistant Professors ensure that learners receive quality educational experiences consistent with stated course outcomes as well as HLC and any program accreditation standards. They provide high-quality, impactful, and inclusive experiences that deliver exceptional learning outcomes. Capella values the scholarly-practitioner model and expects Assistant Professors to continue learning and development through participation in scholarly activities or professional practice in the discipline. Among the responsibilities that Assistant Professors are expected to perform include: teaching (online), mentor and committee work (graduate level only), and contributing to curriculum development. Assistant Professors also participate in school governance through faculty committees and may participate in a variety of other activities based upon the university’s needs and the faculty member’s unique skill set.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Teaching and Instruction – Assistant Professors are highly engaged instructors in the courses and residencies they teach. They are sought out by learners and consistently exceed set expectations for faculty who teach courses at Capella. Assistant Professors use course data to constantly improve their individual teaching performance and contribute regularly to the improvement and refinement of the courses they teach. Regularly reviews course feedback and implements change to continually strengthen performance and enhance learner experience.
  • Doctoral Mentoring – Assistant Professors are highly knowledgeable about established dissertation and doctoral capstone processes and resources. They interact effectively with learners, develop strong relationships and offer guidance. They have demonstrated success in chairing and serving on doctoral committees. Assistant Professors facilitate highly interactive dissertation and capstone courserooms and their learners are supported to timely completion of the dissertation or capstone product.
  • Curriculum and Course Development – Assistant Professors are knowledgeable in the Capella course development process and have demonstrated the ability to work successfully with cross functional partners across Capella to plan and deliver high-quality course and curriculum in the area of their expertise. Participates in the design development and continuous improvement of courses and course materials including course plans, objectives, and outcomes, teaching aids, competency-based assessments, and authentic assessment tools. Ensure sensitivity diversity and inclusiveness in curriculum design, course content, and study materials as needed.
  • School and University Governance – Assistant Professors regularly demonstrate leadership roles in school and university governance. They willingly assume school and university committee roles as active participants and are effective in driving the positive impact of these governance structures. They are the role models and leaders among faculty and serve as peer mentors.
  • Professional Service and Practice – Assistant Professors are active in contributing their professional knowledge and skills to the needs of their local communities and within their professional network affiliations. They carry the “Capella Brand” and mission to their local regions and communities. Research and Scholarship – Assistant Professors stay current in their scholarly field(s) and demonstrate expertise through writing, speaking and conference attendance.
  • Leadership through Team Engagement – Assistant Professors are expected to take on essential roles and other duties as needed, within the department, school or university. Bringing their unique skills and perspectives, Assistant Professors regularly contribute to departmental leadership whether it be through specific roles, active contribution of innovative ideas, or taking on challenging tasks. All full-time faculty are depended on, and relied upon, for immediate and unplanned needs and must be nimble and adjust to changes as they occur. These roles may include specialized assignments such as faculty and cross functional staff meetings, commencement, residencies, Capella-sponsored faculty development, problem resolution, faculty orientation/mentoring, webinar facilitation, course revisions, etc.
  • Additionally, some Assistant Professors may have certain “areas of emphasis” where a greater degree of leadership is expected and include such as specialized responsibilities or coordinating functions in support of the school’s educational goals such as Learner Management, Research and Advising, Program Development and Advising, Field Education, Accreditation or support of B2B partnership efforts. Responsibility areas and specific assignments are based on the needs of the school and capabilities of the faculty member. Faculty assignments and areas of emphasis may vary significantly from school to school; however, the position is structured to ensure the faculty member is able to contribute optimally to essential teaching and related support services to learners.

Job Skills:


Teaching and Assessment and/or Doctoral Mentoring:

Refers to the ability to enable learner academic progression, provide guidance, and enhance learner experience.

  • Understand and apply Capella’s competency-based education model that aligns program outcomes, competencies, assessments, and reports with external standards and Capella educational philosophy to improve learning.
  • Convey and share content knowledge and relevant professional experience in the discipline.
  • Facilitate learner acquisition of course and/or research competencies aligned with their program.
  • Consider learner differences and appreciate the diversity of experience and interpretation among students.
  • Effectively assess and document learner knowledge, skills, and dispositions through formative and summative feedback.
  • Monitor learner progress and achievement and refers students to additional resources as needed.
  • Display cultural awareness and sensitivity to learner differences and seek information about strengths, needs, and interests of the learner to provide personalized support.
  • Engage students in effective, timely, and relevant interactions and nurtures a learning community that cultivates a spirit of trust, interaction, and learning.
  • Effectively manage key online course and/or advanced doctoral processes and tools.
  • Provide a timely, visible, consistent, and responsive presence in the courseroom and/or mentoring process, and communicate appropriately and respectfully.
  • Encourage learner engagement consistent with the learner code of conduct and support the free exchange of ideas.

Research and Scholarship:

These activities advance teaching and mentoring as well as professional development. Activity varies by person and field. Meeting research and scholarship requirements as defined by external accreditors, where appropriate. Schools may identify focus areas of research, specific conferences, or professional journals.

  • Scholarship for applying innovative teaching methods, especially those that can be empirically validated as having a positive impact on learner success (e.g., course success, continuation, graduation).
  • Submit proposals and/or present at workshops or conferences (internally and externally).
  • Showcase original/innovative work/exhibition.
  • Maintain an active research agenda.
  • Attend professional development events, attain continuing education credits, and pursue additional credentials.
  • Present research (whether applied or teaching-focused).
  • Submit paper and/or publish at industry-recognized channels.

Professional Service and Practice:

Includes external-facing activities related to students, institution, profession, and/or community. Activities increase the service of the institution and strengthen its external reputation. Meeting professional service and practice requirements as defined by external accreditors, where appropriate. In most situations, the activities are with reduced fee/pro bono/honorarium.

  • To students: Career and well-being advising, leading student organizations, guidance on learning and projects outside of courseroom, learner-facing webinars.
  • To institution: Providing support for institutional activities with external audience (e.g., presentations for employer partners, job fairs, representing the institution at conferences).
  • To profession: Leadership in organizations or professional associations, advocacy for the advancement of the profession and communities served, organize professional conferences.
  • To community: Sharing knowledge with the public, volunteer for community-based events with their expertise (e.g., volunteering at clinics for underprivileged communities).

Governance and Leadership:

Include internal-facing activities to increase the effectiveness of the institution, the school, and faculty practice.

  • Active participation in appropriate program, department, school, or university committees, providing expertise and perspectives to advance university and school’s strategic direction.
  • Active participation in faculty staff meetings, Capella-sponsored faculty development, and other faculty-focused events (e.g. CU Faculty Virtual Conference), including sharing best practices, providing personal expertise via different communication channels, promoting better community support among peers, etc.
  • Serve as SMEs in course and program development; support for accreditation efforts; and serve in pilot groups for innovation projects at program, school, or university levels.
  • Identify and orchestrate the proactive management of curriculum content quality and currency. Demonstrate expertise in evaluating and coordinating the ongoing assessment of content to ensure its relevance, accuracy, and up-to-date nature.
  • Take on additional, challenging projects to serve the needs of the school or university in support of student success.
  • Provide mentorship, feedback, and guidance to other faculty members when appropriate.

Performance Criteria:

Satisfactory performance of teaching and/or mentoring activities based on the university faculty expectations is required and will be reviewed as part of the annual plan of work and review process.


Work Experience:


  • Expertise in biostatistics, epidemiology, policy analysis, or program evaluation is required.
  • Experience with how to conduct and oversee public health research is required.
  • Two or more years teaching is required. Teaching in an online setting is preferred.
  • A strong background in qualitative research methods, GIS mapping, financial management, or project management is a plus.
  • Teaching experience in higher education is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring doctoral students is preferred.
  • Experience writing curriculum is preferred.
  • Knowledge of CEPH accreditation standards and CEPH curriculum development experience is preferred.
  • Membership/affiliation in an educational leadership organization on a national, regional, and/or local level.
  • Demonstrated commitment to service and practice in the field of educational leadership.
  • Experience with leadership through team engagement.
  • Evidence of supporting learner success and a commitment to quality teaching outcomes.
  • Ability to contribute through teaching and/or service to the diversity, cultural sensitivity, and excellence of the academic community.
  • Experience presenting at professional conferences on a national and/or local level.
  • Experience with scholarly writing and use of APA 7th edition.


Education:

  • A doctoral degree in public health is required.
  • All degrees must be conferred and from a regionally accredited institution. Copies of required certificates and licenses and unofficial transcripts for all graduate degrees with the institution and conferred degree and date must be attached.

Other:


  • Must be able to travel occasionally should a business need arise. For most roles travel would not be common. Travel may involve plane, car or metro. In accordance with ADA policies, reasonable accommodations regarding travel limitations can be provided. Travel will be more common for roles such as Account Executives (25 - 50%), senior leaders (10 – 20%) or all levels of Capella Faculty (5 – 10%).
  • Ability to work onsite in Corporate or Campus location (in a typical office environment) may be required based on role. If so, this would include being mobile within the office, including movement from floor-to-floor using elevators or stairs.
  • If offsite or hybrid role, must have access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • Faculty and Federal Work Study roles require access to work in setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role role (including computer, privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at a remote location.
  • This role may require lifting, however reasonable accommodations will be provided in accordance with our ADA policies.
  • Must be able to meet critical thinking and problem-solving aspects aligned to job duties, as well as effectively communicating with co-workers.
  • Must be able to work more than 40 hours per week when business needs warrant. Accommodations related to schedule may be considered.Able to access information using a computer.
  • Other essential functions and marginal job functions are subject to modification.

Work Location Details:

Many of our positions, including this role, are designed to be remote "home office" settings.

Employees working out of a home office are responsible for providing appropriate and safe office space, office furniture and organization, communication tools, and related items. These include:

  • Arranging for high speed internet connection, printer and a dedicated phone line for business use. Specifics regarding expense coverage and reimbursement vary based on individual position categories. The University will not provide office equipment or on-site set up assistance.
  • The environment must be free from distractions and enable a highly productive and professional work environment.
  • As with on-site positions, our off-site positions require that the majority of the time will be spent using a telephone, PC and monitors.
  • There are minimal lifting requirements unless otherwise noted.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


$84,000-$87,000 is the expected starting pay for this position. This offer is based on current budgetary guidelines and the additional factors outlined below.

SEI offers a comprehensive package of benefits to employees scheduled 30 hours or more per week. In addition to medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans, SEI employees may take advantage of well-being incentives, parental leave, paid time off, certain paid holidays, tax saving accounts (FSA, HSA), 401(k) retirement benefit, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, tuition assistance as well as entertainment and retail discounts. Non-exempt employees are eligible for overtime pay, if applicable.

Careers - Our Benefits, Strategic Education, Inc

SEI is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture where individuals can grow their careers and contribute fully. We strive to attract talent with broad experiences, skills and perspectives. We welcome applications from all. While it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the pay range at SEI, we offer a competitive salary. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate may vary depending on multiple factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal pay equity. Our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to discuss your interest in joining SEI. The expected salary range for this position is below.

$75,800.00 - $113,700.00 - Salary

raw.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role:

The Senior Data Strategy Analyst supports the development and execution of media reporting and measurement initiatives across client accounts. Reporting to the Manager, Data Strategy, this role is responsible for analyzing marketing performance data, developing insight-driven reporting deliverables, and contributing to measurement frameworks that align with client business objectives.

This position requires a strong understanding of cross-channel media performance (digital and traditional), a developing advanced analytical capability, strategic mindset, and the ability to independently manage reporting workstreams while collaborating effectively across internal teams.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and deliver recurring and ad hoc reporting with accuracy, clarity, and alignment to client KPIs.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights and optimization recommendations.
  • Support the development and refinement of measurement frameworks.
  • Partner with Strategy, Media, Client Services, Data Engineering, and Data Science teams to ensure data integrity and actionable reporting outputs.
  • Contribute to Tableau dashboard builds and reporting automation initiatives.
  • Assist in integrating advanced analytics outputs (e.g., attribution, incrementality, MMM) into client reporting.
  • Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities within campaign data.
  • Ensure timely delivery of reporting outputs and proactively communicate risks or blockers.

About you:

    • 2–3 years of experience in marketing or media analytics, including experience analyzing pharmaceutical marketing campaigns.

    • Strong understanding of digital and traditional media performance metrics.

    • Proficiency in Google Analytics and Tableau.

    • Familiarity with pharmaceutical marketing measurement tools, such as Crossix, and the ability to interpret their outputs for client reporting and recommendations.

    • Working knowledge of tagging systems and campaign performance datasets.

    • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint (or Google equivalents).

    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

    • Ability to translate complex data into insights for non-technical audiences.

    • Organized and able to manage multiple deliverables across timelines.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Bilingual Dental Patient Coordinator

Location: Remote - Nicaragua
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Dental Services / Healthcare Administration
Compensation:$1,280 USD per month
Language Requirements: Fluent English (C1+) and Spanish

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based dental practice committed to providing patients with a professional, welcoming, and well-organized healthcare experience.

The practice relies on effective communication, accurate scheduling, insurance coordination, and dependable administrative support to ensure patients receive timely assistance throughout their dental care journey.

The team is looking for a remote professional who can help streamline daily front-office operations while maintaining a high standard of patient service.

About the Role

We are hiring a Bilingual Dental Patient Coordinator to provide remote front-office and administrative support for a busy dental practice in the United States.

In this position, you will serve as an important point of contact for patients, assisting with appointments, insurance-related inquiries, patient records, and daily administrative requests.

You will communicate with patients in English and Spanish, coordinate with the dental team, and help ensure that appointments, documentation, and patient requests are handled accurately and efficiently.

This role is well suited for someone with experience in U.S. dental or healthcare administration who enjoys patient interaction, works well under pressure, and can independently manage multiple priorities.

What You'll Do

Patient Relations & Communication

  • Serve as a primary contact for patients through phone calls, email, and text messaging.

  • Manage incoming inquiries and conduct outbound calls when follow-up is needed.

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with English- and Spanish-speaking patients.

  • Provide appointment reminders and follow up regarding scheduled treatments.

  • Address routine questions and help patients navigate administrative processes.

  • Support a positive patient experience through responsive and empathetic communication.

Dental Appointment Management

  • Coordinate patient appointments, including new bookings, confirmations, cancellations, and rescheduling.

  • Maintain accurate provider calendars and appointment information.

  • Assist with scheduling adjustments to support efficient clinic operations.

  • Communicate scheduling updates to patients and the dental team.

  • Help reduce administrative delays through timely reminders and follow-up.

Dental Insurance & Payment Coordination

  • Review and verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Gather coverage information and confirm relevant insurance details before visits.

  • Assist with dental billing activities and payment posting.

  • Support insurance claims follow-up and related documentation.

  • Help patients understand routine insurance and payment information.

  • Escalate complex insurance or billing questions to the appropriate team members.

Patient Records & Office Administration

  • Assist with patient registration, intake information, and demographic updates.

  • Enter and update information in dental practice management systems.

  • Maintain organized and accurate electronic patient records.

  • Complete administrative tasks, data entry, and routine reporting.

  • Coordinate with internal staff to ensure patient requests are properly addressed.

  • Handle sensitive patient information in accordance with HIPAA requirements.

Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher).

  • At least 1–2 years of relevant experience in U.S. dental administration, healthcare administration, dental reception, medical scheduling, or insurance coordination.

  • Familiarity with dental office procedures and patient-facing administrative workflows.

  • Experience supporting appointment scheduling and insurance verification.

  • Knowledge of dental practice management software, such as Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or comparable platforms.

  • Strong telephone communication and patient service skills.

  • Ability to handle several administrative responsibilities while maintaining accuracy.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA-compliant information handling.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with a remote team.

Preferred

  • Clear, professional spoken English with a neutral accent.

  • Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based dental office remotely.

  • Experience with insurance claims follow-up, payment posting, and patient billing inquiries.

  • Familiarity with patient engagement and treatment follow-up processes.

What Makes a Strong Candidate?

We are particularly interested in professionals who demonstrate:

  • Patient-centered communication: You can make patients feel heard, respected, and supported.

  • Administrative accuracy: You pay close attention to scheduling details, insurance information, and patient records.

  • Ownership: You follow through on pending requests without constant supervision.

  • Adaptability: You can shift between phone calls, scheduling, insurance questions, and documentation.

  • Problem-solving: You identify issues early and take appropriate action.

  • Team collaboration: You communicate effectively with dental professionals and administrative staff.

How Success Is Measured

  • Patient calls, messages, and inquiries receive timely responses.

  • Appointment calendars are maintained accurately and efficiently.

  • Insurance information is verified and documented correctly.

  • Billing and claims-related administrative tasks are completed with appropriate follow-up.
