raw.description:
Description

Muse Group's products — spanning learning, playing, creating, publishing, and buying music — reach over 100 million musicians, creators, teachers, and music lovers worldwide. Today these are strong but standalone products. Our next chapter is to turn them into one connected ecosystem, where a person moves naturally between learning, playing, practicing, creating and where each product makes the others stronger. The goal is simple: the portfolio should be worth more to the user together than each product on its own.

We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to lead that chapter. This is a mandate to build, not to maintain. Few places in the industry combine this much audience, this much love for the products, and this much still-unwritten product architecture on top of them. You get a rare mix: a ready audience of 100M+, deep content libraries, one of the strongest organic platforms in music, and a clean sheet to assemble it into a connected product. We are starting AI almost from zero, not optimizing an existing layer, so what AI-native means for Muse is yours to define. And all of it is about music and musicians, not product management as an end in itself.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in Europe or Cyprus.

Key responsibilities

Group product strategy. Where the portfolio goes; where products stay independent, where they share capabilities, where connecting them creates new value. From priorities to a coherent roadmap, investment model, and product architecture.

One ecosystem for musicians. The connective layer — shared identity, personalization, content portability, cross-product discovery, shared libraries. You make the transitions between products natural and mutually reinforcing.

A North Star for each product — and for the group. For every product, one measure of the real value it creates for the user. And as products connect, a single North Star for the whole ecosystem. This is the compass teams steer by.

The customer lifecycle. You own the whole arc — from first touch to lasting habit: how people arrive, activate, come back, get more value, and stay. We judge product success by that, not by short-term conversion. Monetization strengthens the user relationship instead of working against it.

AI-native product. Define what AI changes in learning, practice, creation, search, and discovery, and build a focused portfolio of AI initiatives with real user value — a product, not a set of demos.

The team and its leaders. Build an exceptional global product organization and grow strong product leaders under each product, so the team is durable, not dependent on one person.

Requirements

An established product leader who has worked at portfolio or ecosystem level, not a single product, and who combines strategic range with closeness to users, data, and product quality.

  • Led consumer products, platforms, or digital ecosystems at significant scale.
  • A demonstrated record of growing retention, engagement, and user value.
  • Systems thinking — can assemble an architecture across products, users, and data.
  • Grew strong product leaders instead of keeping decisions to themselves.

What matters to us:

We are looking for someone who thinks in outcomes for the user and the business, not roadmap length; who can protect a product's long-term value from the pull of short-term monetization; who builds a team instead of carrying it alone. The opposite stops us: success measured by feature velocity, treating AI as a tool rollout, and an inability to work without a fully prescribed process.

raw.excerpt: About PantheonPantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft and Doctors Without Borders.
raw.description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon’s multitenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. Organizations including Clorox and the United Nations drive results through accelerated development and real-time publishing using Pantheon’s collaborative workflows.

The Role

Pantheon is looking for a Senior Designer to help shape how our brand shows up across the world.

As a key member of the Brand and Creative team, you will turn strategy into clear, distinctive, and compelling creative work across campaigns, events, executive communications, product storytelling, digital experiences, sales enablement, and internal communications. You will help make Pantheon recognisable, relevant, and memorable for the developers, marketers, IT leaders, agencies, and organisations we serve.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who can move comfortably between big-picture thinking and precise execution. You will bring strong visual judgement, thoughtful craft, and an understanding of how design supports brand perception, audience engagement, and business goals. You will work closely with Brand, Marketing, Events, Product Marketing, Digital, Sales, and executive stakeholders to create work that is both creatively ambitious and effective.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate brand strategy, campaign objectives, and audience insights into clear creative concepts and visual systems.
  • Develop high-quality design work across digital, print, social, presentations, events, executive communications, sales enablement, and internal channels.
  • Create and evolve campaign identities, art direction, layouts, illustrations, motion concepts, and supporting design assets.
  • Partner with copywriters, strategists, marketers, event leads, and subject-matter experts to develop integrated creative work from brief through delivery.
  • Help with the visual development of major brand moments, including global campaigns, product launches, customer stories, company events, and executive engagements.
  • Design experiences that work across audiences, formats, markets, and channels while maintaining a coherent Pantheon brand.
  • Bring fresh ideas, references, and perspectives to the team, while knowing when to build from established systems and guidelines.
  • Present concepts and creative recommendations clearly, explain the thinking behind your work, and incorporate feedback with confidence and care.
  • Manage multiple projects at different stages, balancing deadlines, quality, stakeholder needs, and available resources.
  • Collaborate with external agencies, freelancers, production partners, and vendors when additional support is needed.
  • Contribute to and improve Pantheon’s design systems, templates, asset libraries, workflows, and creative operations.
  • Help raise the quality and consistency of design across the organisation through constructive critique, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay curious about emerging design practices, tools, technologies, and responsible uses of AI in creative work.

How Success Is Measured

Your success will be evaluated through a balanced view of:

  • The quality, originality, and effectiveness of the creative work you deliver.
  • Consistent and thoughtful application of Pantheon’s brand across channels, markets, and experiences.
  • The ability to turn complex ideas, products, and business priorities into clear and compelling visual communication.
  • Strong partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and the ability to build alignment around creative decisions.
  • Reliable project ownership, prioritisation, communication, and delivery against agreed timelines.
  • Contribution to reusable systems, templates, processes, and assets that help the wider organisation work more effectively.
  • The impact of your work on audience engagement, campaign performance, event experiences, executive communication, and brand perception.
  • Contribution to a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing creative culture.

What You Bring

  • Significant experience as a designer in a brand, creative, marketing, agency, or in-house environment.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking, visual craft, typography, layout, art direction, and execution across multiple formats.
  • Experience developing creative work from initial brief and concept through production and final delivery.
  • The ability to simplify complex information and communicate it through compelling visual storytelling.
  • Strong understanding of brand systems and how to apply them consistently while continuing to evolve the creative expression.
  • Experience working across integrated campaigns, digital channels, presentations, events, and other brand touchpoints.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to explain design decisions to both creative and non-creative audiences.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the judgement to navigate differing perspectives, feedback, and competing priorities.
  • Excellent organisation, attention to detail, and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously.
  • Comfort working in a distributed, cross-functional, and fast-moving environment.
  • Experience with relevant design and collaboration tools, such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, presentation software, and digital asset-management platforms.
  • A pragmatic, curious, and solutions-oriented approach, with a high bar for quality and a willingness to get hands-on.

You’ll Stand Out If You Have

  • Experience designing for a B2B technology, SaaS, developer, infrastructure, WebOps, or open-source audience.
  • Experience creating brand systems or campaigns that work across global markets and different cultural contexts.
  • Experience with motion design, video, animation, illustration, 3D, or other complementary creative disciplines.
  • Experience designing for large-scale events, executive experiences, customer engagements, or physical environments.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders or executive communications teams.
  • Experience working with agencies, freelancers, production teams, and external creative partners.
  • Experience using AI-enabled creative tools thoughtfully, with appropriate attention to accuracy, originality, privacy, copyright, and brand integrity.
  • A strong interest in how technology, design, and the open web can help organisations do more meaningful work.

Growth at Pantheon

We want this role to build durable creative, strategic, and leadership skills—not just deliver individual projects.

You will have opportunities to deepen your craft, influence Pantheon’s creative direction, shape scalable design systems, lead significant brand moments, and build strong partnerships across the business. As you demonstrate impact and grow your scope, future opportunities may include leading larger creative programmes, mentoring designers, managing external creative partners, or progressing into creative direction and design leadership.

Progression is based on demonstrated capability, business needs, and sustained performance.

What We Offer

We offer an environment where talented people can do meaningful work with thoughtful, collaborative colleagues around the world.

Depending on location and employment arrangement, our regional offering may include:

  • Industry-competitive compensation and equity plan.
  • Flexible time off and regional paid holidays.
  • Comprehensive regional health and wellbeing benefits.
  • Paid parental leave and family-support benefits.
  • Access to equipment and workspace support where available.
  • Allowances and learning opportunities that support wellbeing and continued development.
  • Team-based and company-wide events and activities that inspire, educate, and connect us.

The base salary for this position is $129,000.00 – $161,200.00 annually for employees based in San Francisco and New York, $115,900.00 – $144,900.00 annually for all other U.S. locations, £61,600.00 – £77,000.00 for employees based in the UK, and €66,900.00 – €83,600.00 for employees based in Ireland. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including role scope, relevant experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and equity.

Pantheon is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law. Pantheon complies with federal and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability for any part of the interview process, please contact . Pursuant to local and federal regulations, Pantheon will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

After an offer is made and accepted, E-verify will be utilized to establish your identity and employment eligibility as required by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

With our solutions, we execute across the entire healthcare journey — from member experience to payment integrity, provider quality, and plan performance. With one of America’s largest cost, quality and utilization datasets, we create greater transparency, flexibility, and cost containment — empowering members and employers with the information they need to make smarter, more cost-effective decisions.

About This Opportunity: As a Business Development Representative – Employer Markets, you'll help build Valenz Health's future growth pipeline by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective customers across the employer and employee benefits market. Through targeted outbound outreach, market research, marketing campaigns, events, and referrals, you'll connect with self-funded employers, brokers, consultants, and other priority prospects to uncover business needs and generate new sales opportunities.

You'll play an important role in creating interest in Valenz solutions, conducting initial discovery, and connecting qualified prospects with the appropriate Sales leaders. Your ability to build relationships, navigate challenging prospecting environments, and turn early conversations into meaningful opportunities will help expand our market reach and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to advance healthcare through technology and expertise to optimize cost, quality, access, and utilization for all. The Lead Site Reliability Engineer will continuously collaborate with key stakeholders across the business to solve critical technical problems for Allergan Aesthetics. You will be a hands-on technical leader driving reliability, availability, and operational excellence for large-scale public-facing software. As part of the Cloud Platform team, you will own how we measure, protect, and improve production reliability — championing SRE practices, building resilience into our platform, and ensuring our services meet the availability and performance standards our customers expect. You will provide technical thought leadership, mentor engineers across the organization, and turn small ideas into high-fidelity technical game plans that achieve both reliability and business goals.

Reliability Engineering:

  • Define and champion SLO/SLI frameworks and error budget-based decision making to drive prioritization between reliability and feature work.
  • Own observability strategy across services — metrics, logs, traces, and alerting — ensuring signals are actionable and tied to user impact.
  • Lead capacity planning, load testing, and resilience/chaos testing for critical public-facing services.
  • Establish production readiness reviews and partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.
  • Identify and eliminate toil through automation, self-healing systems, and improved observability.
  • Gather and analyze metrics from operating systems and applications to drive performance tuning and fault finding.
  • Contribute reliability improvements to the platform through infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes configuration, working within Cloud Platform team standards.

Incident Management & Response:

  • Own and evolve the incident response process, including severity definitions, escalation paths, and postmortem practice.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and provide hands-on support during incidents with appropriate urgency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application issues, driving blameless root cause analysis and tracking corrective actions to completion.

Standards & Architecture:

  • Champion reliability, scalability, and security standards across AA Tech services and the AA Tech product platform.
  • Partner and inform strategic architecture decisions for new services and major platform changes for reliability risks (failure modes, redundancy, scaling limits, alerting) before launch as part of Cloud Platform design reviews.
  • Define and maintain reliability standards (e.g., SLO coverage, alerting, runbooks, backup and recovery requirements) and track how services meet them
  • Stay current with the latest trends in site/service reliability practices and tooling. Identify proven technologies and solutions for emerging challenges.

Technical Mentorship:

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to senior-level DevOps and Software Engineers utilizing proven design patterns and experience building large-scale public-facing software.
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the engineering organization.
  • Provide technical thought leadership to implement strategic architecture, systems, and projects on the roadmap.
  • Proven track record running SLO/error budget programs and incident management for large-scale production systems.
  • Deep experience with observability platforms (e.g., Datadog) and alert design.
  • Working proficiency with Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS; comfortable reading, reviewing, and contributing infrastructure code.
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and tooling.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience using or building agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, MCP-based integrations) to automate engineering or operational workflows, with appropriate guardrails and human oversight.

This includes helping to create a single source of truth (SSOT) data flow from API partner to client dashboards, conducting A/B testing, staging data for reporting dashboards, and developing ML/AI solutions for client needs.

Build our future together:


We're seeking an Associate Director to lead companion diagnostic (CDx) strategy and development, bridging translational science with diagnostic execution. This role owns companion diagnostic programs from early biomarker feasibility through clinical validation, regulatory submission, and launch — translating biological insights and clinical hypotheses into validated, fit-for-purpose assays that support drug development decisions. You'll work at the interface of biomarker science, clinical development, regulatory, and external IVD partners to ensure diagnostics keep pace with therapeutic milestones.


When & where:

  • Location: Remote, USA

Discover your role:

  • Translate emerging biomarker and mechanism-of-action data into diagnostic target product profiles, defining assay intent across platforms (Next Generation Sequencing, polymerase chain reaction, immunohistochemistry, immunoassays).
  • Partner with translational and clinical teams to design biomarker strategies for patient selection, stratification, and enrichment, including sample strategy and specimen logistics.
  • Lead analytical and clinical validation planning (accuracy, precision, sensitivity/specificity, limit of detection, reproducibility), linking assay performance to clinical safety and efficacy endpoints.
  • Set global CDx strategy for assigned programs, aligning diagnostic milestones with clinical and regulatory timelines.
  • Select and oversee In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) development partners; manage co-development scope, timelines, and quality expectations.
  • Support global regulatory strategy and submissions (Food and Drug Administration PMA/supplement, EU IVDR, PMDA) in collaboration with IVD Regulatory, including labeling alignment.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant standards (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CLSI, IVDR, GCP alignment).
  • Lead cross-functional working groups, translating scientific rationale into program plans and clear governance reporting.
  • Support design transfer, manufacturing readiness, and launch preparation with commercial and medical affairs.

This role requires:

  • PhD or advanced degree in molecular biology, pathology, biomedical engineering, or related translational/biomedical science field.
  • 8+ years in diagnostics or translational research, with 4+ years leading biomarker-driven CDx or IVD programs bridging bench discovery and clinical application.
  • Track record translating biomarker science into validated assays supporting drug approvals.
  • Working knowledge of global CDx regulatory pathways (FDA CDRH, EU IVDR, PMDA).
  • Ability to translate complex scientific and clinical data for cross-functional and executive audiences.
  • Experience managing external partners and multi-workstream programs under QMS/GxP-adjacent conditions.

The Principal Consultant Engineer – Government Cloud Managed Services is the senior technical leader for CDW’s Government multi-cloud Managed Services practice, supporting Federal, State and Local Government, and Education customers, as well as commercial customers serving federal agencies, across AWS GovCloud (US), Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, and Google Cloud.

This role sets the architecture standards, automation strategy, and compliance-aligned operating model for regulated customer environments, serves as the top technical escalation point for the practice, and acts as the technical lead for pre-sales engagements.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in at least one government cloud platform with working knowledge of another, a strong Infrastructure as Code and automation background, hands-on experience applying Government security frameworks, and the ability to mentor and grow a team of engineers.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the technical lead and escalation point for Government Cloud Managed Services across Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud (US), and Google Cloud.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, secure landing zone standards, and operational patterns for regulated Government customer environments.
  • Lead the design and delivery of Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), automation, and CI/CD pipelines that standardize customer onboarding, deployment, and day-to-day operations across clouds.
  • Translate Government compliance requirements, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CMMC, DISA STIGs, and CIS Benchmarks, into implementable controls, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in pre-sales technical engagements, including discovery, solution design, architecture input, effort estimation, scopes of work, proposals, and presentations.
  • Lead customer design workshops, architecture reviews, and operational readiness reviews for onboarding and transition into Managed Services.
  • Oversee complex implementations, migrations, upgrades, and modernization efforts through operational handoff and service onboarding.
  • Participate in on-call rotation, provide escalation support for critical incidents, and lead root cause analysis and preventative actions.
  • Follow and strengthen incident, change, problem, request, and knowledge management processes within the ITSM platform (ServiceNow).
  • Drive resiliency, capacity, performance, backup and disaster recovery, and cost optimization across customer environments.
  • Maintain trusted advisor relationships with Government customers and account teams, and communicate technical strategy, risks, and solution direction to customers and CDW leadership.
  • Mentor senior and consulting engineers, guiding solution design, engineering practices, and cross-training across cloud platforms.
  • Develop practice standards, runbooks, reusable templates, architecture documentation, and training materials for customers and internal teams.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Project Management, Security, Legal and Contracts, and cloud provider partners to develop and grow Government Cloud Managed Services offerings and identify growth opportunities.
  • Research emerging government cloud, security, and automation technologies and regulatory changes, including the evolving FedRAMP program, and present recommendations.

What We Expect of You

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering OR 14+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering.
  • Minimum 8+ years of IT engineering experience supporting one or more cloud, hybrid infrastructure, platform, automation, security, monitoring, database, network, systems, or service management solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience with large, cross-brand Managed Services projects.
  • Experience designing and operating cloud environments aligned with Government security frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CMMC, DISA STIGs, and CIS Benchmarks.
  • Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), scripting, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience aligning technical solutions to business outcomes and developing technical roadmaps, architecture documentation, project plans, and schedules for complex initiatives.
  • Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead critical escalations.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, including executive-level interaction, and the ability to build trusted customer relationships.
  • Ability to mentor and lead technical teams and manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.
  • Certain customer workloads (for example, those involving ITAR or CUI data) may require U.S. citizenship.
  • Experience supporting public sector (Federal, DoD, State and Local Government, or Education) cloud environments strongly preferred.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one government cloud platform (Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud (US), or Google Cloud Assured Workloads) and working knowledge of a second major cloud platform, strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting Azure GCC High or CMMC-regulated customers, a plus.
  • Professional-level certifications in two or more of Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, and published case studies, white papers, reference architectures, or technical thought leadership, a plus.

Pay range: $172,000 - $240,800 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Job Title: Project Manager

About Cybit

Predict. Protect. Perform

Cybit delivers data and AI‑led technology, to help organisations work more securely, productively, and with confidence across digital workspaces, cloud, security, and managed services. Our mission is to create positive business outcomes and support the people and communities our customers serve. We believe the right technology, delivered well, drives resilience, performance, and meaningful impact.

Why Join Us?

Be part of a dynamic, outcome‑focused, and people‑first team across Berkshire and Newcastle, where talent, ideas, and collaboration are genuinely valued. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact on how we deliver technology and how our brand is experienced, while building a meaningful career and helping to create a safer, more resilient future.

Guide to what a Project Manager does at Cybit

As a Project Manager you’ll join our PMO Team and be responsible for the successful planning, coordination and delivery of a wide range of customer projects across cloud, infrastructure, networking, security and managed services technologies.

You'll act as the central point of contact for customers and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the high standards our customers expect. We're looking for someone with excellent communication, organisational skills and a proactive approach to problem solving.

What are some of the key tasks a Project Manager is responsible for?

  • Managing the end-to-end delivery of customer projects from initiation through to completion.
  • Creating and maintaining project plans, timelines, risk logs and status reports.
  • Coordinating internal technical resources and third-party suppliers to ensure successful delivery.
  • Leading project kick-off meetings and regular progress reviews with customers.
  • Managing project budgets, schedules, scope and resource allocation.
  • Identifying, tracking and mitigating project risks and issues.
  • Ensuring clear communication between customers, technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Monitoring project progress and escalating concerns where required.
  • Supporting project governance and ensuring compliance with internal delivery processes.
  • Facilitating successful project handovers into operational support teams.
  • Maintaining accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Building strong relationships with customers and ensuring a positive delivery experience.
  • Supporting with Project related procurement where required.

We are looking for someone with

Essential

  • Experience managing end-to-end customer projects from initiation through to completion.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with customers, suppliers and internal teams.
  • Experience creating and managing project documentation, including project plans, status updates, risk logs and governance reports.
  • Proven ability to identify, manage and mitigate project risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead customer meetings and project reviews.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and resources effectively.
  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach to problem solving.
  • Experience managing project budgets, schedules, scope and delivery outcomes.
  • Experience working within an MSP, technology services or IT environment, ideally delivering infrastructure, cloud, networking, security or managed services projects.

Nive to Have

Project Management Qualifications:

  • PRINCE2 Foundation / Practitioner
  • APM Project Fundamentals Qualification (PFQ)
  • APM Project Management Qualification (PMQ)

Be well looked after

Happy people make happy businesses. We have a great range of flexible benefits which helps you to do your best work every day. This includes:

  • Enhanced Pension contribution scheme
  • 33 days annual leave including bank holidays (& the opportunity to buy more if desired)
  • Healthcare cash plan
  • Private Medical Insurance (upon passing probation)
  • Company electric car scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Occupational sick pay
  • Birthday day off
  • Enhanced family leave
  • Volunteering time available

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Product Manager leads the development and commercialization of future versions of on-market or new product lines including new features and service components. This person supports the vision and 5-year planning for our product roadmap to remain a premium brand with leading market share. This role combines strategic thinking with execution, and requires strong leadership in cross-functional teams. Responsible for the product lifecycle from concept to obsolescence. This includes creation of a strategic product roadmap, evaluation and prioritization of new features and programs, creation of product requirements, and evaluation and improvement of product performance.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop or co-develop and execute the product roadmap for one or more reproductive health tests.
  • Deliver product requirements based on customer needs and operational limitations.
  • Manage product performance and field all product support needs, working across departments, including Product Management, Molecular Biology R&D, Statistics R&D, Software Engineering, Sales & Marketing, Clinical/Medical, Operations, Regulatory, and Business Development.
  • Develop quantitative product performance indicators, analyze and track performance data, and identify strategies for improvement across teams.
  • Identify business opportunities and create business cases and financial models.
  • Conduct VOC interviews, market research, and competitive analysis as a means to test and validate product features, improve customer satisfaction and support market growth.
  • Support product marketing in the definition of product positioning – from market launch plans, pricing, and delivering key collateral content to marketing communications.
  • Create written, data-based arguments and presentations to achieve buy-in from stakeholders
  • Provide internal and external stakeholders with the appropriate updates on progress, vision, product roadmap, etc.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in physical or life science, statistics or engineering discipline. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience, which includes 2-3 years of product management, product/solution marketing, product commercialization, or strategic consulting experience.
  • Experience with Prenatal products/education, medical devices, or diagnostics preferred.
  • Expertise and experience in the Life Sciences industry preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to lead and motivate a cross-functional team
  • Ability to understand technology and articulate customer value/benefit propositions
  • Strong project/process management skills required.
  • Strong computer skills in office applications (e.g., MS Word, MS Excel) and presentation tools (e.g., MS PowerPoint) required.
  • Basic financial/economic modeling skills
  • Proven excellence in both written and oral communications skill
  • Proven organizational skills and extraordinary attention to detail, with ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Will consider scientific or technical project leads for candidates coming from research and development roles. Must have demonstrated applicable analytics, product development and/or project management skills and experience.
  • Must be able to collaborate and interact effectively with individuals, and influence individuals, across functional areas and in team environments.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

We believe in creating environments where your potential is recognized, your voice matters, and your success is tied to meaningful work—not short-term perks. Role Overview:

The Internal Talent Acquisition Partner is a full-cycle recruiting role responsible for driving hiring across Pearl Talent’s internal teams. This position operates at the intersection of execution and strategy, partnering closely with leadership to define hiring needs, build pipelines, and close top-tier candidates.

You will manage multiple searches simultaneously across functions such as Growth, Sales, Talent Acquisition, Client Success, and Operations. The role is highly execution-focused while also requiring strategic thinking to refine hiring processes and elevate talent quality.

This is a high-ownership role suited for candidates who thrive in fast-paced startup environments, enjoy solving complex hiring challenges, and can operate independently while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment.

Your Impact

In this role, you will directly influence how Pearl Talent scales by building high-performing internal teams. Your ability to consistently attract and close top talent will improve hiring velocity while maintaining a high bar for quality.

You will streamline recruiting processes, reduce hiring friction, and ensure strong alignment between hiring managers and candidate pipelines. By building scalable systems and maintaining strong candidate experiences, you will contribute to improved hiring outcomes, stronger team performance, and long-term organizational growth.

Areas of Responsibility:

Full-Cycle Recruitment – 40%

  • Own end-to-end hiring across internal functions including Growth, Sales, Talent Acquisition, Client Success, and Operations
  • Manage multiple open roles simultaneously while maintaining speed and candidate quality
  • Drive candidates through the pipeline from sourcing to offer stage with strong conversion rates

Sourcing & Pipeline Building – 25%

  • Proactively source high-quality candidates using LinkedIn and alternative sourcing channels
  • Build and maintain evergreen pipelines for recurring and critical roles
  • Experiment with new sourcing strategies to improve pipeline quality and speed

Hiring Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership – 15%

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, scorecards, and success criteria
  • Provide insights on talent markets, compensation benchmarks, and hiring strategies
  • Align stakeholders on candidate profiles and hiring expectations

Candidate Experience – 10%

  • Deliver a high-touch candidate experience from initial outreach through offer stage
  • Communicate clearly and consistently with candidates throughout the process
  • Represent and strengthen Pearl Talent’s employer brand

Process Optimization & Reporting – 10%

  • Improve recruiting workflows, systems, and interview processes
  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics such as pipeline health and time-to-fill
  • Build scalable hiring processes to support company growth

Requirements

Must-Haves (Required)

  • 2–5+ years of experience in recruitment (agency or in-house; startup experience preferred)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple open roles and consistently close hires
  • Experience hiring across business functions such as Sales, Operations, or Growth
  • Strong sourcing skills with the ability to identify, engage, and convert high-quality candidates
  • High ownership and accountability with a partner mindset toward hiring managers
  • Structured and analytical approach to candidate evaluation
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and ambiguous environments

Nice-to-Haves (Preferred)

Become a part of our caring community

The Specialty Operations Pharmacy Technician 2 supports Pharmacists in Specialty Rx medication preparation by dispensing Specialty Rx medications. The Specialty Operations Pharmacy Technician 2 performs varied activities and moderately complex administrative/operational/customer support assignments. Performs computations. Typically works on semi-routine assignments.

The Specialty Operations Pharmacy Technician 2 may contact physicians for prescriptions clarification and may enter prescription orders into the system. Also supports pharmacists and patients by ensuring adherence to Specialty Rx specific operational processes and programs developed to optimize health outcomes which include effective communication with patients and providers. Decisions typically focus on interpretation of area/department policy and methods for completing assignments. Works within defined parameters to identify work expectations and quality standards, but has some latitude over prioritization/timing, and works under minimal direction. Follows standard policies/practices that allow for some opportunity for interpretation/deviation and/or independent discretion.


Use your skills to make an impact

Candidates MUST reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, or Ohio.

Required Qualifications

  • Must have an active Pharmacy Technician license with the Board of Pharmacy in the state you reside
  • Must be certified by the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or National Healthcareer Association (NHA)
  • Experience as a Pharmacy Technician or Inbound and/or outbound phone experience
  • Ability to manage multiple or competing priorities, including use of multiple computer applications simultaneously
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including: Outlook, Word and Excel
  • Adaptable with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Strong data entry

Required Work Schedule:

Training:

  • Virtual training starts on day one of employment and will run for the first few weeks with a schedule of either 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM OR 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern, Monday - Friday.

Work Schedule Following Training:

  • Monday – Friday 9:00AM – 5:30PM EST.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare
  • Call center experience

**PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU ATTACH YOUR RESUME TO YOUR APPLICATION (PDF OR WORD FORMAT) ** 

Interview Process

As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we will be using technology called HireVue to enhance our hiring and decision-making ability. HireVue allows us to quickly connect and gain valuable information from you pertaining to your relevant skills and experience at a time that is best for your schedule. 

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

raw.description:
What success looks like in this role:

The Senior Director, Delivery Management is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic direction, operational performance, and commercial success of Digital Workplace Solutions delivery services for a large global restaurant enterprise. This position sits at the intersection of restaurant operations, IT service delivery, and client engagement, requiring a leader who understands how restaurants operate in real time and can translate that knowledge into scalable, high-performing support solutions.


The successful candidate will lead global service delivery teams, drive operational transformation, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders. This leader will be accountable for service quality, customer experience, financial performance, continuous improvement, and the successful delivery of innovative workplace support services across multiple regions.

Key Responsibilities

Global Service Delivery Leadership

  • Lead large-scale, multi-region Digital Workplace and Service Desk operations, ensuring consistent service quality, SLA attainment, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive delivery governance, service performance management, and operational discipline across geographically dispersed teams.
  • Establish and maintain scalable delivery models that support business growth while improving service reliability and efficiency.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for critical operational and customer issues.

Client & Executive Stakeholder Management

  • Build trusted relationships with customer executives and key stakeholders at the regional and global levels.
  • Lead executive business reviews, operational governance meetings, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Partner directly with client stakeholders to:
  • Review service performance, trends, and operational challenges.
  • Provide recommendations to improve support delivery and customer experience.
  • Align service strategies with business objectives and operational priorities.
  • Effectively manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical business-impacting issues.

Restaurant Operations & Technology Leadership

  • Act as the executive subject matter expert on restaurant operations within a service delivery environment.
  • Bridge the gap between restaurant operations teams and IT support organizations to ensure technology solutions align with real-world operational requirements.
  • Drive improvements across:
  • Front-of-house support operations
  • Point-of-sale (POS) support
  • Incident management
  • Service request fulfillment
  • Operational communications
  • Ensure support models effectively address peak-volume environments and time-sensitive customer interactions.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead transformation initiatives focused on AI, automation, analytics, standardization, and operational modernization.
  • Optimize service desk workflows including:
  • Call triage and prioritization
  • Escalation management
  • Resolution speed
  • Workforce productivity
  • Knowledge management
  • Establish metrics and performance frameworks that drive accountability, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement.
  • Champion a culture of innovation, operational excellence, and customer-centricity.

Financial & Commercial Leadership

  • Own delivery financial performance, including P&L accountability, margin optimization, cost-to-serve management, and productivity improvement.
  • Ensure contractual commitments, service obligations, and financial targets are achieved.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability through automation, process optimization, and operational efficiencies.
  • Support account growth opportunities through strong client relationships and delivery excellence.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing global delivery teams.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and results-driven culture.
  • Build leadership capability within the organization while promoting employee engagement and retention.
  • Drive accountability and performance management across all levels of the delivery organization.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be:

  • A strategic leader with strong operational discipline.
  • Comfortable operating in high-volume, fast-paced environments.
  • A trusted advisor capable of influencing senior executives and driving business outcomes.
  • Financially savvy with a focus on profitable growth and delivery excellence.
  • Customer-centric, analytical, and results-oriented.
  • Experienced in transforming services through automation, AI, and continuous improvement.
  • Equally comfortable engaging in boardroom discussions and operational problem-solving.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently exceeds service level, customer satisfaction, and operational performance targets.
  • Improves profitability through productivity, automation, and cost optimization.
  • Earns trusted-advisor status with client executives.
  • Creates a scalable, globally consistent delivery model.
  • Drives measurable improvements in customer experience, employee engagement, and operational efficiency.
  • Successfully transforms support operations into a modern, AI-enabled digital workplace service organization.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in one or more of the following:
  • Digital Workplace Services
  • IT Service Management
  • Managed Services
  • Restaurant Technology Operations
  • Service Desk Operations
  • 5+ years of experience leading large-scale global delivery organizations.
  • Strong understanding of restaurant operations, including:
  • Point-of-sale (POS) systems
  • Order flow management
  • Front-of-house operations
  • Peak-volume customer environments
  • Time-sensitive operational support
  • Demonstrated success managing executive-level client relationships in complex service delivery environments.
  • Proven experience leading operational transformation, service optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong financial management capabilities, including P&L ownership, margin management, and commercial accountability.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Quick Service Restaurant (QSR), fast casual, or hospitality environments.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale global clients and multinational delivery teams.
  • Strong background in Digital Workplace Services, End-User Computing, Workplace Support, or Field Services.
  • Knowledge of AI-enabled service delivery, automation platforms, and service analytics.
  • ITIL v4 certification or equivalent service management expertise.
  • Experience leading enterprise service desk transformation and operational modernization initiatives.
  • MBA or advanced business degree preferred.

Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a Customer Account Manager to lead the post-implementation customer relationship, recurring-revenue strategy and customer continuity for specialized carrier portfolios and larger, higher-revenue or more complex accounts.


Location: This remote work position will consider applicants that reside in the continental United States.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain operational and executive relationships appropriate to assigned portfolio complexity.
  • Develop multi-year account, renewal and network plans informed by customer health, utilization, contract position, competitive risk and financial exposure.
  • Lead complex, multi-service or multi-location renewals, RFP/RFQ responses and executive business reviews.
  • Develop and negotiate save, replacement, portability, migration, network-redesign, relocation, decommission and contract-restructuring strategies.
  • Manage material churn forecasts and mitigation plans; balance customer outcomes with pricing discipline, term, margin, capital recovery and long-term account value.
  • Coordinate complex decisions across Sales, Sales Engineering, Finance, Billing, Legal, Deal Management, Service Assurance, Service Delivery, Product and Operations.
  • Provide senior commercial judgment on credits, ETL, portability, contract exceptions, rate increases, renewal pricing and correct revenue treatment.
  • Mentor less-experienced CAMs and contribute to renewal playbooks, training, negotiation practices and operating standards.

Qualifications

  • Typically 6+ years of experience in Customer Retention, Strategic Account Management, Client Services, Sales or a comparable customer-facing role; senior assignments typically require 8+ years.
  • Significant digital / communications infrastructure experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, strategic or high-revenue customer relationships.
  • Advanced experience in renewals, retention, commercial negotiations, RFP/RFQ response and contract execution.
  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to evaluate customer, contractual, operational and financial tradeoffs.
  • Executive-level communication, presentation, negotiation and facilitation skills.
  • Experience in carrier, public-sector, K-12, E-Rate or other procurement-intensive environments preferred where relevant to assignment.

raw.title: Enterprise Implementation Consultant - WFM, Inventory, Back-Office
raw.excerpt: Fourth is the largest and fastest-growing end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology platform globally, supporting complex, multi-location operators with workforce management, inventory, and back-office solutions designed for scale.
raw.description:
Fourth is the largest and fastest-growing end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology platform globally, supporting complex, multi-location operators with workforce management, inventory, and back-office solutions designed for scale.

As we continue to expand our customer base and support increasingly complex deployments, we are seeking an experienced Implementation Consultant to lead Workforce Management and Back Office implementations from discovery through go-live. This is a customer-facing, delivery-focused individual contributor role within our Professional Services organization.

The Role

This position owns the successful implementation of Fourth’s Workforce Management and Back Office solutions across hospitality and retail environments.

You will partner with customers, Project Managers, and internal technical teams to translate operational requirements into clean system configuration, coordinated integrations, and successful go-live outcomes.

This role is focused on implementation execution. It does not include ongoing account management or post-go-live support ownership.

What You Will Do

  • Lead customer discovery sessions to understand operational workflows and system requirements

  • Configure Workforce Management and back-office systems aligned to documented best practices

  • Coordinate integrations with payroll, POS, ERP, and related systems

  • Support data validation, parallel testing, and user acceptance readiness

  • Partner with Project Managers to ensure delivery milestones are met within scope and timeline

  • Facilitate customer workshops and training sessions

  • Maintain accurate implementation documentation

  • Escalate scope, integration, or data risks appropriately

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions in a client-facing capacity

  • Experience configuring systems that impact labor, payroll, inventory, or operational workflows

  • Exposure to multi-location or enterprise customer environments

  • Familiarity with integration concepts and data validation processes

  • Experience leading customer discovery sessions and facilitating training or workshops

  • Ability to manage multiple implementations within defined scope and timelines

  • Strong communication and documentation skills

What Success Looks Like

  • Implementations delivered on time and within defined scope

  • Clean configuration and validated data prior to go-live

  • Clear communication and proactive risk management

  • Strong customer adoption at launch

  • Adherence to established delivery methodology

Work Environment

This role is remote-eligible within the United States for candidates residing in the following approved states:

AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MS, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, and WA.

Candidates must maintain a professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.

Travel may be required based on customer needs and implementation scope.

Benefits

Fourth offers:

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Parental Leave

  • Company-provided laptop and equipment

Why This Role

This role provides the opportunity to work in operationally complex environments that directly impact how hospitality and retail organizations manage labor, inventory, and compliance. Implementation Consultants in this role have clear configuration ownership, defined project scope boundaries, and structured delivery expectations.


Our Story

In July 2019, Fourth joined forces with HotSchedules to become the global leader in end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. Together, the merged company now represents the world’s largest and only provider of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management solutions for customers across the globe and of all sizes—from a single location or franchisee restaurant to a global restaurant or hotel chain. The combined company’s complete software-as-service (SaaS) solution suite, including scheduling, time & attendance, applicant tracking, training, inventory management/procurement, HR/benefits, and payroll services, now serves customers in 120,000 locations worldwide and is supported by a dedicated, unified team across offices in the US, UK, Bulgaria, China, Australia, and UAE.

Fourth is an Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without discrimination because of sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, age, national origin, military status, religion, or disability or any other legally protected status.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors while leading cross-functional teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You'll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients.

raw.description:
About Modern Campus

Modern Campus empowers institutions to move with confidence across the modern learner journey. Our platform spans web content management, curriculum and catalog management, student engagement and lifelong learning — giving more than 1,700 colleges and universities the infrastructure they need to support the entire learner-to-earner lifecycle and deliver personalized, scalable experiences.

We partner with the education community to create new pathways for learning and opportunity, reimagining how institutions serve the modern learner and shape the future of education.

Our purpose — our north star — is to empower institutions to confidently serve and support the modern learner.

This mission and purpose come to life through how we show up every day:

  • We exist to create empowerment through education.
  • We lead with honesty and empathy.
  • We shape the future through innovation.
  • We become trusted partners.
  • We make the complex feel possible.

Position Summary

Modern Campus is seeking a visionary and execution-oriented Vice President, Product Innovation to identify, validate, build, and scale new product opportunities while transforming how we develop products through AI-enabled and agentic practices.

This leader will serve as the company's innovation catalyst, balancing customer discovery, strategic product incubation, and organizational transformation. The Vice President, Product Innovation will lead the creation of new offerings that expand our portfolio while establishing scalable, AI-native product development capabilities that accelerate speed, quality, and customer value across the organization.

The role partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to drive growth through both new products and new ways of building products.

What You'll Do

Product Innovation & New Venture Development

  • Identify, validate, and launch innovative software products that address emerging challenges and opportunities in higher education.
  • Lead customer discovery, market research, and rapid experimentation to assess new market opportunities.
  • Build and test MVPs, prototypes, and pilot programs to validate customer demand and commercial viability.
  • Define business models, pricing strategies, and go-to-market approaches for new offerings.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to successfully transition validated concepts into scalable businesses.
  • Develop and manage an innovation portfolio that balances incremental improvements with transformative growth opportunities.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and innovation across the product organization.

AI-Enabled Product Development Leadership

  • Define and champion Modern Campus's vision for AI-enabled and agentic product development.
  • Establish best practices for leveraging AI across the product lifecycle, including customer research, discovery, requirements gathering, prototyping, documentation, testing, experimentation, and product operations.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve how product teams operate and deliver value.
  • Develop repeatable frameworks, playbooks, governance models, and adoption strategies for responsible AI implementation.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders to embed AI-native practices into day-to-day product development workflows.
  • Measure and continuously improve the impact of AI-enabled practices on customer outcomes, delivery speed, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Promote a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and responsible AI adoption across the company.

Executive Leadership & Collaboration

  • Influence company strategy through innovation insights, customer feedback, and emerging market opportunities.
  • Communicate vision, strategy, business cases, and outcomes effectively to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Build alignment across departments to accelerate innovation initiatives and organizational transformation.
  • Serve as a thought leader on AI, product innovation, and emerging technology trends.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading software products from concept through customer validation, commercial launch, and post-launch scaling.
  • Experience building and managing innovation portfolios, product incubators, or venture-style product development initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success delivering revenue-generating software products, including business model development, pricing strategy, and go-to-market execution.
  • Deep understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and their application to software product development.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate product development and decision-making.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills with the ability to influence strategy and organizational change.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving environments.
  • 10+ years of progressive product leadership experience within a software organization.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, major product launches, and strategic initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced business degree.
  • Experience in higher education, education technology, SaaS, or other complex B2B software markets.
  • Experience scaling AI-enabled product organizations.
  • Track record of launching net-new businesses, platforms, or product categories.

Success in This Role

Within the first 12–24 months, successful outcomes may include:

  • Launching three or more new product experiments into market.
  • Creating a repeatable and measurable innovation pipeline from idea to commercialization.
  • Generating meaningful new revenue streams from newly launched offerings.
  • Increasing product team effectiveness through AI-enabled workflows and agentic development practices.
  • Improving speed-to-market and customer value realization across the product portfolio.
  • Establishing Modern Campus as a leader in AI-enabled product innovation within higher education technology.

Why Join Modern Campus?

At Modern Campus, we're transforming how higher education institutions engage learners throughout the entire student lifecycle. We believe innovation happens when talented people are empowered to experiment, challenge assumptions, and create solutions that make a meaningful impact.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape both what we build and how we build it, driving the future of product innovation and AI-enabled development across the organization.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Modern Campus, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace strengthens relevance, resilience, and long-term success. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and identities to apply.

Modern Campus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. If you require accommodation during any stage of the interview process, please let our recruiting team know.

* Our salary ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hires for the position within the US and Canada. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

raw.description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.

Staff Product Manager, Data

Built is the AI-first platform for construction and real estate finance, managing over $300 billion in annual capital for more than 340 lenders, including 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks. Every draw, inspection, budget change and payment that moves through Built leaves behind data our customers need to manage risk and run their portfolios. Turning that data into products lenders rely on every day is one of the biggest opportunities in front of us.

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager, Data to own the data capabilities and reporting tools that sit on top of the Built platform: embedded reporting and analytics, portfolio insights, data delivery into customer systems, and the data foundation our AI features depend on. You'll work alongside data engineering, analytics, and the product teams whose workflows generate and consume the data, and you'll be accountable for ensuring our core products deliver data value to customers.

You own a meaningful product area end-to-end with limited direction. You set the roadmap for your space, make the tradeoff calls, and bring stakeholders along with clear reasoning.

Our Guiding Principles

  • Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don’t hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.
  • Help Customers Win. We learn our customers’ businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.
  • Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.
  • Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don’t wait to be asked.
  • Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Built’s data capabilities, including embedded reporting and analytics, portfolio dashboards, data exports, and data sharing integrations.
  • Get close to how lenders, owners, and GCs use data to make decisions, and turn that into sharp problem statements and requirements.
  • Partner with data engineering on data models, pipelines, and data quality so the numbers customers see are accurate and on time.
  • Drive shared metric definitions so a figure like “percent complete” or “funds disbursed” means the same thing in every product and every customer workspace.
  • Work with the CLA, CLA+ and payments product teams so data is captured well at the source instead of cleaned up downstream.
  • Shape the data that powers Built’s AI features, including the AI Draw Agent and lender portfolio risk tools.
  • Track adoption and impact of your products and use what you learn to decide what to build next.
  • Support sales and customer success with demos, customer conversations, and enablement on platform reporting and data features.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–8 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning data, analytics or reporting products in B2B SaaS.
  • Strong SQL and comfort working directly in the data. You can answer your own questions and validate what engineering builds.
  • Working knowledge of modern data stack concepts: warehouses, ELT, dimensional modeling, and BI or embedded analytics tools such as Sigma, Looker or Tableau.
  • Experience writing requirements for data work that a data engineer can build against, including metric definitions, data contracts and acceptance criteria.
  • A track record of shipping data features and analytics capabilities that customers adopt.
  • Ability to explain data concepts clearly to bankers and engineers alike.
  • Experience in financial services, lending, real estate, or construction is a strong plus.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

  • You’ve published a data roadmap that product, engineering, and go-to-market leaders have bought into.
  • At least one data feature improvement has shipped, and you can show its adoption with real usage numbers.
  • Core reporting metrics have agreed definitions and named owners, and customer escalations about numbers not matching are trending down.
  • Product teams across the business treat you as their partner for anything data related.

AI & Technology Expectations

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.
  • Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort through automation and AI.
  • Apply AI to sharpen decision-making and strengthen strategic insights.
  • Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team.

Built’s salary range for this position is $165,000 - $210,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.

Travel Requirement: Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs.

Perks:

  • The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1.5T industry
  • Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation [US ONLY], medical, dental & vision insurance
  • Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options
  • Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development
  • 401k with match and expedited vesting [US ONLY]

We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive workplace where every employee can succeed, and we recruit, hire, and promote fairly - without bias based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
