Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare (formerly QHR Health), we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.


The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.


We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.


Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .


SUMMARY:

The Clinical Documentation Educator (CDE) will audit, create, implement and maintain clinical documentation education for Physicians, Clinicians or other care providers at assigned clients. This role may participate in the orientation of new client providers and client or Ovation revenue cycle staff. The CDE will participate in quality initiatives that impact client metrics as related to documentation. The CDE will also develop/ track/ trend and provide metrics related to those education tasks/ projects to all relevant parties.

This position will assist with the ongoing and continuous development and implementation of all revenue cycle services by managing resources and ensuring quality expectations are met for clients. This role includes establishing and maintaining positive relationships with current and past client contacts, and team members from various revenue cycle management departments, both internal and external. The CDE will ensure quality standards are met as defined by Ovation and/ or other service-level agreements.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Develop and implement clinical documentation education for physicians, clinicians and other stakeholders. Creation of documentation templates. Use data to identify and target areas needing additional training.
  • Maintain provider education library.
  • Aid in trending denials for education opportunities.
  • Assist in developing and growing coding services.
  • Directly perform, oversee, participate in, and recommend process improvements and operational changes to improve efficiency and client relationships.
  • Prepare and provide daily/weekly reports to appropriate internal and external stakeholders, up to the executive level.
  • Comfort and expertise presenting to and working closely with providers.
  • Mentor and train staff as applicable.
  • Aid in or create, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures for the department or clients.
  • Other duties as assigned and assessed by client needs.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of ICD-10 code and MS-DRG assignment, American Hospital Association Coding Guidelines, and Coding Clinics.
  • Extensive knowledge of complex disease processes.
  • Working knowledge of quality improvement theory, core measures, and other required reporting programs.
  • Strong understanding of the requirements for clinical documentation, coding, and billing according to the rules of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers.
  • Proficiency in computer use, including electronic medical records (EMR), CDI software, electronic codebooks, Microsoft Office, and presentation programs.
  • Strong professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize efforts while multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment utilizing critical thinking skills.
  • Strong managerial, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • A team player, always willing to contribute to the organization.

WORK EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS:

Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS) certification by the Association of Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialists (ACDIS) or Clinical Documentation Improvement Professional (CDIP) certification by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA).

Active nursing license.

Five or more years of relevant experience

Three or more years of employee and client management experience in a remote environment.

100% Remote

The Permit Coordinator is the main contact with Permitting Entities and communicates status of all permits to the OSP Construction Team. They manage the cohesive relationship to drive permit approvals and will travel to location to expedite and facilitate the permit approval process.

Remote Work Location: Due to logistics of working with the Central Time Zone, we're looking for candidates who reside in the following states: Arizona, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Missouri, Ohio, Texas, Wisconsin.

What you will be doing:

  • Coordinates permitting activities based on direction from OSP Construction.
  • Determines necessary permits, coordinates with internal and external resources and permitting entities to release passes to construction.
  • Daily routine interaction with various agencies to obtain approvals, submit permit applications and prepare responses in a timely manner.
  • Routine interaction with internal departments to build relationships, build business cohesion and help internal clients to expand Metronet services in the market.
  • Manage work within defined scheduled expectations, remove roadblocks and use analytics to anticipate and avoid future roadblocks and keep projects on schedule.
  • Apply technical and creative solutions to aid in completion of permitting acquisitions.
  • Forecast release dates to allow construction to plan resources accordingly.
  • Provide guidance with internal resources to assure pole applications are submitted in order and on time to meet the project schedule.
  • Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables, assemble, submit, and track progress of permit applications and notify management of delays with actionable solutions.
  • Document and coordinate with centralized permit teams to ensure permit submittals is in line with the field’s construction schedule.
  • Monitor/track permit packages via online systems, email, or in person as necessary to meet local requirements, adjust and report when situations arise.
  • Monitor projects and effectively communicates the status of each permit.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You Need For This Position:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Experience with permitting in multiple states preferred.
  • Experience working in multidiscipline and cross-functional teams preferred.
  • Able to work within a team, leading multiple personalities and driving projects to conclusion.
  • Organization and strong problem-solving aptitude required.
  • Ability to interact with all levels of organization including external agencies required.
  • Strong social, verbal, and written communications skills required.
  • Must be able to work independently, and with a team.

Join us and find out what it means to love your career!

At Metronet, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge technology combined with exceptional customer care. Our 100% fiber-optic technology ensures that we provide our customers with some of the fastest internet speeds in the world. As industry leaders, we’re not just focused on expanding our networks—we’re focused on enriching the lives of those we serve.

We value our associates because they are the cornerstone of our success. By joining the Metronet family, you’re stepping into a rewarding career in technology with a company dedicated to your growth and success. We’re in it to win it, and a key part of our strategy is to strengthen our business-to-business technology sales team with talented and hard-working individuals who aspire to be the next generation of technology leaders.

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work, we offer a competitive total compensation package, including 80% of medical premiums paid by the company, company-paid disability and life insurance, and a 401(k)-company match. Plus, enjoy discounted services within our coverage areas and thrive in a locally owned, friendly, and fun atmosphere.

Discover more with Metronet — a company where your success builds stronger communities, and your future is limitless.

Metronet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Veteran Friendly Employer.

raw.title: Talent Buying Manager
raw.excerpt: Talent Buying ManagerMISSIONLead the execution of our talent buying function for assigned events and/or lineup segments in planning and executing festivals with the goal of providing a world-class experience for guests and talent and their teams.
raw.description:
Talent Buying Manager

MISSION

Lead the execution of our talent buying function for assigned events and/or lineup segments in planning and executing festivals with the goal of providing a world-class experience for guests and talent and their teams.

DESCRIPTORS

Leadership, Relationships, Strategy, Innovation, Communicator, Proactive, Creative, Action Oriented, Curator

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the talent buying function of up to 12 events per calendar year.
  • Identify and engage talent that would be appropriate for Sixthman events, including emerging talent.
  • Build the strategy with the Director of Talent Buying for each event lineup, ensuring adequate balance of acts for the events/venues and that the curation of the lineup matches the event vision—note that in some cases this will be done without any outside influences, but in some cases, this will need to be done in coordination with the host talent management team or partner, requiring balancing advocacy for the event vision and diplomacy for the relationships.
  • Negotiate talent contracts ensuring best-in-class industry terms and modifying standard agency contracts to fit the nature of the events and venues.
  • Evaluate for financial and cabin/room accuracy and edit, as necessary, all support talent contracts and distribute to all relevant SXM teams.
  • Negotiate support talent and auxiliary talent offers and secure talent and auxiliary talent confirmations for Sixthman events in accordance with the talent budgets (both dollars and cabins) for each event, ensuring that any budget overages have appropriate approval from finance and from partners.
  • Communicate the lineup strategy for each event to the launch team and keep the relevant parties apprised of the lineup status, as it is a key component of launch.
  • Collaborate with SXM marketing to ensure support talent contracts are shown to hold a commitment to fully marketing the event.
  • Coordinate post-launch talent announcements with Talent Relations and Event Management teams to maximize impact of talent.
  • Build a relationship with the talent managers in addition to their agents so that talent want to return on events.
  • Work with Event Managers and Production to identify schedule strategy once the event is confirmed.
  • Build and maintain the event schedule for all events with the Event team.
  • Proactively communicate status of line-ups with relevant internal SXM teams.
  • Manage talent cabins within budget and notify Director of Talent Buying and Finance of any required changes and any recommendations to potentially go over budget on talent spend of cabins for events that are in revenue management.
  • Encourage agent and manager connection with the Sixthman team.
  • Serve as a consultant to the Talent Relations and Event Management teams to develop collaboration ideas to enhance guest experience.
  • Evaluate responses to offers and make recommendations as needed to help convert passed offers to accepted offers (with creativity beyond just higher budgets).
  • Serve as primary contact for support talent management during the contracting process and for any issues and opportunities that arise related to the event.
  • Assist the Director of Talent Buying in the development of overall talent strategy and talent budgets for assigned events with the overall goal of maximizing the impact for the dollars spent and ensuring distinct talent lanes for the various events that might have overlap.
  • Maintain an internal comprehensive talent database in Wheelhouse.
  • Mine new concept leads from agent/manager contacts to share with Business Development Team.
  • Recommend, develop, and implement process and procedure improvements to support scalability of growth of the company with focus on increased efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness as well as enhancing guest and talent experience.
  • Work with internal teams to build materials that showcase the value of our events to agents and managers.
  • Lead hiring, training, and performance reviews for direct reports, as applicable.
  • Serve on an internal team that helps build new SXM festivals.
  • Attend several of the Company's festivals annually and perform various duties onsite with the goal of providing a world-class experience to guests, talent, and partners.
  • Serve as onboard CEO or Event Director on several events per year.
  • Host and develop relationships with the support talent, support talent teams, and industry guests sailing.
  • Attend relevant industry events, conferences, or festivals to build relationships and to monitor best practices and make appropriate recommendations to keep Sixthman on the leading edge of industry.
  • Proactively build a relationship with the agency community, visiting key agencies throughout the year to lay the foundation for future offers.
  • Serve as primary owner for at least one of the following areas: consulting with the Talent Relations and Event Management teams on guest-experience collaboration ideas; identifying potential talent collaboration strategy and assisting in the curation of events to implement those collaborations where applicable; building and evaluating new festival concepts with the Director of Talent Buying to enhance the SXM event portfolio; or establishing and developing the SXM presence with agents, managers, artists/talent, and local venues/promoters.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree required (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience
  • Previous talent buying experience required
  • Experience with multi-stage music festivals preferred
  • Contract negotiation experience required
  • Must have good verbal, written, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage one's own time and the time of others
  • Excellent organization skills and ability to multitask
  • Ability to work under pressure and adapt to changes or challenges
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Detail-oriented with high accuracy
  • Computer proficiency (Email, Word, and strong Excel skills)

WHO LEADS YOU

  • Director - Talent Buying and Festival Development

raw.description:
About 360insights

360insights orchestrates how brands engage and grow their complex partner ecosystems. Our unified platform brings together streamlined experiences, incentives, and services so brands can coordinate go-to-market efforts with clarity, consistency, and control. Built for organizations with indirect channels and complex global incentive programs, we are trusted by leading brands worldwide.

We believe in “Experiences that create growth. Growth that creates experiences.” Through learning and development programs and mentorship, we provide the support, tools, and opportunities you need to grow and succeed as an Insighter.

We welcome talent from all backgrounds and are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request. Learn more about our DEIB vision on our website.

About the role

As a key member of the senior leadership team, the Head of Marketing will lead the strategy, operating model, team capability, and execution required to accelerate predictable pipeline and revenue growth. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role will partner across go-to-market, Product Development, and Executive Leadership to build a scalable, measurable, AI-enabled marketing engine.

The successful candidate will be a strategic, values-based marketing leader who can move fluidly from strategy to execution while building both the marketing function and the people within it. They will strengthen demand generation, improve marketing ROI, support 360’s growth story, and create the team, systems, campaigns, and measurement practices needed to help 360insights win in Channel Incentives Management.

Leadership profile: The ideal candidate is a builder, operator, and people leader who can set clear direction, develop talent, simplify complex marketing and revenue challenges, and connect marketing activity to measurable business outcomes.

What you'll do

  • Own 360insights' market positioning, brand strategy, and category leadership, establishing a differentiated narrative that strengthens competitive advantage, increases market awareness, and supports enterprise revenue growth.
  • Develop and lead an integrated marketing strategy aligned to 360’s growth objectives, revenue targets, and long-term company strategy.
  • Build and lead the customer expansion and cross-sell program, including account-based campaigns, scaled executive business reviews, and whitespace analysis, to grow revenue within the existing install base.
  • Own marketing’s pipeline contribution, budget, and performance reporting, including channel ROI, multi-touch attribution, and PlanHat (CRM) reporting, and reallocate spend based on results.
  • Assess the current marketing function and build a practical operating model with clear priorities, accountabilities, and expected business impact.
  • Partner across Sales, Business Development, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to improve pipeline quality, conversion, win rate, and customer expansion.
  • Lead demand generation across priority channels, including events, content, paid media, SEO/AEO, website, analyst activity, field marketing, partner marketing, and account-based programs.
  • Clarify 360’s ideal customer profile, buyer personas, value proposition, and messaging so marketing investments focus on the highest-return opportunities.
  • Use data, experimentation, and performance reporting to improve campaign effectiveness, budget allocation, and pipeline contribution.
  • Evaluate and implement AI-enabled tools, workflows, and automation to improve lead generation, personalization, content, and operational efficiency.
  • Build, coach, and develop a high-performing, values-based marketing team with the focus, capability, and accountability required to support 360’s next stage of growth.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing leadership experience, ideally in SaaS, technology, channel, partner ecosystem, incentive management, or related enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience building marketing strategies that support pipeline generation, revenue growth, customer expansion, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise B2B buying journeys, demand generation, ABM, content strategy, digital marketing, marketing operations, and sales alignment.
  • Ability to evaluate a marketing function, identify capability gaps, reshape priorities, and build practical roadmaps that improve performance.
  • Demonstrated financial and commercial acumen, with experience managing significant marketing investments, building business cases, measuring customer acquisition economics, and connecting marketing strategy to revenue growth, profitability, and enterprise value.
  • Comfort using AI-enabled marketing tools and automation to improve productivity, personalization, lead generation, content, and campaign execution.
  • Experience leading, developing, and motivating marketing teams, including both strategic leaders and hands-on contributors.
  • Values-based, commercially minded leader who builds trust, simplifies complexity, supports change, and drives measurable results.

raw.title: Staff Engineer, AI Developer Experience (Remote, US)
raw.excerpt: Who We AreEveryday Electric (formerly Renew Home) is on a mission to change how we power the world by making it easier for customers to save energy and money at home as part of the largest residential virtual power plant in North America.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Everyday Electric (formerly Renew Home) is on a mission to change how we power the world by making it easier for customers to save energy and money at home as part of the largest residential virtual power plant in North America.

We partner with industry-leading brands to better manage residential energy for users by prioritizing efficiency, savings, and comfort — and cleaner energy for everyone.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer striving to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment where everyone feels that they have a voice that is heard.

We strongly encourage candidates to check out our website at to learn more about the world-changing work we are doing.

Role Summary

At Everyday Electric, we are embracing AI-assisted development as a core part of how we work — and we are looking for a Staff Engineer to lead that effort from the inside. This role will help define how our engineers interact with AI tools and agents, shape the standards and guardrails that make adoption safe and effective, and continuously improve the inner loop of software development: the daily experience of writing, building, testing, and iterating on code.

You will be embedded directly within the application development teams, giving you firsthand exposure to their workflows and friction points. While other engineers across the organization already contribute meaningfully to DevX, you will bring dedicated ownership, drive prioritization, and serve as the primary point of accountability for making progress. You won't be starting from scratch, and you won't be working alone.

The application engineering teams are your primary customers. Success here means earning their trust, understanding their daily workflows, and shipping improvements they notice and value. We want someone who brings expertise and fresh ideas, and who also knows how to build buy-in, incorporate feedback, and make durable change through iteration.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with meaningful technical leadership responsibility. You will act as a force multiplier across the engineering organization by mentoring engineers, incorporating feedback, influencing engineering culture, and helping shape how we work.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the evolution of our AI Developer Experience, enabling engineers to safely and effectively leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Drive the evaluation, adoption and governance of AI development tooling (code generation, in-editor assistance, agentic workflows), ensuring that adoption is practical, secure and measurable.
  • Measure and improve the speed of common developer actions across our TypeScript/Node and Python codebases. This includes build times, pre-push hooks, linting, type checking, conformance checks, and Nx task orchestration.
  • Own our devcontainer strategy, both local and cloud-based, to ensure a secure, consistent and reproducible development experience that scales across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Maintain and improve local testing frameworks and developer-facing test infrastructure.
  • Own and evolve shared internal libraries and configuration systems used across application teams, ensuring they are well-documented, versioned, and easy to adopt.
  • Contribute to related areas including CI/CD and delivery pipelines, SDLC definition, language and library upgrade cycles (Node/Python, NPM, PyPI), developer onboarding and documentation, and observability.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on developer tooling, platform engineering, or developer productivity.
  • Deep familiarity with TypeScript/Node and Python ecosystems — you know the package management landscape, common build tooling, and where things tend to break.
  • Experience with monorepo tooling (Nx or similar) and an intuition for how to make large codebases fast to work with.
  • Hands-on experience designing, configuring, and improving devcontainer-based development environments.
  • Practical experience evaluating and integrating AI development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, OpenAI, Cursor, Codex) including thinking carefully about standards and guardrails, not just rollout.
  • Strong listening, communication, and leadership skills — you seek out feedback from the engineers you serve and know when to lead and when to follow.
  • Bonuses:
    • Experience with agentic development workflows, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool orchestration, or AI workflow automation.
    • Experience relevant to AI security including designing secure execution environments, sandboxing, secrets management, or credential isolation for AI systems.
    • Experience with cloud-based or remote development environments.

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A full-time position, with a competitive salary based on experience. The base salary for this role is $170k - $220k. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a target annual bonus of 15% of base salary, and participation in long-term incentive programs tied to company growth and performance. We use market data and consider your job family, background, skills, experience, and U.S. work location to determine compensation within our established pay range.
  • Fully remote work environment with home office set-up allowance.
  • Real and lived work-life balance - Company perks include no pre-set vacation limits (with a top-down culture of taking meaningful PTO every year!), parental leave benefits, and a corporate value of working sustainably and putting families first.
  • Competitive benefits package that includes numerous health and wellness benefits.
  • 401(k) plan, with employer contributions to the same.
  • Opportunity to work with amazing people who are passionate about their mission, thriving in a fully-remote work environment, and learning and growing every day.

At this time, Everyday Electric is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future immigration from the company, including training plans for foreign students.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Individuals seeking employment at Everyday Electric are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identification, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

raw.description:
The Regional Project Lead is a senior level clinical trial manager who oversees, manages, and coordinates activities of project teams in designated countries and ensures consistency of Clinical Operations processes across regions. They ensure meeting study milestones are met by the project team on a country and regional level.

  • Ensures planning, implementation, and management of projects in compliance with industry regulations, ICH-GCP, essential study documents, and applicable controlled documents (e.g., PSI QSDs or Sponsor QMS documents)
  • Acts as primary or secondary project management contact for the project team and PSI support services in designated countries
  • Performs study status review and progress reporting (if delegated by the Project Manager)
  • Collects and reports project status updates for designated regions, both internally and externally
  • Develops and updates project planning documents, essential study documents and project manuals/ instructions
  • Manages and reports on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for designated countries and clinical project team members
  • Ensures that the project timelines and subject enrollment targets are met in designated countries
  • Coordinates maintenance of study-specific and corporate tracking systems
  • Coordinates site contractual startup and budget negotiations
  • Establishes communication lines within the project team and supervises clinical project team members’ performance
  • Identifies, escalates and resolves resourcing and performance issues
  • Conducts and supervises therapeutic area training of the project team (if delegated by the Project Manager)
  • Prepares presentations and conducts training of Investigators
  • Ensures team compliance with project-specific training matrix
  • Performs field training of Monitors tailored to the project needs
  • Supervises preparation, conduct and reporting of site selection, site initiation, routine monitoring and closeout visits
  • Oversees investigator and site payments, as well as CRF data retrieval/ upload and monitoring and the query resolution process
  • Supervises project team preparation for study audits/ inspections and resolution of audit/ inspection findings
  • Coordinates conduct of supervised monitoring visits
  • Reviews site visit reports and ensures monitoring and reporting standards are met
  • Coordinates preparation of initial and follow-up Regulatory and Ethics Committee submissions and notifications
  • Oversees the safety information flow and participates in feasibility research
  • Reviews/approves project related expenses and timesheets (if delegated by the Project Manager)
  • College/University degree in Life Sciences or an equivalent combination of education, training & experience is required
  • Prior experience in Clinical Research and on-site monitoring is required
  • Prior experience monitoring within the US
  • Experience as a Study Manager/Clinical Trial Manager with the ability to supervise project activities as a Regional Lead or equivalent is required
  • Experience in Oncology is required
  • Experience in GI is preferred
  • Full working proficiency in English
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications, including MS Project
  • Communication, presentation and customer-service skills
  • Ability to negotiate and build relationships at all levels
  • Team building, leadership and organizational skills

Advance your career in clinical research, coordinating a variety of tasks and learning new things while growing with a rapid growing company that puts its people first.

PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization with more 30 years in the industry, offering a perfect balance between stability and innovation to both clients and employees. We focus on delivering quality and on-time services across a variety of therapeutic indications.

raw.description:
Category: HVAC

Location: North East United Kingdom


Our client is a well-established HVAC manufacturer, supplying air distribution solutions to commercial construction projects across the UK. With a workforce of over 250 employees, they are recognised for both product quality and technical expertise.

As part of their continued growth, the company is now seeking a Field-Based Area Sales Manager to join the external sales team and cover the North East England region.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and manage relationships across a wide range of commercial project types, including offices, healthcare, education, residential, hospitality, retail, and government buildings.

  • Ensure the company’s products (e.g. diffusers, dampers, grilles, control systems) are specified, approved, and ultimately installed on new projects.

  • Engage with key decision-makers throughout the route to market, including M&E consultants, main contractors, specialist subcontractors, design & build contractors, and specifiers.

This is a remote position, typically spending 3–4 days per week in the field and the remainder working from home. Project values range from £10,000 to £250,000+, with sales cycles typically spanning 6–18 months.

In addition to managing regional enquiries and driving business development, you’ll also represent the company at conferences and exhibitions alongside the National Sales Manager and Sales Director.


Requirements

We are keen to hear from:

  • Candidates from a wholesale or distribution background who are looking to move into technical sales.

  • Experienced specification-led sales engineers with knowledge of HVAC or related products and an understanding of the route to market, ideally gained with another manufacturer.

  • Field sales experience with a wholesaler, distributor, or manufacturer within the construction industry.

  • HVAC product knowledge is highly desirable, but we will also consider candidates from other technical field-based products or services such as lighting, facades, renewables, lifts & escalators, fire & security systems.

  • Strong understanding of the route to market, including engagement with M&E consultants, main contractors, subcontractors, or specifiers throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Comfortable working autonomously, managing your own diary and territory.

  • A full UK driving licence is essential.


Benefits

  • £45,000-£55,000 base salary negotiable
  • OTE first year £15,000
  • Company car, phone and laptop
  • Good company pension
  • Life insurance
Marcus Knightley is a specialist recruitment consultancy with 35 years experience placing salespeople within the built environment.

description: We’re a games studio focused on building games that bring people together.

raw.title: Senior 3D Generalist Artist - 6 month contract
raw.excerpt: We’re a games studio focused on building games that bring people together.
raw.description:
We’re a games studio focused on building games that bring people together.

We believe that games that deliver the most fun-per-minute have the highest chance of success. We are a start-up and not a big company, which means we’re a bit scrappy but we’re resourceful, highly collaborative and focused on outcomes and shipping builds over process and meetings.

We aim to hire multi-talented individuals who can operate autonomously and at speed, with every role at the studio being hands-on working directly on our games.

Role Overview

We’re looking to bring on a Senior 3D Generalist Artist for a 6 month contract, with potential to extend further depending on how things go.

We’re looking for a Senior 3D Generalist Artist that has experience building modular environments and character art, to contribute to art production on an exciting unannounced co-op combat game.

Key Responsibilities

1 - Create Game-Ready Art

You’ll mainly be working on modular environments, props, set dressing and character / creature work.

Success looks like:

  • Understanding our art ethos and working autonomously with high level direction
  • Grasping the project art style and adapting quickly
  • Understanding how to construct modular environments and working to a grid
  • Rapid output by focusing on getting the core elements right rather than superficial details

2 - Be a Force Multiplayer, Not Just an Asset Maker

There’s more to it than just creating assets, it’s about being an invaluable team member.

Success looks like:

  • Communicating and collaborating with the team. Nurturing the synergy between disciplines and problem solving the gaps in-between
  • Joining playtests and contributing to the game experience beyond art
  • Identifying risks and constraints early and redirecting effort when needed
  • Being pro-active and moving the project forward, even if you’re waiting for feedback or currently blocked, you know how to identify meaningful work to keep momentum

3 - Implement Assets in Engine

You’re not just handing off art assets, you’re implementing them in-engine.

Success looks like:

  • Importing, setting up and hooking up assets
  • Correctly handling setup for materials, prefabs, folders and naming etc
  • Fixing materials, collision and general art bugs in engine
  • Spotting inefficiencies and offering better solutions
  • Keeping assets and scenes well optimized without sacrificing the game’s vision

Requirements

  • Senior experience level. Comfortable working autonomously with high level direction, championing your area of responsibility
  • Broad artistic & technical skillset: environments, props, characters / creatures
  • Confident in Unity; asset implementation and fixing art bugs
  • Comfortable in Blender (preferred) or able to transition quickly
  • Happy to prioritize speed & efficiency
  • Project first mindset: Our games look good but we’re not trying to win art awards or build stunning portfolio pieces. The experience is king.
  • General understanding of supporting optimization and performance for online multiplayer titles (from an art POV)
  • Bonus skills: Rigging, VFX, UI, Tech Art skills, Concept Art

Please note: This is a 6 month contract, remote-working position, open to anyone within the UK.

Deine Mission

As Senior ERP Engineer - Odoo (d/f/m), you shape how our ERP grows. Odoo runs our invoicing, hardware logistics and energy market communication, and over the next year it becomes the source of truth for customer and contract data and takes over electricity billing. You design the data model and module architecture, build integrations with our platform and partners, and hold the quality bar for the team. You do not only ask "How do we build this in Odoo", but also "Should this live in Odoo at all".

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Designing and building custom Odoo modules, from data model to UI
  • Making architecture decisions for a growing ERP, including what belongs in Odoo and what doesn’t
  • Driving the migration of customer, contract and metering processes from HubSpot into Odoo
  • Building and maintaining integrations with our internal platform and external partners in logistics, metering and market communication
  • Shipping features to production independently
  • Setting technical standards for code reviews, automated tests, CI and code quality
  • Reviewing code and pairing with our developers and our external Odoo partner
  • Working closely with Finance and Ops to turn their needs into clear scope and reliable estimates

Dein Profil

  • You bring 5+ years of software development, several of them hands-on with Odoo (custom modules, ORM, views, security rules, major version upgrades)
  • You work confidently with Python and PostgreSQL
  • You’ve built ERP integrations (REST APIs, webhooks, batch jobs) that run reliably in production
  • Git, CI and automated tests are part of your daily routine
  • You think in data models and processes, not just in tickets
  • You raise risks early, say clearly when a deadline won’t hold and push back when needed, including with non-technical stakeholders
  • You speak fluent English

Unser Offer

  • Real influence on a core system: shape the ERP our whole business runs on
  • Impact on the energy transition: work powers billing, logistics and market communication for smart home energy
  • More room to shape things than at an Odoo agency or in a large corporate
  • Short paths to Finance, Ops and our CTO, no long chains of command
  • Flexibility: work remotely from anywhere in Germany or from our offices in Berlin and Cologne

About ttcInnovations
Founded in 2001, ttcInnovations is a certified woman-owned consulting and talent partner supporting Fortune 500 organizations. We connect clients with top-tier experts through staff augmentation, project delivery, and flexible engagement models, always prioritizing culture fit and impact.

Today, we’re evolving alongside traditional learning services into a business transformation and performance partner. Our work is increasingly focused on diagnostic-led engagements that drive measurable outcomes across performance consulting, change management, enablement, and sustainment.

This posting is for future opportunities. We are creating a talent pool to support upcoming client engagements as needs emerge.

Engagement Type: Contract / Project‑Based

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Start Date: Based on project availability

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Change Management Consultant to support clients through complex transformation initiatives. This role embeds structured change management strategies into learning and enablement solutions, ensuring initiatives drive adoption, reduce resistance, and accelerate measurable business outcomes.

The consultant operates in a client‑facing, advisory capacity and partners closely with business leaders, HR, L&D, and internal design teams to integrate change strategy with learning and execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with client stakeholders to assess change readiness, organizational impact, and adoption risk.
  • Develop and apply change management strategies aligned to business initiatives and transformation goals.
  • Provide subject matter expertise across core change domains, including:
    • Stakeholder identification and engagement
    • Communication planning and messaging alignment
    • Change adoption and reinforcement strategies
    • Resistance identification and management
  • Collaborate with instructional designers to align learning solutions with broader change journeys.
  • Support the development of change enablement assets, including:
    • Change communication plans
    • Manager toolkits and leader enablement resources
    • Adoption and sustainment strategies
  • Facilitate workshops, stakeholder alignment sessions, and leadership meetings as needed.
  • Define and track success metrics related to change adoption, behavior change, and engagement.
  • Incorporate feedback and performance data to continuously improve change and learning solutions.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in change management, organizational development, or transformation roles.
  • Hands‑on experience leading or supporting enterprise or large‑scale change initiatives.
  • Strong working knowledge of change frameworks (e.g., Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter).
  • Experience partnering cross‑functionally with business, HR, and L&D leaders.
  • Comfortable operating in client‑facing, project‑based environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prosci or similar change management certification.
  • Experience supporting large‑scale technology, process, or organizational transformations.
  • Consulting, advisory, or professional services experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Recommended solutions are embedded within a clear, structured change approach.
  • Clients experience stronger adoption, reduced resistance, and faster realization of benefits.
  • Stakeholders view you as a trusted change advisor, not just a framework expert.
  • Change efforts result in observable behavior change tied to business outcomes.

Join InPost’s Consumer & Merchant Domain / Send Team and work on business-critical systems responsible for key areas related to parcel creation and some of the largest initiatives across InPost.

You’ll become part of a multidisciplinary team of senior engineers with a high level of autonomy, strong ownership, and real influence on solution architecture.

The team values knowledge sharing, close collaboration, and a friendly working atmosphere.

What you’ll be working on

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the full software development lifecycle, from analysing a topic and designing the solution architecture to implementation, automated testing, and deployment.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and implementing microservices following Hexagonal Architecture principles
  • Actively contributing to architectural decisions and solution design
  • Building event-driven integrations using Kafka, Avro, and Transactional Outbox
  • Writing comprehensive automated tests, including unit, integration, and contract tests
  • Participating in code reviews and maintaining high code-quality standards
  • Taking ownership of assigned topics, identifying relevant stakeholders, and independently gathering the information needed to deliver solutions end-to-end
  • Using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code as part of your daily development workflow

Tech stack

  • Java 21
  • Spring Boot 3.x / 4.x, MVC & WebFlux
  • Gradle
  • PostgreSQL, JPA/Hibernate, R2DBC
  • MongoDB
  • Apache Kafka, Avro, Confluent Schema Registry
  • Hexagonal Architecture, Microservices, Event-Driven Design, Transactional Outbox
  • OAuth2 / JWT, Spring Security, OpenFGA
  • Spock Framework, Testcontainers, WireMock, REST-Assured, ArchUnit, PIT Mutation Testing
  • GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
  • Micrometer, Prometheus, SonarQube, Checkstyle, CodeNarc

We’re looking for a Senior-level Software Developer who has:

  • Strong experience with Java 21+ and Spring Boot, including MVC and/or WebFlux
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and/or MongoDB
  • Good understanding of Hexagonal / Clean Architecture and microservices patterns
  • Experience with automated testing, such as Spock or JUnit, Testcontainers, and contract testing
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, and GitLab CI
  • Solid understanding of OAuth2/JWT-based security
  • Proficiency with AI coding tools. Claude Code is the company standard, while experience with equivalent agentic coding tools such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor is also relevant

The challenges

You’ll be working within a highly complex distributed environment consisting of dozens of microservices and numerous communication channels. Understanding the wider system landscape will be just as important as working effectively with individual components.

The role also comes with a high degree of autonomy from day one. You’ll be expected to independently analyse topics, identify the right stakeholders, gather the necessary information, and take ownership of delivering solutions end-to-end.

AI-assisted development is an integral part of the team’s way of working. Claude Code is used at scale, and working effectively in an agentic, AI-first development workflow is a core expectation for this position.

Please note that while the role is remote, the final stage of the recruitment process is conducted in person at our Warsaw office, so candidates are expected to be available and willing to travel to Warsaw for this meeting.

  • Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.

  • You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland. We already have over 300,000 products in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey - heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

raw.excerpt: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you!
raw.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This Associate Territory Production Underwriter - Middle Market Commercial Lines will support the Commercial Middle Market Business Development Team. The territory for this position is Arizona. The qualified candidate will reside in Arizona ideally Phoenix metro but flexible.


Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As an Associate Territory Manager, You'll be the primary relationship manager for middle market new and renewal business, through direct contact with a territory of select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through development, negotiation and execution of business plans. Your leadership and influencing skills will be key as you help agencies create and implement sales strategies, processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and member retention. Your collaboration with internal partners will be important to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Underwrites new business, renewals and endorsements based on authority level and appetite. Decisions at this level may require review of additional variables, leveraging agency, sales and underwriting relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions.

  • Reviews individual risks for acceptability and handles those within authority based on company underwriting guidelines and standards. Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. May perform portfolio analysis or additional underwriting analysis in support of unit objectives.

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work by utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of Middle Market Business Development Team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, enhance agency relationship and to develop business solutions. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options to improve retention and profitability. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups. Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates and collaborates actively with team members and leadership to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, account abilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively identifies opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the Middle Market Business Development Team regarding new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of escalated customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter expert.

  • Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to MM Business Development Director. Individual contributor.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in business administration or management preferred. Technical insurance coursework toward designations of CPCU, CLU, FLMI, etc. is desirable.

Experience: Three years Commercial Lines underwriting experience required, additional sales experience preferred. Successful completion of the first phase (training) of the Associate Territory Manager role required.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Ability to manage heavy workload effectively and backup other team members as needed. Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for commercial business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and best practices compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid drivers license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law.


NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:

We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Nationwide does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Nationwide employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Nationwide Client Services Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means.

Nationwide pays on a geographic-specific salary structure and placement within the actual starting salary range for this position will be determined by a number of factors including the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; and other conditions of employment. If a Sales job, Sales Incentives, based on performance goals are possible in addition to this range. raw.description:
Are you an experienced professional with a deep understanding of the Ellucian Colleague software platform and a passion for optimizing financial aid operations in higher education? College Aid Services is expanding our team of consultants with Ellucian Colleague experience.

Whether you enjoy leading teams, solving operational challenges, or helping institutions get more from Colleague, there may be an opportunity for you. Join our dynamic team and make a lasting impact on institutions across the country.

Position Overview

As a College Aid Services consultant, you will support higher education institutions across the country through assignments aligned with your experience, availability, and interests. Opportunities may include interim leadership, operational support, remote processing, compliance support, staff training, business process reviews, and technology assistance.

We welcome both functional professionals and those interested in “funky-tech” roles, our term for work that connects financial aid operations with system functionality. These roles may involve Colleague setup, rules configuration, reporting, troubleshooting, and process improvement.

Consultants join College Aid Services as employees. Assignments may be short-term or long-term, with part-time or full-time hours depending on institutional needs.

Key Responsibilities May Include

  • Serve as an interim financial aid director, assistant director, or other financial aid team member.
  • Support daily operations, staff leadership, and administration of Title IV aid programs.
  • Assist with verification, awarding, loan and grant processing, disbursements, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Evaluate business processes and recommend improvements that strengthen efficiency, compliance, and student service.
  • Apply Colleague expertise to support financial aid processing and, for funky-tech assignments, system configuration, rules, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Train staff, document procedures, and collaborate with campus partners and College Aid Services colleagues.

Responsibilities will vary by assignment and your area of expertise.

Qualifications

  • Substantial higher education financial aid experience, with 10 or more years preferred.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Ellucian Colleague.
  • For leadership assignments, at least five years of financial aid director or comparable leadership experience.
  • For funky-tech assignments, experience with Colleague setup, rules, reporting, troubleshooting, or related functionality.
  • Strong knowledge of Title IV programs and applicable financial aid regulations.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively.
  • College degree preferred, or equivalent progressive professional experience.
  • Prior consulting experience, FAAC® certification, and NASFAA credentials preferred.

Availability and Work Requirements

We are seeking professionals with part-time or full-time availability. Many assignments require availability during the client’s regular business hours, which may vary by time zone. Some opportunities may include work outside regular business hours.

Assignments may be remote or hybrid, with travel requirements determined by the assignment. Travel expenses will be reimbursed by College Aid Services, LLC.

When applying, please indicate your areas of expertise, Colleague experience, preferred hours, availability during and outside regular business hours, and preference for remote or hybrid work, including willingness to travel.

Why Join College Aid Services?

Join a collaborative, remote work environment where your experience is valued and you can exchange ideas with knowledgeable higher education colleagues. Our consultants work with project management and compliance team members who provide guidance and support throughout client engagements.

You will have opportunities to pursue assignments that align with your strengths, availability, and professional interests while helping institutions strengthen their operations and support student success.

About College Aid Services, LLC

Since 2002, College Aid Services has provided customized solutions to higher education institutions nationwide. Our services include Interim Staffing and Outsourcing, Business Process Reviews, Remote Processing, Technology Support, Title IV Compliance Support, Enrollment Modeling and Analytics, Staff Training and Executive Coaching.

At the heart of our work is a commitment to exceptional service and student success at the institutions we serve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

College Aid Services, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. College Aid Services participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Du sprichst Deutsch und suchst einen sinnstiftenden Job in Pristina, bei dem Du Dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst und das in einem großartigen Team? - Dann ist diese Position genau das Richtige für Dich!

Zum Start wird die Stelle voraussichtlich vollständig remote ausgeübt. Wir planen jedoch, einen Standort in Pristina zu eröffnen und sollte es dazu kommen, wird die Rolle hybrid oder vollständig vor Ort stattfinden. Du hast dann außerdem die Chance, beim Aufbau unseres Standorts aktiv mitzuwirken und Verantwortung als Team- und Büroleitung zu übernehmen.

Vergütung & Startdatum:

Du solltest im Juli oder August 2025 starten können.

Deine Bezahlung beträgt zwischen 1.800 € und 2.200 € bei 40h/Woche. Bei der Übernahme von mehr Verantwortung, z. B. durch die Leitung des Teams in Pristina auch wesentlich mehr.

Inkludiert sind 23 Tage Urlaub sowie die gesetzlich festgelegten Feiertage in Pristina.

Krankheitstage sind natürlich ebenfalls vergütet.

Über SAWOO
SAWOO ist ein internationales, dynamisches, 20-köpfiges Unternehmen aus München, das überwiegend remote arbeitet. Wir bauen und betreiben Communitys, die Führungskräfte großer Unternehmen zusammen bringen, um diese durch kollaboratives Lernen und Networking zu unterstützen, Herausforderungen zu meistern und sich persönlich sowie beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Dazu organisieren wir monatliche physische Netzwerktreffen (aktuell ca. 20/Monat), Konferenzen (aktuell 3/Jahr), Podcasts sowie weitere Netzwerk-Möglichkeiten für die Community-Mitglieder. Mitglieder unserer Communitys sind beispielsweise Führungskräfte renommierter Firmen, wie Mercedes, Porsche, Airbus, Amazon, Siemens, u. v. m. Unser Ziel ist es, bis 2034 zwei Millionen aktive Mitglieder in unseren Communitys willkommen zu heißen.

Beispiele der Communitys, die wir betreiben:

  • LEADERS IN CONSULTING
  • Level Up HR
  • The Procurement Initiative

Besuche unsere Website für weitere Informationen. Verwende eine Suchmaschine → SAWOO GmbH.

Aufgaben

Du unterstützt unser Team beim Community-Aufbau, indem Du insbesondere über LinkedIn und E-Mail aktiv neue Mitglieder und Event-Teilnehmer gewinnst und den Austausch mit Interessierten führst. Dafür arbeitest Du vorwiegend in den LinkedIn-Profilen unserer Community-Hosts, in den E-Mail-Postfächern unserer Communitys sowie unserem CRM System.

Konkret gehört u. a. zu Deinen Aufgaben:

  • Versand vorformulierter Einladungsnachrichten via LinkedIn und E-Mail zur Bewerbung unserer Communitys und anstehender Events
  • Betreuung der LinkedIn- und E-Mail-Postfächer, inklusive Beantwortung eingehender Nachrichten auf Basis vorhandener Templates, die Du situativ anpasst
  • Identifikation und gezielte Ansprache von Personen, die mit unserem LinkedIn Content interagieren
  • Pflege und kontinuierliche Aktualisierung unserer Community-Datenbank (CRM)
  • Kommunikation mit Community-Hosts zur Vergabe und Nachverfolgung derer To-dos

Deine Ziele:

  • Zuverlässige und fehlerfreie operative Umsetzung: Du lässt bei der Arbeit große Sorgfalt walten. Z. B. versendest Du Nachrichten absolut fehlerfrei und hältst die Einträge im CRM sauber und aktuell.
  • Leistungsbereitschaft & Effizienz: Du hast Lust Gas zu geben, bist fix am PC und versendest z. B. auch mal bis zu 150 vorformulierte Nachrichten pro Stunde bei gleichbleibender Qualität.
  • Schnelle und professionelle Kommunikation: Eingehende Nachrichten und Kommentare beantwortest Du zeitnah, freundlich und passend zum Kontext – mithilfe von Vorlagen, die situativ angepasst werden.

Qualifikation

raw.title: Customer Success Manager (North America - Remote)
raw.excerpt: tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.
raw.description:
tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it:

Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself:

Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones.

What you will be working on

Your mission is to help our customers build more successful short-term rental businesses while driving revenue growth for Hospitable.

This isn't a traditional Customer Success role focused primarily on answering questions, managing relationships, or preventing churn. We're building a proactive, commercially driven Success team that helps customers discover opportunities, get more value from our platform, and grow their businesses.

You'll own a revenue quota, and your ability to consistently meet or exceed that quota will be the primary measure of your success.

You'll do this through the following:

  • Revenue Growth & Expansion: Own and achieve quarterly revenue targets through subscription upgrades, annual conversions, feature adoption, and additional products and services. You'll proactively identify opportunities within our existing customer base and turn those conversations into measurable revenue.
  • Consultative Selling: Get to know our customers, their businesses, and what they're trying to accomplish. Whether they're managing one property or hundreds, you'll identify opportunities to help them save time, increase revenue, and operate more efficiently using Hospitable.
  • Proactive Customer Engagement: Don't wait for customers to reach out. You'll actively engage customers through scheduled meetings, personalized outreach, and targeted campaigns to uncover opportunities, demonstrate value, and drive action.
  • Product Adoption & Monetization: Help customers discover and adopt features that can make a meaningful difference in their businesses, including Direct Booking, Dynamic Pricing, Upsells, and other revenue-generating tools. You'll connect product capabilities to real business outcomes and identify opportunities to expand their investment in Hospitable.
  • Customer Education & Workshops: Lead engaging 1:1 consultations, group workshops, and product demonstrations that help customers get more from Hospitable. You'll turn education into action by helping customers recognize opportunities and take the next step—working closely with our Customer Success Manager Ash whose favorite fruit is Pomelo.
  • Strategic Account Management: Work with high-value customers through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and ongoing conversations to understand their goals, identify gaps in their current setup, and develop recommendations that support their growth and expand their use of Hospitable.
  • Pipeline & Performance Ownership: Build and manage your own pipeline of opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records, and consistently follow through on customer conversations. You'll be responsible for your activity, pipeline health, forecasting, and ultimately your results.
  • Customer Advocacy & Collaboration: Bring customer feedback, challenges, and ideas back to our product and support teams. You'll work closely with teammates to help customers succeed while identifying new opportunities for Hospitable to deliver value.

What success looks like

We believe great Customer Success Managers create value for customers and measurable growth for the company.

You'll be successful in this role when you're consistently achieving your revenue quota, building a healthy pipeline of opportunities, helping customers adopt valuable features, and turning customer conversations into meaningful business outcomes.

We give our team the autonomy to own their results. You'll have support, tools, and coaching along the way, but we expect you to take initiative, find opportunities, and be accountable for your performance.

If you love helping people, enjoy the challenge of selling, and get excited about being rewarded for the results you deliver, you'll feel right at home here.

Requirements

For this position, your location is not a requirement. The ideal fit would work under North American timezones.

Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. The successful candidate will demonstrate how they are uniquely qualified for this role and will be someone that we cannot wait to start working with.

  • Sales & Revenue Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Executive, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS. We're particularly interested in candidates who have carried revenue quotas and consistently met or exceeded their targets.
  • Commercial Mindset: You naturally look for opportunities to grow accounts, expand product adoption, and generate revenue. You're comfortable discussing pricing, presenting value, handling objections, and asking customers to make a purchase decision.
  • Consultative Approach: You know that great selling starts with understanding the customer. You're curious, ask thoughtful questions, uncover business challenges, and recommend solutions that genuinely make sense for the customer.
  • Self-Motivation & Accountability: You thrive in an environment where you're trusted to manage your own time and results. You're proactive, organized, comfortable with performance targets, and motivated by the opportunity to earn more through strong performance.
  • Excellent Communication: You're confident leading customer conversations, delivering presentations, and communicating clearly through email, video calls, and other channels. You can make complex products easy to understand and compelling to use.
  • Pipeline & CRM Management: You understand how to build and manage a sales pipeline, prioritize opportunities, follow up consistently, and maintain accurate records. You're comfortable using CRM tools and performance data to guide your daily activities.
  • Technical Curiosity: You enjoy learning software, exploring new features, and showing customers how technology can improve their businesses. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable demonstrating and explaining software.
  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: You're resourceful, comfortable working independently, and willing to try new approaches when something isn't working. You see challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.
  • Team Collaboration: You enjoy sharing ideas, learning from others, and working with cross-functional teams. You're competitive with your own goals while being genuinely invested in the success of the team.

Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality technology, property management, or revenue management is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

  • A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
  • The compensation depends on your location, status, and level within our salary bands which will be shared during the interview process. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For contractors, the total cost could range from USD$72,000.00 - USD$106,700.00. For US employees, the gross salary could range from USD$66,385.10 to USD$98,379.04.
  • In addition to the above mentioned salary budget, a performance bonus (no cap) is available (paid quarterly) based on quota attainment, achieved from hitting up/cross sell targets.
  • We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a current grant value of up to $9,700.00, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.
  • Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD $230,756.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.
  • 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.
  • For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).
  • Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.
  • Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.
