raw.description:
About Finix

Finix is building the global operating system for fintech, starting with payments. From startups to publicly traded companies, Finix processes tens of billions of dollars annually both in-store and online. Finix was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco.
To date Finix has raised over $200M, including a $75M Series C led by Acrew Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners and backed by American Express Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Homebrew, Inspired Capital, Visa, and others

About the Role:

As an Account Executive on our Platform team, you will own the full sales cycle for Finix's payments products, selling to platforms and ISVs of all sizes. You will lead the sales cycle with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CFOs, and VP/Director-level functional leads. You will drive sales strategy by owning every stage of the cycle from discovery to close, including the cross-functional work to develop the customer strategy and contribute to broader revenue initiatives.

Payments are core to the strategy of the vertical SaaS companies we partner with, and Finix's tools let software platforms monetize payments while keeping their SaaS fees competitive. You'll work with founders and executives to understand their business and help them embed and monetize payments.

You Will:

  • Own and manage the full sales cycle from hunting/discovery to close for software platforms and ISVs.
  • Develop relationships with executives at software companies, along with the technical and non-executive stakeholders brought into deals.
  • Share prospect feedback with cross-functional teams, refine our Ideal Customer Profile, and act on insights from your knowledge of our platform customers.
  • Contribute to team projects focused on developing and refining our sales process and playbooks.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to help drive product strategy and operations.
  • Work closely with our Implementation, Product, and Payment Ops teams to ensure long-term customer success.

You Are:

  • Driven to consistently exceed goals and expectations.
  • A go-getter with a bias toward action and the ability to produce results in fast-paced, ambiguous situations.
  • Proactive, improving existing processes and developing best practices.
  • A strategic negotiator with a passion for closing deals.
  • Curious about prospects, their needs, and how Finix can help.
  • Energetic, bringing a positive attitude to everything you do.

You Have:

  • Proven ability to exceed sales targets.
  • 3+ years of experience in a consultative SaaS selling environment or business development, preferably with a technical product.
  • 1+ years of experience in fintech, ideally selling payments to ISVs or software platforms preferred
  • Strong communication, research, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Google Suite, and other sales tools.
  • A strong desire and ability to grow within Finix.
Finix is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected class.
Role: Account Executive III/IV
Level: IC3/4
Location: Remote
Base Salary Range: $100,000/year to $150,000/year + equity + benefits
Total On-Target-Earnings: $200,000/year to $300,000/year
Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries at our headquarters in San Francisco, California. Individual pay is determined by work location, job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

raw.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Sales Strategy teams define sales approaches for all products in our portfolio. They provide sales feedback to the product teams to guide product development and enablement material development and identify inventive ways to teach sellers how to sell. Motorola Solutions provides critical public safety solutions for our customers with offerings from our Services and Cybersecurity Portfolio, including managed and support services, professional services, lifecycle services, and cybersecurity solutions. A key function within the North America (NA) Sales Operations team is that of a Portfolio Strategist lead for the services and cybersecurity portfolio. This function provides go to market requirements to the product teams and marketing organization to help ensure successful launch and sales expectations can be reached. In addition, this function leads readiness efforts to enable direct, channel and inside sales teams to understand key value propositions, solution features from customer perspective and differentiators over competition.


Job Description

The candidate will be expected to work closely with account managers, sales leadership, sales operations, product managers, development engineering, sales specialists, marketing, and service organizations.


Responsibilities:

  • The Services & Cybersecurity Portfolio Strategist is the bridge between the sales and product organizations for services and cybersecurity offerings. The role encompasses two primary functions:
    • The voice of sales into the product organization for feature development and prioritization
    • Primary contact point and sales enablement source for sellers for questions about Service and Cybersecurity offerings.
  • Prioritize and manage the Services & Cybersecurity "OneList" by synthesizing VoS/VoC inputs into clear development priorities for Product/Engineering
  • Determination of suitable beta trial customers for upcoming products and solutions
  • Meet with customers for Voice of Customer (VoC) sessions
  • Gather and translate VoS and VoC feedback to hold Product teams accountable to sales requirements and drive solution "attach" strategies
  • Make sure new products and solutions are ready for sale and can be consumed by our customers
  • Use of the D stream checklist to confirm market readiness of new products and solutions
  • Bridge gaps between Offer Management, Product, launch assets and Sales Hubs to reduce seller friction, speed up order-to-fulfill flow, and streamline multi-year proposals
  • Communicate new product and service launches, intent to cancel, and process changes to direct sales, MRs, and channel partners as needed to support North America sales for State & Local government as well as Federal business
  • Business case development and confirmation
  • Build practical, bite-sized selling tools (e.g., SPIN questions, ROM quote guidance, ecosystem integration strategies) to empower field sellers across all phases of sales enablement
  • Reducing friction points for the sales organization with new product and solution launches
  • Evaluation of interactions and interfaces of solutions that stretch beyond the assigned portfolio
  • Ability to change presentation styles as needed, ex. technical presale vs. senior leadership
  • Identification of best routes to market and strategies that will increase sales
  • Guide offer teams on the strategy to increase ecosystem sales and reduce seller friction to extend proposals from product siloes to comprehensive multi-year customer outcomes
  • Build strong relationships and become a trusted work partner within the sales organization
  • Provide targeted deal & RFP support for complex projects, empowering field reps to own initial discovery and sales cycles independently
  • Customer Interaction in support of sales; contribute/participate in sales meetings, trade shows, or other customer facing venues
  • Drive "Services Adder" strategies that connect product siloes into peace-of-mind, multi-year recurring outcomes
  • Monitor leading and lagging metrics (e.g., Services attach rates, enablement completion rates, VoS items delivered, ROM quote velocity)

  • Bachelors 3+ years of experience in or more of the following: product management/engineering, marketing, sales, public safety or military
  • OR 6+ years of experience in or more of the following: product management/engineering, marketing, sales, public safety or military
  • Knowledge of managed and support services, professional services, lifecycle services, and cybersecurity solutions
  • Proven experience translating technical product capabilities into practical sales tools or GTM enablement programs
  • Familiarity with services attach strategies, lifecycle services, cybersecurity solutions, or SaaS/recurring revenue models
  • Understanding of financial trade offs, business case development, and product pricing
  • Experience in services delivery, cybersecurity, or related fields is beneficial but not required

raw.title: Associate Territory Production Underwriter - Middle Market Commercial Lines
raw.excerpt: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you!
raw.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This Associate Territory Production Underwriter - Middle Market Commercial Lines will support the Commercial Middle Market Business Development Team. The territory for this position is Arizona. The qualified candidate will reside in Arizona ideally Phoenix metro but flexible.


Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As an Associate Territory Manager, You'll be the primary relationship manager for middle market new and renewal business, through direct contact with a territory of select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through development, negotiation and execution of business plans. Your leadership and influencing skills will be key as you help agencies create and implement sales strategies, processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and member retention. Your collaboration with internal partners will be important to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Underwrites new business, renewals and endorsements based on authority level and appetite. Decisions at this level may require review of additional variables, leveraging agency, sales and underwriting relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions.

  • Reviews individual risks for acceptability and handles those within authority based on company underwriting guidelines and standards. Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. May perform portfolio analysis or additional underwriting analysis in support of unit objectives.

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work by utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of Middle Market Business Development Team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, enhance agency relationship and to develop business solutions. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options to improve retention and profitability. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups. Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates and collaborates actively with team members and leadership to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, account abilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively identifies opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the Middle Market Business Development Team regarding new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of escalated customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter expert.

  • Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to MM Business Development Director. Individual contributor.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in business administration or management preferred. Technical insurance coursework toward designations of CPCU, CLU, FLMI, etc. is desirable.

Experience: Three years Commercial Lines underwriting experience required, additional sales experience preferred. Successful completion of the first phase (training) of the Associate Territory Manager role required.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Ability to manage heavy workload effectively and backup other team members as needed. Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for commercial business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and best practices compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid drivers license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law.


NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:

We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Nationwide does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Nationwide employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Nationwide Client Services Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means.

Nationwide pays on a geographic-specific salary structure and placement within the actual starting salary range for this position will be determined by a number of factors including the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; and other conditions of employment. If a Sales job, Sales Incentives, based on performance goals are possible in addition to this range. Note on Compensation for Part-Time Roles: Please be aware that the salary ranges listed below reflect full-time compensation.   • Proponer las reglas de calidad para cada una de las tablas del dominio de datos, registrarlas en la plantilla definida.
  • Comprender los requisitos de negocio en relación con la calidad para apoyar a la unidad de negocio en definir las reglas de calidad a implementar.
  • Apoyar en el desarrollo y configuración de la plataforma de calidad para aplicar las reglas y estándares.
  • Diseñar y apoyar la construcción de informes (Power BI) que permitan medir y monitorizar la calidad de los datos.
  • Compartir los resultados, identificar oportunidades de mejora y monitorizar la evolución de las métricas de calidad.
  • Conocer los requisitos funcionales relacionados al gobierno y la gestión de la calidad en la organización y proponer acciones para la mejora continua.
  • Colaborar con el equipo de desarrollo (Snowflake+PBI) en la definición funcional de los diferentes activos de datos. Diseñar la forma en la que se incorporará esta información en la plataforma Collibra.
  • Apoyar a los diferentes Data Stewards en la ejecución de las tareas técnicas asociadas con su función.
  • Apoyar a los Data Stewards en el proceso de definición de los términos de negocio y otros activos, así como el mantenimiento en la plataforma.
  • Mantener en Collibra la información de los activos relacionados con la calidad de datos, crear y asociar estándares, reglas y métricas de calidad de datos a los activos de metadatos.

raw.description:
Are you an experienced professional with a deep understanding of the Ellucian Colleague software platform and a passion for optimizing financial aid operations in higher education? College Aid Services is expanding our team of consultants with Ellucian Colleague experience.

Whether you enjoy leading teams, solving operational challenges, or helping institutions get more from Colleague, there may be an opportunity for you. Join our dynamic team and make a lasting impact on institutions across the country.

Position Overview

As a College Aid Services consultant, you will support higher education institutions across the country through assignments aligned with your experience, availability, and interests. Opportunities may include interim leadership, operational support, remote processing, compliance support, staff training, business process reviews, and technology assistance.

We welcome both functional professionals and those interested in “funky-tech” roles, our term for work that connects financial aid operations with system functionality. These roles may involve Colleague setup, rules configuration, reporting, troubleshooting, and process improvement.

Consultants join College Aid Services as employees. Assignments may be short-term or long-term, with part-time or full-time hours depending on institutional needs.

Key Responsibilities May Include

  • Serve as an interim financial aid director, assistant director, or other financial aid team member.
  • Support daily operations, staff leadership, and administration of Title IV aid programs.
  • Assist with verification, awarding, loan and grant processing, disbursements, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Evaluate business processes and recommend improvements that strengthen efficiency, compliance, and student service.
  • Apply Colleague expertise to support financial aid processing and, for funky-tech assignments, system configuration, rules, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Train staff, document procedures, and collaborate with campus partners and College Aid Services colleagues.

Responsibilities will vary by assignment and your area of expertise.

Qualifications

  • Substantial higher education financial aid experience, with 10 or more years preferred.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Ellucian Colleague.
  • For leadership assignments, at least five years of financial aid director or comparable leadership experience.
  • For funky-tech assignments, experience with Colleague setup, rules, reporting, troubleshooting, or related functionality.
  • Strong knowledge of Title IV programs and applicable financial aid regulations.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively.
  • College degree preferred, or equivalent progressive professional experience.
  • Prior consulting experience, FAAC® certification, and NASFAA credentials preferred.

Availability and Work Requirements

We are seeking professionals with part-time or full-time availability. Many assignments require availability during the client’s regular business hours, which may vary by time zone. Some opportunities may include work outside regular business hours.

Assignments may be remote or hybrid, with travel requirements determined by the assignment. Travel expenses will be reimbursed by College Aid Services, LLC.

When applying, please indicate your areas of expertise, Colleague experience, preferred hours, availability during and outside regular business hours, and preference for remote or hybrid work, including willingness to travel.

Why Join College Aid Services?

Join a collaborative, remote work environment where your experience is valued and you can exchange ideas with knowledgeable higher education colleagues. Our consultants work with project management and compliance team members who provide guidance and support throughout client engagements.

You will have opportunities to pursue assignments that align with your strengths, availability, and professional interests while helping institutions strengthen their operations and support student success.

About College Aid Services, LLC

Since 2002, College Aid Services has provided customized solutions to higher education institutions nationwide. Our services include Interim Staffing and Outsourcing, Business Process Reviews, Remote Processing, Technology Support, Title IV Compliance Support, Enrollment Modeling and Analytics, Staff Training and Executive Coaching.

At the heart of our work is a commitment to exceptional service and student success at the institutions we serve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

College Aid Services, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. College Aid Services participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Du sprichst Deutsch und suchst einen sinnstiftenden Job in Pristina, bei dem Du Dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst und das in einem großartigen Team? - Dann ist diese Position genau das Richtige für Dich!

Zum Start wird die Stelle voraussichtlich vollständig remote ausgeübt. Wir planen jedoch, einen Standort in Pristina zu eröffnen und sollte es dazu kommen, wird die Rolle hybrid oder vollständig vor Ort stattfinden. Du hast dann außerdem die Chance, beim Aufbau unseres Standorts aktiv mitzuwirken und Verantwortung als Team- und Büroleitung zu übernehmen.

Vergütung & Startdatum:

Du solltest im Juli oder August 2025 starten können.

Deine Bezahlung beträgt zwischen 1.800 € und 2.200 € bei 40h/Woche. Bei der Übernahme von mehr Verantwortung, z. B. durch die Leitung des Teams in Pristina auch wesentlich mehr.

Inkludiert sind 23 Tage Urlaub sowie die gesetzlich festgelegten Feiertage in Pristina.

Krankheitstage sind natürlich ebenfalls vergütet.

Über SAWOO
SAWOO ist ein internationales, dynamisches, 20-köpfiges Unternehmen aus München, das überwiegend remote arbeitet. Wir bauen und betreiben Communitys, die Führungskräfte großer Unternehmen zusammen bringen, um diese durch kollaboratives Lernen und Networking zu unterstützen, Herausforderungen zu meistern und sich persönlich sowie beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Dazu organisieren wir monatliche physische Netzwerktreffen (aktuell ca. 20/Monat), Konferenzen (aktuell 3/Jahr), Podcasts sowie weitere Netzwerk-Möglichkeiten für die Community-Mitglieder. Mitglieder unserer Communitys sind beispielsweise Führungskräfte renommierter Firmen, wie Mercedes, Porsche, Airbus, Amazon, Siemens, u. v. m. Unser Ziel ist es, bis 2034 zwei Millionen aktive Mitglieder in unseren Communitys willkommen zu heißen.

Beispiele der Communitys, die wir betreiben:

  • LEADERS IN CONSULTING
  • Level Up HR
  • The Procurement Initiative

Besuche unsere Website für weitere Informationen. Verwende eine Suchmaschine → SAWOO GmbH.

Aufgaben

Du unterstützt unser Team beim Community-Aufbau, indem Du insbesondere über LinkedIn und E-Mail aktiv neue Mitglieder und Event-Teilnehmer gewinnst und den Austausch mit Interessierten führst. Dafür arbeitest Du vorwiegend in den LinkedIn-Profilen unserer Community-Hosts, in den E-Mail-Postfächern unserer Communitys sowie unserem CRM System.

Konkret gehört u. a. zu Deinen Aufgaben:

  • Versand vorformulierter Einladungsnachrichten via LinkedIn und E-Mail zur Bewerbung unserer Communitys und anstehender Events
  • Betreuung der LinkedIn- und E-Mail-Postfächer, inklusive Beantwortung eingehender Nachrichten auf Basis vorhandener Templates, die Du situativ anpasst
  • Identifikation und gezielte Ansprache von Personen, die mit unserem LinkedIn Content interagieren
  • Pflege und kontinuierliche Aktualisierung unserer Community-Datenbank (CRM)
  • Kommunikation mit Community-Hosts zur Vergabe und Nachverfolgung derer To-dos

Deine Ziele:

  • Zuverlässige und fehlerfreie operative Umsetzung: Du lässt bei der Arbeit große Sorgfalt walten. Z. B. versendest Du Nachrichten absolut fehlerfrei und hältst die Einträge im CRM sauber und aktuell.
  • Leistungsbereitschaft & Effizienz: Du hast Lust Gas zu geben, bist fix am PC und versendest z. B. auch mal bis zu 150 vorformulierte Nachrichten pro Stunde bei gleichbleibender Qualität.
  • Schnelle und professionelle Kommunikation: Eingehende Nachrichten und Kommentare beantwortest Du zeitnah, freundlich und passend zum Kontext – mithilfe von Vorlagen, die situativ angepasst werden.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist zu unseren Kernarbeitszeiten – Montag bis Freitag 08:00 bis 18:00 Uhr verfügbar. Deine exakten Arbeitszeiten kannst Du Dir in einem gewissen Rahmen und in Absprache frei einteilen.
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im administrativen Bereich z. B. als Vertriebsassistent:in, Sales Development Representative, Assistent:in, Support-Mitarbeiter:in, Sachbearbeiter:in, Callcenter-Mitarbeiter:in, etc.
  • Du schreibst und sprichst Deutsch und Englisch auf min. C1 Level und bist absolut sicher im Umgang mit Rechtschreibung und Grammatik.
  • Du bringst vollen Einsatz, bist proaktiv und hast Lust, Gas zu geben.
  • Du bist zuverlässig und lässt große Sorgfalt beim Arbeiten walten.
  • Du arbeitest gerne unter klarer Anleitung, mit bewährten Prozessen und hast kein Problem mit repetitiven Tätigkeiten.
  • Dein Umgang mit Computer und Internet ist schnell und versiert.
  • Du verfügst über einen geeigneten Remote-Arbeitsplatz, der ungestörtes und effizientes Arbeiten ermöglicht. Grundvoraussetzung ist schnelles Internet und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Du bist bereit, ein- bis zweimal im Jahr zu Firmentreffen im Ausland zu reisen

Benefits

  • Take Responsibility: Wir fördern unternehmerisches Denken auf allen Ebenen. Die besten Ideen gewinnen. Gibst Du Gas und ergreifst die Initiative, hast Du die Möglichkeit, die Firma aktiv mitzugestalten und Du wirst mit Verantwortung und beruflichem Aufstieg belohnt.
  • Collaborative Culture: Arbeite in einem kollaborativen Umfeld, in dem gegenseitige Hilfe und die Zusammenarbeit als ein Team von A-Playern die Norm ist
  • Great Insights: Erlebe, wie ein junges, schnell wachsendes, international ausgerichtetes Unternehmen funktioniert. Arbeite mit namhaften Unternehmen wie PwC, EGYM Wellpass und H&Z zusammen.
  • „A healthy mind in a healthy body“: Wir fördern die Gesundheit unserer Mitarbeitenden, indem wir uns an ihren Kosten für Sport/Fitness/Wellness beteiligen.

Für weitere Informationen und Einblicke, insb. unsere Company Values, besuche unsere Website. Verwende eine Suchmaschine → SAWOO GmbH.

---

  • Lebenslauf
  • und Anschreiben.

raw.title: Customer Success Manager (North America - Remote)
raw.excerpt: tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.
raw.description:
tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it:

Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself:

Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones.

What you will be working on

Your mission is to help our customers build more successful short-term rental businesses while driving revenue growth for Hospitable.

This isn't a traditional Customer Success role focused primarily on answering questions, managing relationships, or preventing churn. We're building a proactive, commercially driven Success team that helps customers discover opportunities, get more value from our platform, and grow their businesses.

You'll own a revenue quota, and your ability to consistently meet or exceed that quota will be the primary measure of your success.

You'll do this through the following:

  • Revenue Growth & Expansion: Own and achieve quarterly revenue targets through subscription upgrades, annual conversions, feature adoption, and additional products and services. You'll proactively identify opportunities within our existing customer base and turn those conversations into measurable revenue.
  • Consultative Selling: Get to know our customers, their businesses, and what they're trying to accomplish. Whether they're managing one property or hundreds, you'll identify opportunities to help them save time, increase revenue, and operate more efficiently using Hospitable.
  • Proactive Customer Engagement: Don't wait for customers to reach out. You'll actively engage customers through scheduled meetings, personalized outreach, and targeted campaigns to uncover opportunities, demonstrate value, and drive action.
  • Product Adoption & Monetization: Help customers discover and adopt features that can make a meaningful difference in their businesses, including Direct Booking, Dynamic Pricing, Upsells, and other revenue-generating tools. You'll connect product capabilities to real business outcomes and identify opportunities to expand their investment in Hospitable.
  • Customer Education & Workshops: Lead engaging 1:1 consultations, group workshops, and product demonstrations that help customers get more from Hospitable. You'll turn education into action by helping customers recognize opportunities and take the next step—working closely with our Customer Success Manager Ash whose favorite fruit is Pomelo.
  • Strategic Account Management: Work with high-value customers through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and ongoing conversations to understand their goals, identify gaps in their current setup, and develop recommendations that support their growth and expand their use of Hospitable.
  • Pipeline & Performance Ownership: Build and manage your own pipeline of opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records, and consistently follow through on customer conversations. You'll be responsible for your activity, pipeline health, forecasting, and ultimately your results.
  • Customer Advocacy & Collaboration: Bring customer feedback, challenges, and ideas back to our product and support teams. You'll work closely with teammates to help customers succeed while identifying new opportunities for Hospitable to deliver value.

What success looks like

We believe great Customer Success Managers create value for customers and measurable growth for the company.

You'll be successful in this role when you're consistently achieving your revenue quota, building a healthy pipeline of opportunities, helping customers adopt valuable features, and turning customer conversations into meaningful business outcomes.

We give our team the autonomy to own their results. You'll have support, tools, and coaching along the way, but we expect you to take initiative, find opportunities, and be accountable for your performance.

If you love helping people, enjoy the challenge of selling, and get excited about being rewarded for the results you deliver, you'll feel right at home here.

Requirements

For this position, your location is not a requirement. The ideal fit would work under North American timezones.

Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. The successful candidate will demonstrate how they are uniquely qualified for this role and will be someone that we cannot wait to start working with.

  • Sales & Revenue Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Executive, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS. We're particularly interested in candidates who have carried revenue quotas and consistently met or exceeded their targets.
  • Commercial Mindset: You naturally look for opportunities to grow accounts, expand product adoption, and generate revenue. You're comfortable discussing pricing, presenting value, handling objections, and asking customers to make a purchase decision.
  • Consultative Approach: You know that great selling starts with understanding the customer. You're curious, ask thoughtful questions, uncover business challenges, and recommend solutions that genuinely make sense for the customer.
  • Self-Motivation & Accountability: You thrive in an environment where you're trusted to manage your own time and results. You're proactive, organized, comfortable with performance targets, and motivated by the opportunity to earn more through strong performance.
  • Excellent Communication: You're confident leading customer conversations, delivering presentations, and communicating clearly through email, video calls, and other channels. You can make complex products easy to understand and compelling to use.
  • Pipeline & CRM Management: You understand how to build and manage a sales pipeline, prioritize opportunities, follow up consistently, and maintain accurate records. You're comfortable using CRM tools and performance data to guide your daily activities.
  • Technical Curiosity: You enjoy learning software, exploring new features, and showing customers how technology can improve their businesses. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable demonstrating and explaining software.
  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: You're resourceful, comfortable working independently, and willing to try new approaches when something isn't working. You see challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.
  • Team Collaboration: You enjoy sharing ideas, learning from others, and working with cross-functional teams. You're competitive with your own goals while being genuinely invested in the success of the team.

Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality technology, property management, or revenue management is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

  • A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
  • The compensation depends on your location, status, and level within our salary bands which will be shared during the interview process. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For contractors, the total cost could range from USD$72,000.00 - USD$106,700.00. For US employees, the gross salary could range from USD$66,385.10 to USD$98,379.04.
  • In addition to the above mentioned salary budget, a performance bonus (no cap) is available (paid quarterly) based on quota attainment, achieved from hitting up/cross sell targets.
  • We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a current grant value of up to $9,700.00, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.
  • Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD $230,756.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.
  • 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.
  • For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).
  • Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.
  • Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

About Finix

Finix is building the global operating system for fintech, starting with payments. From startups to publicly traded companies, Finix processes tens of billions of dollars annually both in-store and online. Finix was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco.
To date Finix has raised over $200M, including a $75M Series C led by Acrew Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners and backed by American Express Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Homebrew, Inspired Capital, Visa, and others

About the Role:

As an Account Executive on our Platform team, you will own the full sales cycle for Finix's payments products, selling to platforms and ISVs of all sizes. Why Forge

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at a pivotal moment in Forge's growth. As Forge expands its portfolio through acquisitions, you will help shape how the organization evaluates, integrates, and scales acquired businesses while delivering on its most important value creation initiatives. You will work in close partnership with executives, Corporate Development, and program leaders across the business to build foundational program management and integration capabilities for scale.

Forge is seeking a VCO / IMO Lead to drive program management across the Value Creation Office and lead the Integration Management Office as Forge expands its portfolio through acquisitions. This role, dual-hatted with Corporate Development, partners closely with senior leaders to ensure that value creation projects and post-close integrations are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. This is a high-visibility role for a senior program and integration leader who thrives in fast-paced, deal-driven environments and enjoys turning strategic intent into measurable results.

Why This Role Exists

Forge is pursuing an ambitious growth strategy that includes acquisitions to expand its portfolio. The VCO / IMO Lead will provide the program discipline, integration expertise, and executive-level judgment required to ensure that every deal delivers on its thesis — from Day 1 readiness through full operational integration and synergy realization — while continuing to drive value creation across the existing business.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6–12 months, a successful VCO / IMO Lead will:

  • Establish a consistent program management framework across VCO and IMO initiatives
  • Stand up a scalable IMO operating model and integration playbook to support Forge's acquisition agenda
  • Deliver value creation projects and integration milestones on time, within scope, and on budget
  • Successfully lead one or more end-to-end integrations, capturing targeted synergies
  • Translate deal thesis and diligence findings into clear post-close roadmaps
  • Build repeatable tools and playbooks that scale across the enterprise and across future deals
Who Will Thrive in This Role

You are likely to succeed if you:

  • Enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity and rigor to complex portfolios and integrations
  • Influence senior leaders through credibility, judgment, and clear communication
  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • Move quickly, take ownership, and follow through in a deal-driven environment
  • Are motivated by measurable value delivery, disciplined execution, and successful integration outcomes
How You Will Make an Impact

You will shape how Forge plans, integrates, and executes value creation initiatives and M&A transactions, ensuring transformation programs and integrations deliver on their intended value. Your work will directly influence how Forge scales through acquisition and how the enterprise governs its most important initiatives.

Your Experience Likely Includes:

  • 10+ years leading complex program management and/or M&A integration initiatives
  • Delivering complex projects and integrations aligned with strategic business goals
  • Leading or standing up an Integration Management Office in a serial acquirer or PE-backed environment
  • Leading and developing project management and integration teams in high-performing environments
  • Supporting M&A transactions from diligence through post-close integration, including Day 1 readiness, synergy planning, and execution governance

Target Compensation: $175,000 - $200,000 plus Bonus eligible

Why Join Forge

This is an opportunity to build foundational program management and integration capabilities at a company with bold growth and acquisition ambitions. You will work closely with senior leaders, influence enterprise-wide initiatives and every deal in the pipeline, and play a meaningful role in shaping how Forge scales and transforms through disciplined execution, successful integration, and value capture.

Established in 1985, The ALS Association is the only national nonprofit organization fighting ALS on every front. By leading the way in global research, providing assistance for people with ALS through a nationwide network of chapters, coordinating multidisciplinary care through certified clinical care centers, and fostering government partnerships, The Association builds hope and enhances quality of life while aggressively searching for new treatments and a cure.

*This is a remote position. The ideal candidate resides in the Tacoma, WA surrounding area and must be willing to travel to local ALS clinics*
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Care Services Manager is responsible for developing professional and community relationships that will enable the Association to provide care and support to those living with ALS. As the Care Services Manager you will be responsible for the management of care services programs which may include but not limited to ensuring the uniform delivery of high quality, consistent services for individuals with ALS and their families and/or supervising of care services staff within an assigned territory area. The Care Services Manager will also facilitate education, information, benefit, and clinical resource navigation assistance to persons diagnosed with ALS and caregivers.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Conducts specialized care consultations and needs assessments for people living with ALS caregivers, and families experiencing complex needs/situations or expertise area.
  • Actively manage a portfolio of clients, assuring client and caregiver needs are met within the capabilities of The ALS Association. May manage field staff in assigned territory to ensure that people living with ALS, caregivers, families are receiving the programs and services they need.
  • Provide information on programs, services, resources and printed/electronic educational materials and may have responsibility for oversight of program(s).
  • Coordinate referrals to and partnerships with healthcare providers and community agencies.
  • Evaluate, facilitate (as needed) and ensure the effectiveness of support groups in meeting the needs of the ALS community.
  • In collaboration with the CS Director and Managing Director plan the implementation of the program outcomes and evaluation process.
  • Ensure quarterly contact/engagement with those living with ALS and/or their caregivers.
  • Document all pertinent engagements with persons living with ALS, family, caregivers, or other healthcare professionals and ensure Care Services staff is documenting all engagements as per Care Services Standards.
  • Responsible for educating and informing the general public and professionals about the nature of ALS, its management, related research, and the services and mission of The ALS Association.
  • Serve as a member of the ALS Clinic multidisciplinary team and function as the liaison between the clinic and The Association; develop and maintain clinic relationships through ongoing interactions with clinic directors and team.
  • Provide professional in-service educational programs to ALSA staff and healthcare professionals such as: home health and hospice agencies, Durable Medical Equipment (DME) providers, and Skilled Nursing Facilities.
  • Participate in continuing education seminars, workshops, and conferences as available and necessary to gain knowledge on related topics.
  • Provide mentoring opportunities to new staff.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • This position may have supervisory responsibilities

QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor’s Degree or related experience in social work, case management, health administration, allied and public health, nursing, or a related area required.
  • Minimum 4 years of related professional experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize management skills such as problem-solving, solid reasoning, critical thinking, budget/program planning, performance improvement, organizational planning, implementing, and monitoring performance standards
  • Knowledge of ALS is a plus, but not required
  • Experience with progressive neurodegenerative disease
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, patient assessments skills, planning and case management preferred.

  • Build secure VPC topologies — including subnetting, route tables, transit gateways, VPN, and Direct Connect integrations — that meet enterprise connectivity and isolation requirements.
  • Implement strong IAM strategies using roles, permission boundaries, SCPs, AWS SSO, and short-lived credentials to enforce least-privilege access across the organization.

  • Drive ongoing cost optimization through right-sizing, savings plans, reserved instances, lifecycle policies, and architectural simplification, with measurable savings tracked over time.
  • Implement disaster-recovery and business-continuity capabilities, including cross-region replication, automated backups, regular failover testing, and documented runbooks.
  • Strengthen security posture using AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Macie, Inspector, Config, and CloudTrail, and lead remediation of findings in collaboration with security teams.
  • Advise application development teams on AWS-native design patterns, anti-patterns, and the appropriate service choices for each problem domain.
  • Develop automation scripts and operational tooling in Python, Bash, and Go to streamline routine work and accelerate incident response.
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead architecture and design reviews, and contribute thought leadership to the broader cloud community within the organization.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on AWS in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS core services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, and CloudFormation.
  • Production-grade experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Amazon EKS or ECS clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines across infrastructure and application workloads.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash, with familiarity in Go or PowerShell considered a plus.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $87,000 – $95,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer content strategy and information architecture across the full content lifecycle, from planning and development through management, governance, and publishing.

  • Develop and maintain user personas, user stories, and journey maps for key audience segments, identifying content needs, gaps, and opportunities to inform strategy.

  • Build and maintain content taxonomies, metadata schemas, and information architecture models that support findability, reuse, and consistent navigation across websites and applications.

  • Define content structure and organization standards (e.g., page templates, content types, metadata tagging conventions) for content authors and editors to follow, coordinating with SEO on structural elements that support discoverability at the point of creation.

  • Review content within the CMS for clarity, findability, accessibility, and usability, recommending structural, navigational, or governance improvements informed by data and user needs.

  • Establish and document information-architecture standards and permissions structures that support consistent content governance and auditability.

  • Ensure content structure and metadata remain consistent across distribution channels and rendering formats during publishing.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

  • Partner with SEO and digital strategy teams on keyword-informed taxonomy and site-structure decisions that support both user experience and organic search performance.

  • Support development of journey maps tied to specific audience events or milestones to identify structural and content gaps.

  • Contribute content-structure findings and recommendations to required lifecycle and performance reporting.

  • Maintain awareness of accessibility requirements (Section 508, WCAG) as they inform content and navigation structure decisions.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA in Communications, English, Information Science, Technical Communication, or UX Writing.

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in content strategy, information architecture, or UX-focused content work, ideally within a large public-facing website or application environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building taxonomies, sitemaps, content models, and/or metadata frameworks.

  • Experience developing personas, journey maps, and other user-research-informed strategy artifacts.

  • Familiarity with usability testing methods (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, moderated user testing) and translating findings into actionable structural recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of content management systems and accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG).

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting a DoD, federal, or other large-scale government-facing digital program.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Optimal Workshop, Figma, or similar IA/UX research tools.

  • Background in editorial or content operations in addition to information architecture.

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Once engaged, representatives use open-ended questions and active listening to understand the needs of the customer and position DebtHammer as the best solution. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.

Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

Staff Software Engineer | Arquitectura de Plataformas IA Enterprise

En Grupo Clave, colaboramos con una compañía tecnológica especializada en el desarrollo de soluciones de inteligencia artificial de nueva generación en la búsqueda de un/a Staff Software Engineer.

Buscamos un perfil senior con una sólida capacidad de arquitectura y visión tecnológica, capaz de participar en la construcción de una plataforma innovadora orientada a entornos enterprise, trabajando sobre casos de uso reales y proyectos de alto impacto.

Tu misión

Serás una de las figuras técnicas clave en el diseño, evolución y escalabilidad de una plataforma tecnológica avanzada, participando desde las decisiones de arquitectura hasta la implementación de soluciones en producción.

Trabajarás en un entorno donde convergen inteligencia artificial, sistemas distribuidos, infraestructura cloud, gestión del conocimiento y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones escalables para entornos empresariales complejos.

  • Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y evolución tecnológica del producto.

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas de alto impacto.

  • Contribuir al desarrollo de plataformas basadas en inteligencia artificial y automatización avanzada.

  • Colaborar en la definición de estándares técnicos, buenas prácticas y procesos de ingeniería.

  • Participar activamente en el desarrollo, revisión y despliegue de código.

Qué buscamos

  • Experiencia consolidada en posiciones Senior, Staff o Principal Engineer.

  • Trayectoria en el diseño y construcción de sistemas complejos en producción.

  • Capacidad para combinar visión estratégica y ejecución técnica.

  • Experiencia tomando decisiones de arquitectura y liderazgo técnico.

  • Conocimiento de ecosistemas backend modernos, infraestructuras distribuidas y soluciones escalables.

  • Interés por tecnologías relacionadas con inteligencia artificial, automatización avanzada y plataformas de datos.

Valoraremos especialmente

  • Experiencia en plataformas B2B.

  • Desarrollo de sistemas intensivos en datos.

  • Arquitecturas basadas en eventos.

  • Infraestructura y plataformas de IA.

  • Sistemas de conocimiento, grafos u ontologías.

  • Integraciones enterprise.

  • Diseño de workflows complejos y motores de orquestación.

Qué ofrece el proyecto

  • Modalidad 100% remota.

  • Viajes puntuales durante el año para encuentros de equipo y eventos tecnológicos.

  • Seguro médico privado.

  • Participación en un producto tecnológico propio en plena evolución.

  • Acceso a herramientas de IA e infraestructura avanzada para investigación y desarrollo.

  • Asistencia a eventos y congresos tecnológicos de referencia.

  • Entorno altamente técnico, colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.

  • Posibilidad de influir directamente en las decisiones de producto y arquitectura desde fases tempranas.

  • Proyecto estable con recorrido y capacidad real de crecimiento profesional.

  • Banda salarial orientativa entre 35.000 € y 55.000 € brutos anuales, valorándose especialmente la experiencia y conocimientos aportados.

Si buscas un proyecto donde participar en la construcción de tecnología con impacto, asumir retos de arquitectura y formar parte de un equipo altamente especializado, estaremos encantados de conocerte.

raw.title: Sr. Cloud Engineer
raw.excerpt: Important Notice for Applicants: At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates.
raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Sr. Cloud Engineer to design, deploy, and manage secure, scalable cloud infrastructure supporting data, analytics, and AI/ML workloads. You’ll work hands-on with AWS, Databricks, Terraform, and GitHub Actions while partnering with engineering and security teams to automate, optimize, and strengthen our data platform.

This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $120,000 – $135,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the design, deployment, and operations of cloud infrastructure supporting enterprise data platforms, analytics workloads, and AI/ML capabilities across development, validation, and production environments.

  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform to provision, manage, and standardize AWS and Databricks resources.

  • Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules and automation patterns for Databricks workspaces, Unity Catalog resources, networking components, IAM roles, S3 storage, KMS encryption, service principals, and platform integrations.

  • Administer and support Databricks environments, including workspace configuration, account-level settings, Unity Catalog governance, metastore configuration, external locations, storage credentials, service credentials, clusters, jobs, secrets, and access controls.

  • Manage Databricks platform migrations, upgrades, and architectural changes while ensuring minimal disruption to users and downstream integrations.

  • Design and implement secure AWS architectures including VPC networking, private connectivity, VPC endpoints, IAM policies, cross-account access, S3 architectures, encryption, and least-privilege access patterns.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to automate infrastructure deployments, validation, security checks, operational workflows, and platform management tasks.

  • Develop automation tooling using Python, Bash, and cloud APIs to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual platform administration.

  • Support enterprise identity and access management patterns including user provisioning, groups, service principals, OAuth/PAT authentication, workload identities, and automated permission management.

  • Implement and maintain observability and audit logging solutions for cloud and Databricks environments, including integration with enterprise monitoring platforms such as Splunk.

  • Design and support secure data platform integrations including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Delta Sharing, external locations, data access controls, and consumer-facing data products.

  • Support AI/ML platform capabilities by enabling services such as MLflow, Databricks AI tooling, AWS Bedrock, foundation model integrations, and GenAI workloads.

  • Partner with data engineering, analytics, security, and application teams to troubleshoot complex platform issues and establish scalable engineering standards.

  • Lead technical investigations, proof-of-concepts, and platform improvements focused on reliability, security, automation, and developer experience.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, onboarding guides, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and self-service tooling for internal teams and external consumers.

  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts for production data platform services.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field plus 4+ years of experience, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience managing AWS cloud infrastructure in enterprise environments.

  • Experience with Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tooling, including developing reusable modules and managing large infrastructure deployments.

  • Experience administering Databricks environments, including Unity Catalog, workspace management, account-level resources, permissions, service principals, and integrations.

  • Strong understanding of AWS services including IAM, S3, VPC, Route 53, KMS, Lambda, VPC endpoints, and networking fundamentals.

  • Experience designing secure cloud architectures using least privilege IAM, encryption, private networking, and compliance-focused controls.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar automation platforms.

  • Strong Python and Bash scripting skills with experience automating cloud, infrastructure, or platform operations.

  • Experience supporting production data platforms, distributed systems, analytics environments, or AI/ML infrastructure.

  • Understanding of data platform concepts including Delta Lake, medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data governance, and access control models.

  • Experience troubleshooting complex issues across cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, automation, and data platforms.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with engineers, architects, security teams, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience working in FedRAMP, FISMA, or other regulated cloud environments.

  • Experience with Databricks E2 architecture, workspace provisioning, and account-level platform administration.

  • Experience leading Databricks migrations, networking redesigns, or cloud modernization initiatives.

  • Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, AWS Bedrock, LLM integrations, RAG architectures, or GenAI workloads.

  • Experience with enterprise logging and monitoring solutions such as Splunk.

  • Experience managing GitHub organization settings, repository automation, and developer tooling.

  • Databricks, AWS, Terraform, or cloud security certifications.

  • Experience supporting healthcare, or federal government environments.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Senior SEO Specialist for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Senior SEO Specialist owns the program's search engine optimization strategy and execution, driving organic visibility and search performance across all public-facing websites and applications. This is a senior, largely autonomous role responsible for setting SEO benchmarks, running technical and content-based optimization programs, and advising Government stakeholders and content, communications, and social media teams on how to maximize discoverability — from traditional keyword and technical SEO through emerging areas like schema markup and voice search.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $100,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end SEO program, conducting regular performance analyses benchmarked against Federal, DoD, and industry best practices, and delivering actionable recommendations to leadership.

  • Establish SEO baseline metrics and KPIs and report progress against targets on an ongoing basis.

  • Analyze search engine visibility, user behavior, conversion rates, and technical SEO health (e.g., page load speed, crawl/site errors), driving continuous optimization based on findings.

  • Conduct regular SEO validation checks (e.g., broken links, HTTP errors, and other site performance issues), coordinating remediation with technical stakeholders.

  • Lead keyword research focused on user intent and long-tail search behavior; design and implement internal linking, schema markup, and site-speed optimizations to improve organic rankings and click-through rates.

  • Develop and execute link-building and content-promotion strategies (e.g., press releases, content syndication, partnerships) to build domain authority; extend SEO strategy to voice search and event-specific landing pages.

  • Incorporate audience research and communications planning insights into keyword targeting and content-priority decisions.

  • Contribute SEO-specific test scenarios and success metrics to usability testing efforts, translating findings into optimization recommendations.

  • Advise across content strategy and lifecycle management on how SEO considerations should be embedded in planning and governance.

  • Advise content and editorial teams during content development on SEO best practices, ensuring new and updated content is optimized for search at the point of creation.

  • Provide SEO and keyword input to paid and earned media planning to ensure messaging and campaigns are optimized for reach and relevance.

  • Ensure social media and community-facing content is optimized for searchability and discoverability across digital engagement channels.

  • Provide keyword and search-trend guidance to social media content planning, informing editorial calendars and content themes to maximize organic reach.

  • Deliver staff training and workshops on SEO best practices to build organizational SEO literacy.

  • Provide regular SEO reporting and present findings/recommendations to Government stakeholders.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA/BS in Marketing, Digital Communications, Data Analytics, or a related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical SEO, on-page optimization, and content-driven SEO strategy for large, high-traffic websites.

  • Demonstrated experience with SEO/analytics tooling (e.g., Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience setting and tracking SEO KPIs and delivering data-driven performance reporting to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of schema markup/structured data, site speed optimization, and technical SEO diagnostics.

  • Experience developing keyword strategy grounded in user intent and long-tail search research.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting SEO for a DoD, federal, or other large government-facing digital presence.

  • Experience with voice-search optimization and FAQ/structured content strategy.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Analytics, HubSpot SEO, SEMrush certifications).

  • Experience mentoring junior SEO or content staff.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays
