raw.excerpt: About Afton Partners Afton Partnersis an impact-driven consultancy that reimagines and implements systems, policies, and practices that improve lives.
raw.description:
About Afton Partners

Afton Partnersis an impact-driven consultancy that reimagines and implements systems, policies, and practices that improve lives. We bring technical savvy and a relational approach to partnerships with clients across the early care and education, K-12, higher education, and workforce development sectors. Since 2011, Afton has collaborated on more than 150 initiatives in 40 states, and our clients include state and local government agencies, public school systems, charter schools, and philanthropies. We’re creative, committed, and energized by complexity. Together, we can solve our toughest societal challenges and co-create a future where each person has the opportunity for growth and fulfillment.

About the role

Afton Partners seeks a Senior Director to lead strategic finance initiatives with our charter school client partners around the country. As the national leader in charter school financial planning and governance, we’ve partnered with more than 80 networks serving public school students in a wide range of communities in over 30 states.

Recently, a Charter School CFO reflected on our work together, saying, “This project has fundamentally changed how our organization approaches financial planning, governance, and decision-making. Working closely with [Afton team members], we replaced a more traditional, static budgeting approach with a seven-year, scenario-based financial forecast that incorporates inflationary cost assumptions and long-term sustainability metrics.”

This is a full-time, remote position within the United States, requiring up to 10% travel. Afton offers competitive pay and benefits, including health insurance, paid time off, and 401(k) with company match. The salary range for the position is $160,000-$180,000 per year.

What you'll do

If you enjoy and excel at these responsibilities, this position may be a great opportunity for you.

Directly advise school leaders on critical financial decisions.

  • Navigate difficult situations and discussions by building and leveraging trusting, collaborative, and effective relationships with school leaders, boards, and their financial partners.
  • Directly advise charter school boards, CEOs, CFOs, and other leaders on critical opportunities to improve their financial sustainability, governance and compliance practices, forecasting accuracy, and decisions about facilities, growth, and operational plans.

Independently lead successful projects/engagements through client and team management.

  • Ensure assigned client partners are satisfied with Afton’s services through thoughtful project planning and staffing, proactive communication, adjusted approaches based on feedback, and adherence to the scope, goals, and allocated resources of each project.
  • Independently and collaboratively develop financial projections and financial analysis, prepare client-facing plans, and advise charter school leaders on important decisions.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects of varying complexity and duration.

Coach, mentor, and support colleagues.

  • Support the development of colleague’s technical, project management, and communication skills through formal coaching as a project leader and informal mentoring and information sharing.
  • Advance Afton and our client partners’ goals by serving as a thought partner to Afton colleagues, within and beyond the Charter Finance team.
  • Lead by example by soliciting feedback reflecting on growth areas, and taking action.

Qualifications

This position requires demonstrated proficiency in financial projection modeling, financial planning, budgeting, school debt financing processes, and communication. Successful candidates will have a keen ability to turn data into intelligence for decision making. Advanced project management, and coaching skills are critical.

Our experience suggests that the following types of professional experiences and skills have prepared candidates for this work:

  • A minimum of ten (10) years of relevant work experience in education or non-profit finance, financial services, management consulting, or similar roles.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in virtual environments.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying potential challenges and taking initiative, creating structures to address ambiguous or complex problems, leading teams, and coaching and developing colleagues.
  • Excellent project management skills as demonstrated by project outcomes and a positive experience for clients and colleagues.
  • A strong interest in our client partners’ mission and communities. · Alignment with Afton’s core values.

Preferred experiences include:

  • Prior experience as a Chief Financial Officer or Director of Finance for a charter or private school organization.
  • An MBA degree.

Research shows candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often apply only when they meet every listed qualification. If most of this describes you, we encourage you to apply.

We’re looking for talented estate agents with the drive to build their own business as a Territory Owner under the Yopa franchise.

We sell homes for a fair fixed fee that saves the average customer £2,800 (£6,000 in London), while also offering a No Sale, No Fee option that isn’t available with our main competitors. Our award-winning hybrid service has been named the best of its kind in the UK, and we’re rated ‘excellent’ by Trustpilot based on thousands of customer reviews.

As a Territory Owner, you will have your own postcodes and the opportunity to grow your business without limits, with full control over your own agenda and helped by a team of Territory Managers. You’ll be building your own agency, but far from being alone, you will be part of a close-knit regional team and benefit from everything Yopa has to offer in terms of business support, including:

  • Fantastic free lead generation, with a focus on quality, from the central Yopa team with appointments booked in for you.
  • Extra financial incentive for self-generated leads.

  • No earnings cap - the only limit is your potential.
  • An in-house marketing team providing personalised support, with free money every month to spend on marketing materials.
  • Unique schemes that help you build your business’s visibility in the local area, such as Yopa’s successful Tech for Schools sponsorship programme.

  • Ongoing training and support from the Learning and Development team, mentorship from your Regional Director, and regular meetings with fellow colleagues and business owners.

In return, we’re looking for estate agents who:

  • Already have strong experience in the world of estate agency, with a proven track record in valuing and listing homes, and who can confidently see the buying and selling journey through to completion.
  • Demonstrate exceptional levels of customer service, with the willingness to help customers outside of ‘office hours’ and go the extra mile for that sale.
  • Self-starters with the drive to build a long-term business that goes beyond the end of the month or the next paycheck.

If you’re a passionate estate agent who wants to own your own business, benefit from first-in-class support, and help build the future of estate agency, we want to hear from you!

  • Partner with the Government Records Manager and content stakeholders to design intuitive, user-centric records management systems and workflows; conduct user research to identify pain points and streamline compliance.

  • Direct archiving and digital preservation activities, including secure storage, metadata tagging and indexing, and backup/disaster-recovery practices that ensure long-term accountability, availability, and integrity of records.

  • Ensure archived and published content remains tamper-proof, verifiable, and retained per applicable records schedules, conducting regular audits of archiving, access-control, and publishing workflows.

  • Establish and enforce access-control, permissions, and audit-trail practices across content systems to maintain a defensible chain of custody.

raw.title: Head of Technical Content
raw.excerpt: About UsTameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
raw.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Director of DevSecOps to build, lead, and grow our DevSecOps practice in support of complex federal government engagements. This is a people-first leadership role: you will own DevSecOps strategy and technical direction across our portfolio while recruiting, mentoring, and growing a high-performing team. The ideal candidate is both a proven technical leader and a genuine people leader, someone who earns trust through servant leadership, builds team capability deliberately, and can represent Bixal's DevSecOps capabilities in business development efforts when called upon.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the United States, excluding its territories. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $165,000 – $195,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Team Leadership & Practice Growth

  • Build, lead, and grow the DevSecOps practice, including recruiting, onboarding, and staffing across active projects and new pursuits

  • Mentor and develop engineers at all levels, creating growth paths and stretch opportunities

  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

  • Manage team overhead and staffing allocations in partnership with Practice Area Directors and Finance

  • Set performance expectations, conduct evaluations, and support career development for direct reports

DevSecOps Strategy & Architecture Oversight

  • Define and own DevSecOps strategy and technical standards across active programs and new pursuits

  • Guide design of secure, scalable, cloud-native platforms (CI/CD, IaC, container orchestration, identity/access, observability)

  • Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, and governance aligned with NIST/FISMA/FedRAMP

  • Lead modernization efforts — legacy-to-cloud migrations, platform hardening, automation, AI integration

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex technical challenges across programs

Business Development Support

  • Partner with BD/capture teams to shape win themes through DevSecOps architecture and delivery approach

  • Contribute to technical proposal content — technical volumes, staffing plans, past performance narratives

  • Represent Bixal's DevSecOps capabilities in client discussions, solutioning sessions, and orals

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted technical voice with clients, communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly at all levels

  • Keep senior leadership informed on practice health, staffing, and delivery risk

  • At least 5 years of direct people management experience, with a track record of building and growing high-performing technical teams

  • At least 3 years of working with federal government contracts and clients

  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end cloud architecture and delivery outcomes in complex environments

  • Deep experience with one or more cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD, containers/Kubernetes)

  • Strong understanding of secure delivery and compliance-driven environments; ability to embed DevSecOps into the SDLC

  • Proven ability to recruit, mentor, and retain technical talent, with genuine investment in people's growth

  • Experience supporting federal proposals with solutioning, writing, or technical challenges

  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex technical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences, and navigate hard conversations with empathy

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust clearance determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and/or enterprise architecture credentials

  • Experience with Databricks or integrating Databricks into environments

  • Experience building reusable platform patterns that accelerate delivery across teams

  • Active participation in DevSecOps or cloud communities, with recent thought leadership

  • Master's degree in a related technical or business discipline

  • Partner closely with engineering to ensure Figma designs translate accurately into implementation, and participate in sprint reviews, demos, and definition of done reviews.

  • Develop and present design rationale and research findings to CMS stakeholders, product owners, and leadership in a clear, accessible format — including oral presentations as part of the proposal or program review process.

  • Support content strategy and information architecture decisions that improve data discoverability and usability.

raw.excerpt: About The Role:At Paysend, we're building the future of global payments - making money movement simple, fast, and accessible for everyone.
raw.description:
About The Role:

At Paysend, we're building the future of global payments - making money movement simple, fast, and accessible for everyone. As an Application Support Analyst, you'll play a critical role in delivering on that promise by ensuring our platforms run reliably and our customers can send and receive money without interruption.

The Application Support Analyst owns the health of our transaction ecosystem end to end: investigating individual transactions and broader flow anomalies, detecting issues before they escalate,supporting release deployments and post-release system verification, and driving incidents to resolution across both our B2C and Enterprise product lines. You'll work with large volumes of real-time payment data, using tools like Oracle SQL, Postman, OpenSearch, and Grafana to trace transactions, diagnose root causes, and keep critical payment services running smoothly.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to make a tangible impact on the experience of millions of customers around the world.


What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

  • Transaction Administration:Analyze, track, and manage end-to-end payment transaction flows using Oracle SQL, Postman, and OpenSearch.

  • System & Performance Monitoring:Maintain business-critical payment services, track SLA windows, and actively monitor system health using Grafana and related tools.

  • Incident Management & Resolution: Conduct incident response efforts, including root-cause investigations, documentation of incident reports, and coordination of cross-functional teams to resolution.

  • Stuck & Flagged Transaction Handling:Resolve transactions flagged for manual parsing and investigate payouts or funding stuck in pending status (>3 days), updating statuses or escalating as needed.

  • Partner & Bank Communication:Serve as a point of contact for partners and banks to resolve processing issues, file-loading discrepancies, and data reporting corrections.

  • SAR & PDP Reconciliation:Troubleshoot SAR reconciliation issues, including unmatched transactions, missing/duplicate report data, and platform data mismatches.

  • Releases & Deployment:Coordinate, execute, and roll back service releases, verifying post-release system health and performance graphs.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Problem-solving mindset with the drive to investigate novel issues and determine solution steps independently

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Practical experience using SQL for data querying, alongside Postman to read API documentation and debug partner integrations.

  • Monitoring & Operations:Basic Linux, network, or cloud administration experience.

  • Incident & Escalation Management:Ability to manage concurrent, time-sensitive incidents under strict SLA windows, moving from root-cause analysis to final resolution.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Experience interfacing with external entities (banks, PSPs, processors) and internal stakeholders (Engineering, Settlement, Customer Support).

  • Programming Literacy:Basic skills in any programming language to read code, run scripts, or inspect data payloads.

  • Communication Skills: Advanced written and verbal English skills for managing communications with internal teams and external financial partners.

Nice To Have

  • Experience working directly with OpenSearch for log and transaction analysis.

  • Hands-on experience with team collaboration tools (Slack, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence).

  • Domain knowledge infinancial workflows, payment lifecycles, and core fintech terminology.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related operational field.

Why Join Paysend?

  • Make a Global Impact:

Join a company that is transforming how people and businesses move money around the world. Your work will contribute to products and services that help millions of customers stay connected globally.

  • Own Meaningful Outcomes:

We empower our people to take ownership, make decisions, and drive real impact. You'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, challenge the status quo, and see the results of your work firsthand.

  • Grow with Us:

As a fast-growing global fintech, we offer opportunities to learn, develop new skills, take on new challenges, and advance your career across functions and geographies.

  • Collaborate with Exceptional People:

Work alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds and disciplines who are united by a shared ambition to build, innovate, and deliver great outcomes for our customers.

  • Move Fast and Make Things Happen:

We value action, curiosity, and continuous improvement. You'll be part of a culture that encourages experimentation, embraces change, and focuses on delivering meaningful results.

  • Be Part of Our Journey:

We're building the future of the global money movement. Join us at an exciting stage of growth where your ideas, expertise, and contributions can help shape what's next.

raw.description:
About Afton Partners

Afton Partnersis an impact-driven consultancy that reimagines and implements systems, policies, and practices that improve lives. We bring technical savvy and a relational approach to partnerships with clients across the early care and education, K-12, higher education, and workforce development sectors. Since 2011, Afton has collaborated on more than 150 initiatives in 40 states, and our clients include state and local government agencies, public school systems, charter schools, and philanthropies. We’re creative, committed, and energized by complexity. Together, we can solve our toughest societal challenges and co-create a future where each person has the opportunity for growth and fulfillment.

About the role

The Manager will support Afton’s public charter school finance practice with a keen focus on financial projection modeling and fiscal data analysis. The position will engage in consulting projects with public charter schools of all sizes, with the goal of strengthening our clients’ capability to achieve and maintain long-term financial sustainability.

Recently, a Charter School CFO reflected on our work together, saying, “This project has fundamentally changed how our organization approaches financial planning, governance, and decision-making. Working closely with [Afton team members], we replaced a more traditional, static budgeting approach with a seven-year, scenario-based financial forecast that incorporates inflationary cost assumptions and long-term sustainability metrics.”

This is a full-time, remote position within the United States, requiring up to 10% travel. Afton offers competitive pay and benefits, including health insurance, paid time off, and 401(k) with company match. The salary range for the position is $120,000-$130,000 per year.

What you'll do

If you enjoy and excel at these responsibilities, this position may be a great opportunity for you.

Financial Analysis and Client Service

  • Collaboratively design and structure highly complex data analytic models by identifying and applying the appropriate tools.
  • Conduct financial, enrollment, personnel, and other analyses to inform recommendations that will support school leaders’ financial planning and related decisions.
  • Assess the long-term financial health of an organization, including significant drivers of performance and risk, through modeling, research, benchmarking, interviews, and other means.
  • Efficiently and consistently review your own work and the work of others by reviewing financial and other outputs and input assumptions for accuracy, reasonableness, and feasibility.
  • Develop effective communication and recommendation materials for clients.
  • Communicate independently with clients on tactical project topics such as project plans, data requests, scheduling, and meeting preparation.

Maintain and Improve Core Analytical and Communication Tools

  • Maintain and refine standardized financial models, templates, and analytical frameworks used across client engagements to ensure consistency, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline internal processes and communication materials, introducing new tools or approaches that improve the quality and efficiency of the team's work.

Qualifications

This position requires proficiency in financial modeling, financial analysis, and communication. Successful candidates will have demonstrated the ability to translate financial data into actionable insights and can navigate multiple concurrent projects or client requests.

Our experience suggests that the following types of professional experiences and skills have prepared candidates for this work:

  • A minimum of four years of relevant work experience in education or non-profit finance, financial services, management consulting, or similar roles.
  • Advanced financial acumen and financial projection modeling skills, developing projections with minimal supervision, using reasonable and well-researched assumptions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in virtual environments.
  • Intermediate project management skills, leading work streams, meeting project deadlines, anticipating challenges, and driving toward solutions.
  • Strong self-awareness and commitment to continuous improvement, including the ability to give and receive feedback effectively.
  • A strong interest in our client partners’ mission and communities.
  • Familiarity with GASB and FASB accounting concepts.
  • Alignment with Afton’s core values.

Research shows candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often apply only when they meet every listed qualification. If most of this describes you, we encourage you to apply.

Our mission is to assist millions of families in breaking free from the payday loan cycle. Each year, 12 million individuals resort to high-interest loans, often becoming trapped in a cycle of perpetual debt. We aim to put an end to this cycle and revolutionize the personal finance industry.

Joining us now presents an exceptional opportunity to play a pivotal role in DebtHammer's growth journey, working closely with the company's founder. Although our team is currently small, we are rapidly expanding.

We are seeking individuals to join our operations team—individuals who are enthusiastic about building a long-term career with us. If you are sales-oriented, possess a customer-first mindset, and aspire to elevate your customer service and sales skills by joining our remote operations team, we encourage you to apply!

Overview

As a Consumer Sales Representative at DebtHammer, your mission is to drive revenue for the company. Your primary responsibility will be engaging with potential customers actively seeking loan relief. We utilize three modes of communication to reach our customers: phone, text, and email. Once engaged, representatives use open-ended questions and active listening to understand the needs of the customer and position DebtHammer as the best solution. It will be your responsibility to ensure that our customers have an amazing experience with DebtHammer and perceive us as the go-to solution for this industry.

Currently, 100% of our customers are inbound, meaning they searched online, found one of our websites, and indicated that they are looking for payday loan relief.

These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $109,000.00 to $137,700.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

$114,000.00 - $165,800.00

Who are we

We’re not just a locker provider. We’re the technology partner behind seamless live experiences.

For visitors, attending a live experience, whether it is a festival, club night, stadium sports game, or theme park, it should be unforgettable for all the right reasons: convenience, safety, speed, and zero friction.

At elockers, we deliver smart locker solutions for promoters, venues, and event organizers. Our technology ensures smooth operations, reduces queues, removes wardrobe stress, and improves the overall visitor journey.

Founded in the Netherlands in 2017, we expanded across Europe and the UK before entering the US market. Today, we work with hundreds of partners across these regions. Trusted where experience matters most, our international team combines operational expertise with scalable technology to elevate both guest satisfaction and operational performance.

The role

As Sales Manager (US), you are responsible for expanding elockers’ presence across the United States. You identify new opportunities, build strong relationships with venue operators and event organizers, and drive the full sales cycle from first contact to closing.

You will introduce our smart locker solutions to the live entertainment industry and help venues and promoters improve their visitor experience and operational efficiency. Working closely with marketing, operations, and product teams, you translate market needs into opportunities and play a key role in scaling our US business.

Your responsibilities

  • Identify and approach potential clients across the United States

  • Build strong relationships and guide prospects through the full sales journey, from first demo to final onboarding and, in some cases, on-site support

  • Negotiate and close deals with event organizers and venue owners or operators

  • Share valuable market insights and client feedback with internal teams

What we offer

raw.excerpt: About LaunchmetricsLaunchmetrics is the leading Brand Performance Cloud used by Fashion, Lifestyle and Beauty (FLB) executives to make smarter decisions around their branding efforts.
raw.description:
About Launchmetrics

Launchmetrics is the leading Brand Performance Cloud used by Fashion, Lifestyle and Beauty (FLB) executives to make smarter decisions around their branding efforts.

With over a decade of industry expertise, we have helped more than 1,200 customers create inspiring, impactful and measurable experiences.

Founded in NYC and with operating headquarters in Paris, we have employees in ten markets worldwide and offer support in five languages. We have been the trusted brand performance technology to brands worldwide such as Dior, Fendi, Shiseido, NET-A-PORTER and Adidas as well as industry partners like IMG, the Council of Fashion Designers of America, the British Fashion Council, and Camera Nazionale Della Moda Italiana.

The Team & the Pods organization

We are a team of passionate engineers distributed across the world, always eager to learn new things. We are building state-of-the-art modern applications and scale it on the cloud. We innovate to solve customers problems, focusing on high-performance implementations without neglecting the user experience.

We recently moved our Product and Tech teams to a pod model:

  • A pod is a small group, 1 to 4 people, that owns a single mission end to end: from scoping and building through cleaning, enablement and watching adoption. Pods form around a mission and dissolve when it's done. Everyone is a pod owner, from the most junior person to the most senior, because ownership is the point.

  • Your domain is your product-area home, the part of our software suite you know best. Pods change with every mission; your craft and your domain don't.

The role

The Data Platform and Data Enrichment teams are in charge of making our unified database accessible, usable, enrichable and reliable for all our teams internally.

The team owns the Lakehouse that powers Launchmetrics' data products — a Databricks-based platform built on Delta Lake, S3, and following a Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architecture. This layer stores, enriches, and serves the media intelligence data behind Discover (our client-facing platform), Genie (internal tooling), and Delta Sharing. You'll work on a batch-first system that simulates real-time behavior using primitives like Change Data Feed, S3 event triggers, serverless compute, and liquid clustering.

This role plays a key part in our Tech & Product strategy, directly supporting company-wide objectives around customer retention, data trust, and the development of new AI-based insights.

What you'll do

  • Design and build data pipelines (batch and near-real-time) using PySpark and Databricks, across the Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion layers

  • Architect efficient Delta Lake table schemas — partitioning/liquid clustering strategy, schema evolution handling, and enrichment workflows

  • Work closely with product, QA, and other data engineers to translate enrichment and search requirements into reliable pipelines

  • Own code quality: structured PySpark jobs, unit tests (pytest), and adherence to team conventions

  • Continuously improve pipeline reliability and cost efficiency (OPTIMIZE scheduling, retry/backoff logic, concurrency handling)

  • Participate in cross-pod initiatives across the data platform

Technical Stack

  • Languages: Python, PySpark, Typescript

  • Data Platform: Databricks, Delta Lake, Delta Sharing

  • Storage: AWS S3, MySQL

  • Cloud: AWS (S3, Kinesis, Lambda, SQS, ECS, Step Functions, …)

  • Tools: Jira, Databricks Asset Bundles, Serverless, Claude Code

  • Versioning: Git, GitHub

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Testing: pytest, Jest

What we're looking for

  • Engineer Degree or Master Degree in Computer Science and 3+ years of relevant work experience in full-stack development in a SaaS environment

  • Strong Python and PySpark experience; comfort with distributed data processing at scale

  • Experience with a Lakehouse architecture (Databricks, Delta Lake, or comparable — e.g. Spark on EMR/Glue)

  • Familiarity with medallion architecture patterns (Bronze/Silver/Gold) or similar layered data design

  • Ability to reason about schema evolution, partitioning/clustering strategy, and pipeline reliability (retries, idempotency)

  • Ability to traverse logical sequences of either procedural or object-oriented code, abstracted or static - and understand it entirely

  • Bright, energetic, highly motivated self-starter with experience in a fast-paced, results-oriented organization

  • Ability to adapt, estimate workload, break down a task into logical steps, solve problems, self-improve and suggest new ways of improvement

  • Last, but definitely not least: you speak, read, and write English fluently

How we hire

  • Intro call with Talent Acquisition, to get to know each other (30 min).

  • Meet & Greet with VP Software Development.

  • Technical Interview, a live interview with a couple of Software Engineers.

  • Team fit with the engineers and peers you'd build alongside.

Why you'll love it here

We're a company that puts people first, with a relaxed but genuinely dynamic atmosphere and a team of motivated, curious people who like their work. Autonomy is real here: pods make local decisions and own their outcomes, which means you'll see your fingerprints on the product quickly.

You'll get a learning and development allowance, a benefits package tailored to your location, flexible working arrangements with support to set up your home office, and the room to grow along whichever path fits you. We're remote-friendly, with hubs across our twelve markets.

OUR COMMITMENT

Launchmetrics is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If there is anything extra we can do to help you feel at ease during your interview process, please let the PeopleOps team member you’ll be meeting with know.

raw.description:
About the Role

As a Business Enablement Specialist, you will design, document and operationalise repeatable processes and the systems that support them. Working across Product, Engineering, Operations and Commercial teams, you will simplify complex workflows, reduce manual work, and ensure teams have reliable tools, clear procedures and the data they need to operate at scale. This is a hands-on role that combines process design, systems configuration, integration work and cross-functional change management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Map, document and optimise end-to-end operational workflows across multiple products and platforms, identifying automation opportunities and failure modes.

  • Configure and maintain internal systems and tooling (CRM, ticketing, workflow orchestration, admin panels and integrations) to support streamlined operations.

  • Design and implement integrations and automations using APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT patterns and third-party platforms to reduce manual handoffs and data reconciliation.

  • Create clear, scalable process documentation, runbooks and SOPs so teams can operate independently and consistently.

  • Author tracking and instrumentation requirements to ensure operational observability: logs, metrics, alerts and dashboards for key process health indicators.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to prioritise system improvements, scope development work and validate that releases meet operational needs and reliability standards.

  • Lead change management and training for new processes and systems, including stakeholder communication, onboarding materials and hands-on support during rollouts.

  • Own incident playbooks and contribute to incident response readiness: triage steps, escalation paths and post-incident reviews with actionable remediation plans.

  • Maintain data quality and access controls across operational systems, ensuring privacy-sensitive information is handled according to policy.

  • Continuously measure process performance and iterate: reduce cycle times, error rates and manual interventions through disciplined experimentation and monitoring.

How You’ll Do It

  • Develop clear process maps, decision trees and acceptance criteria that translate business workflows into system requirements.

  • Implement and maintain integrations using standard patterns (webhooks, message queues, scheduled jobs) and document failure/retry behaviours.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and alerts for operational KPIs, and perform routine QA to detect regressions or instrumentation gaps.

  • Create and maintain runbooks and training materials; run workshops and drop-in clinics to increase adoption and reduce support load.

  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to scope deliverables, set success metrics and verify post-deployment outcomes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years’ experience in operations, business systems, process improvement or a related role supporting cross-functional teams.

  • Practical experience with business systems such as CRMs, ticketing/workflow tools, analytics platforms and common SaaS integrations.

  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT, event-driven architectures) and a pragmatic approach to automation.

  • Strong documentation skills — able to produce unambiguous process specs, runbooks and training guides that scale across teams.

  • Solid analytical skills with experience instrumenting and monitoring processes using metrics, dashboards and alerts.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business audiences.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments and taking ownership of cross-functional initiatives from discovery through to operational handover.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms, low-code automation tools, or integration platforms (Zapier, Make, Workato, n8n, or similar).

  • Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting (Python, Google Apps Script) to build small automations and perform data validation.

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Looker/Looker Studio or similar) for operational metrics and alerting.

  • Experience designing processes in privacy-conscious environments and implementing appropriate access controls.

  • Previous experience leading cross-functional change programmes or training initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational workflows are well-documented, measurable and reliably executed with minimal manual intervention.

  • Systems and integrations reduce cycle times and error rates, and internal teams trust the tools and runbooks provided.

  • Incidents are resolved according to playbooks, root causes are addressed, and recurrence is demonstrably reduced.

  • Process and system improvements are delivered iteratively with clear metrics demonstrating impact on scalability and efficiency.

Why Join Us?

You’ll join a collaborative team where your work directly improves how the business operates at scale. This role offers exposure to multiple product lines, the chance to shape tooling and process standards, and the opportunity to make measurable impact by reducing operational complexity and enabling teams to move faster.

Krijg jij energie van klanten overtuigen en deals sluiten?
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld en weet je vertrouwen op te bouwen bij potentiële investeerders?
Wil je als zelfstandige zelf bepalen wanneer en hoe je werkt?
En lijkt het je interessant om klanten mee te nemen in het verhaal van investeren in bouwgronden in de Ardennen?

Dan is deze commerciële uitdaging iets voor jou.

Over de klant

Onze klant is gespecialiseerd in de verkoop van bouw- en villagronden in de Ardennen en begeleidt investeerders gedurende het volledige aankooptraject. Met jarenlange ervaring en een uitgebreid aanbod ligt de focus op een persoonlijke aanpak: van het eerste contact en het bepalen van de investeringswensen tot het bezoeken van geschikte gronden en het afronden van de aankoop.

Voor de verdere groei zijn we op zoek naar een zelfstandige Sales Professional die actief klanten in Vlaanderen weet te vinden en hen warm maakt voor een investering in de Ardennen.

Wat houdt de functie in?

  • Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten in Vlaanderen die interesse hebben in vastgoed en investeringen in de Ardennen.

  • Je bouwt zelfstandig een netwerk van potentiële investeerders op en onderhoudt bestaande contacten.

  • Je voert gesprekken met geïnteresseerde klanten en brengt hun wensen, budget en investeringsdoelstellingen in kaart.

  • Je begeleidt potentiële kopers persoonlijk en legt helder uit welke mogelijkheden er zijn binnen het aanbod van bouw- en villagronden.

  • Je gaat samen met klanten naar de Ardennen om geschikte projecten en bouwgronden te bekijken en zorgt ervoor dat zij een duidelijk beeld krijgen van hun mogelijke investering.

  • Je volgt het volledige verkoopproces op, van eerste kennismaking tot offerte en uiteindelijke deal.

  • Je bouwt vertrouwen op gedurende het traject en zorgt ervoor dat klanten met een goed gevoel een beslissing kunnen nemen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met het team om klanten correct te begeleiden en dossiers succesvol af te ronden.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van prospectie, klantencontact en het sluiten van deals.

  • Je bent ondernemend en vindt het vanzelfsprekend om zelf actief op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe klanten.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt mensen op een professionele en overtuigende manier meenemen in een verhaal.

  • Je weet vertrouwen op te bouwen en begrijpt dat de aankoop van vastgoed een beslissing is waarbij persoonlijke begeleiding belangrijk is.

  • Je hebt interesse in vastgoed en investeringen; ervaring binnen vastgoed, financiële dienstverlening of een andere commerciële omgeving is een sterke troef.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en kunt je eigen agenda en klantenportefeuille efficiënt beheren.

  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B en bent bereid om samen met potentiële klanten naar de Ardennen te rijden.

  • Je bent bereid om op zelfstandige basis te werken en ziet flexibiliteit als een belangrijk voordeel.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?

  • Je werkt volledig op zelfstandige basis en bepaalt zelf wanneer je werkt en hoe je jouw agenda organiseert.

  • Je krijgt de vrijheid om je commerciële activiteit op jouw manier uit te bouwen, zonder vaste kantooruren.

  • Je werkt met een concreet en tastbaar product: bouw- en villagronden in de Ardennen.

  • Je krijgt de kans om een eigen klantenportefeuille en netwerk uit te bouwen en rechtstreeks impact te hebben op je verkoopresultaten.

  • Je wordt ondersteund door een ervaren organisatie en kunt rekenen op de nodige informatie en ondersteuning tijdens het verkoopproces.

  • Je begeleidt klanten persoonlijk en bent betrokken bij het volledige traject, waardoor je dicht bij de uiteindelijke deal staat.

  • Je werkt in een markt waarin de interesse van Vlaamse investeerders in de Ardennen aanwezig is en waarin vastgoed en tweede verblijven een belangrijke rol spelen.

  • Je inkomsten zijn gekoppeld aan je commerciële resultaten, waardoor je als zelfstandige rechtstreeks kunt profiteren van je eigen succes.

raw.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.

raw.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.

Programa de capacitação gratuito oferecido pelo Centro de Competência EMBRAPII CPQD em Open RAN em parceria com a Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Paraná (PUCPR). O curso é voltado para a formação avançada em infraestrutura tecnológica e orquestração de contêineres aplicada ao ecossistema de telecomunicações.

Detalhes da Formação

  • Modalidade: 100% Online e Síncrono (aulas ao vivo, não gravadas)

  • Duração: 20 semanas (com 5 semanas intensivas de conteúdo/atividades)

  • Investimento: Gratuito

  • Certificação: Emitida pela PUCPR e Centro de Competência CPQD (exige 100% de consumo do conteúdo, 75% de frequência ao vivo, nota mínima 7,0 e 100% das entregas realizadas)

  • Turma de formação:

    • Turma 1: Início em 26/10/2026 — Segundas e Quartas-feiras, das 17h às 19h

    • Turma 2: Início em 27/10/2026 — Terças e Quintas-feiras, das 19h às 21h

      Atenção: A alocação nas turmas será feita exclusivamente pela instituição, conforme a disponibilidade de vagas. Não é possível escolher turma ou horário.

Requirements

  1. Público alvo:

  • Estudantes Universitários: Matriculados em cursos de TI/Engenharias (Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Telecomunicações, Software, Elétrica, Mecatrônica, etc.) com no mínimo 50% do curso concluído.

  • Formados: Tecnólogos e Técnicos em Eletrônica/Telecomunicações ou graduados/pós-graduados nas áreas de TICs.

  • Profissionais: Experiência comprovada em áreas correlatas ao Open RAN.

2. Conhecimentos Técnicos Necessários:

  • Obrigatórios: Conhecimentos em Linux (terminal, comandos, permissões, serviços, SSH e logs), Redes TCP/IP (IP, sub-redes, roteamento, DNS, portas/protocolos) e Virtualização (Máquinas Virtuais, VirtualBox, infraestrutura de servidores).

  • Desejáveis: Shell Scripting (Bash), arquivos YAML, HTTP/HTTPS, Certificados Digitais e arquitetura Cliente-Servidor.

3. Documentação Obrigatória para Inscrição:

  • Documento oficial de identificação com foto.

  • Comprovante de escolaridade (Diploma ou Declaração da faculdade atestando ao menos 50% de conclusão).

  • Curriculum Vitae atualizado — formatos aceitos: CV padrão ou Lattes.

raw.description:
Pak jij de kans om samen met twee collega's te ondernemen in een groeiende technische detachering? Bij SD Worx Technics ga je vakspecialisten verbinden aan een opdracht waarin zij echt het verschil maken. Je krijgt hierin volop de vrijheid, het vertrouwen en de verantwoordelijkheid om impact te maken: op klanten, op technici én op je eigen carrière.

Jij zorgt voor de perfecte match en begeleiding gedurende het gehele proces. Jij bent dé specialist die precies weet wat er speelt in de technische sector. Jij weet op de juiste manier technici te benaderen en te overtuigen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Recruiter Techniek ben je de spil tussen onze technici en opdrachtgevers. Jij weet hoe je de beste technici binnenhaalt en samen met je collega plaatst bij je klanten. Vanzelfsprekend bouw je aan je relaties met je kandidaten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

· Recruitment: je bouwt aan je kandidatenpool met de beste technici. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan elektromonteurs, maintenance engineers, servicetechnici en werktuigbouwkundige.

· Technici en opdrachtgevers matchen: Ook na het matchen blijf je de eerste contactpersoon van zowel de klant, als de begeleider van je kandidaat gedurende de opdracht.

· Targets behalen: Je werkt toe naar het behalen van jouw persoonlijke doelstellingen. Dit omvat zowel kwantitatieve als kwalitatieve targets.

· Netwerk verder uitbouwen: Je gaat zelfstandig actief opzoek naar nieuwe opdrachtgevers.

Wat bieden wij?

SD Worx Technics heeft een informele werksfeer waarin gestuurd wordt op output. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatieven. We bieden jou de vrijheid en flexibiliteit om de regie over je werk in handen te nemen. Zo krijg je de ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris tussen de €2900,- en €4500,- bruto op basis van 40 uur afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Een netto onkostenvergoeding van €75,- en een netto internetvergoeding van €25,- op basis van 40 uur

  • Leaseauto die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Een kwartaalbonusregeling

  • 8,5% vakantiegeld

  • 25 vakantiedagen, 6,5 adv dagen (of 2,5% extra salaris) & een vrije dag op je verjaardag

  • Een pensioenregeling waarbij SD Worx 60% van de premie betaald

  • Korting op je sportschool abonnement en op een nieuwe fiets

Wat neem jij mee?

Als Recruiter Techniek is het van belang dat je een commerciële drive hebt. Het gaat om een zelfstandige functie die vraagt om proactiviteit. We zoeken daarbij iemand met:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Ervaring in de technische sector en/of detachering

  • Resultaatgerichtheid en ervaring met het behalen van individuele en teamtargets

  • Klantgerichtheid en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden

  • Oog voor de marktontwikkelingen en deze weet te vertalen naar kansen voor kandidaten

Technics

SD Worx Technics is een specialist in het matchen van technische vakmensen met uitdagende projecten. Wij bieden een persoonlijke benadering en leveren maatwerkoplossingen voor zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers. Onze cultuur is open en informeel, met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en innovatie. Bij ons staan kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en integriteit centraal.

Bij SD Worx werken we als één team en groeien we samen, van beter tot best. Diversiteit staat centraal in ons bedrijf, omdat het ons inspireert en innovatie stimuleert. We verwelkomen sollicitaties van gekwalificeerd talent, ongeacht afkomst, nationaliteit, geslacht, huidskleur, etnische en sociale achtergrond, religie, leeftijd, handicap, seksuele geaardheid en levensfase.

Hier kun je volop groeien, leren en innoveren. Join the team en ervaar het zelf!

About BigHand

BigHand offers technology solutions for busy legal professionals that provide data and insights to increase value and profits. Through our expert knowledge and innovative technology, we enable our customers to achieve enhanced efficiency, better decision-making and harness their competitive edge.

We build with tomorrow in mind, transforming ideas into action and empowering our customers to succeed in a world of constant change. We make big happen for our customers.

In Lebanon, we partner with Digitus Consultants who enable us secure top talent across Lebanon. Joining the BigHand team via Digitus will mean joining a values-driven business, we have these at the centre of everything we do. Our BigHanders are dedicated to building a culture where We Win Together, We Love to Learn, We Do the Right Thing, We Own It and We Find the Fun.

About the role

BigHand is on an exciting journey to become a truly cloud‑native, AI‑enabled SaaS organisation. As a Platform Operations Engineer, you will sit at the heart of this transformation, helping to modernise our platforms while strengthening our cloud, operational and security capabilities.

You will work closely with engineers, architects and delivery leaders to design, operate and continuously improve our cloud platform, ensuring our SaaS services remain secure, scalable and highly available for customers worldwide.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build and operate highly available SaaS platforms, supporting cloud migration, containerisation using Kubernetes and Docker, and modern PaaS and IaaS architectures.

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and automation tooling to standardise, secure and scale deployments.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver secure, cost‑effective cloud platforms aligned to business goals.

  • Lead and support platform operations, including incident management, observability, patching, upgrades and continuous service improvement.

  • Embed security and compliance best practices across the platform, including OWASP methodologies, ISO27001 and SOC2 controls.

  • Contribute to ongoing innovation and operational excellence by improving processes, documentation and platform standards.

What we’re looking for

  • Any cloud background, including Azure, AWS or GCP.

  • Significant hands‑on experience (5+ years) in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure or Software Engineering roles.

  • Expert scripting experience, ideally PowerShell, with Bash also considered.

  • Strong experience with container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code approaches.

  • A solid understanding of cloud security, secure development lifecycle practices, cryptography and vulnerability management.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate and balance reliability, security, velocity and cost.

What we offer (via Digitus)

  • 15 days holiday per year + 3 extra BigHand days off between Christmas & New Year every year

  • Various wellbeing benefits including medical insurance, wellbeing leave, online wellbeing programs & webinars, access to online therapy and Employee Resource Groups (ERG)

  • Company-wide Wellness day, for our teams all across the globe to switch off and spend the day doing something to nourish their mental health

  • Opportunities to give back with company volunteer events and individual volunteer days

  • Family benefits including enhanced maternity leave, paternity leave and marriage leave

  • Career growth opportunities and study leave options

  • Remote-working arrangement

  • Growing business with a global presence, growing Lebanon team and a brand new Beirut office (for those who would prefer hybrid-working)!

OurDEI Commitment

We welcome the unique value and individuality that you can bring to BigHand. We are an equal opportunity employer and are dedicated to recruiting solely based on capability and potential regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, educational background, national origin, religion, military status or physical ability. Our BigHanders are dedicated to advancing our culture of belonging by embracing differing viewpoints, opinions, thoughts, and ideas.

We are a group of young and motivated professionals from all corners of the world, working with the world’s largest enterprises on all continents, and driven by the clear idea to leave a mark in the rapidly growing AI-powered marketing technology space. We are a stable and profitable high growth operation, and our journey has just begun.

Location: Remote (Europe)

HQ: Barcelona

Role Overview:

Momentum Data is looking for an experienced ABM Director to lead and scale our account-based marketing strategy across both existing enterprise customers and new target accounts.

In this role, you’ll own the global ABM vision - from strategy and segmentation through execution and measurement - working closely with Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Product. You’ll help deepen relationships with our 150+ enterprise clients while building repeatable ABM programs that drive pipeline, expansion, and long-term growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows how to turn ABM from a concept into a measurable revenue driver.

Requirements

Own and evolve Momentum Data’s ABM strategy across customer expansion and new business acquisition

Design and execute 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many ABM programs for enterprise and strategic accounts

Partner closely with Sales and Account Management to align on target accounts, account plans, messaging, and success metrics

Develop scalable ABM frameworks that can be adapted across regions, industries, and account tiers

Drive account engagement, pipeline creation, deal acceleration, and expansion revenue

Oversee ABM-related content, personalization, and campaign orchestration across channels

Act as a subject-matter expert on ABM internally and externally, helping position Momentum Data as a leader in the space

Collaborate with Product and RevOps to ensure tooling, data, and workflows support ABM execution

Qualifications & Experience:

8+ years of experience in B2B marketing, with deep expertise in Account-Based Marketing
